trans-unit.source: Arc accordion: a list of question rows that reveal their answers in place. The panel height follows the content on a smooth spring that never overshoots and retargets mid-flight, the answer settles down 6px out of a subtle blur as it opens, and the chevron turns on a snappy spring. Single mode (Arc) keeps one row open and lets it close; `Multiple` opens rows independently. Arrow keys move between the row triggers, Home / End jump to the ends, Enter / Space toggle. Rows are `AccordionItem`s written inline (`<arc:AccordionItem Header="Question">Answer</arc:AccordionItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource` (`ItemTemplate` renders the question, `ContentTemplate` the answer).
trans-unit.target: Arc 手风琴：一组问题行，展开后在原位显示答案。面板高度沿平滑弹簧跟随内容变化，不会过冲，并且可以在动画中途改变目标；答案展开时从轻微模糊中下落 6px；箭头以灵敏的弹簧转动。单选模式（Arc）保持一行展开，并允许其收起；`Multiple` 则让各行独立展开。方向键在行触发器之间移动，Home / End 跳到首尾，Enter / Space 切换展开。行为内联书写的 `AccordionItem`（`<arc:AccordionItem Header="Question">Answer</arc:AccordionItem>`），或由 `ItemsSource` 生成（`ItemTemplate` 渲染问题，`ContentTemplate` 渲染答案）。

trans-unit.source: Template for the answers of data items (the question uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 数据项答案的模板（问题使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.target: 单选（Arc）或多行同时展开。

trans-unit.source: Index of the open row; −1 closes every row (Arc defaultOpen, default 0). Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 已展开行的索引；−1 表示收起所有行（Arc 的 defaultOpen 默认为 0）。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Row size; `Large` suits page-level FAQs.
trans-unit.target: 行的尺寸；`Large` 适合页面级常见问题。

trans-unit.source: One row of an `Accordion`: `Header` is the question (the whole row is the trigger) and `Content` the answer. The answer stays mounted while closed so a second click mid-flight reverses from where it is; a closed answer takes no pointer or keyboard focus.
trans-unit.target: `Accordion` 的一行：`Header` 为问题（整行即触发器），`Content` 为答案。收起时答案仍保持挂载，因此动画中途再次点击会从当前位置反向；收起的答案不接收指针或键盘焦点。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the row opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 行展开或收起后引发。

trans-unit.target: 答案是否展开。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: A call to action for one asynchronous submit (Save, Publish): pending and success show on the button itself. The changed letters of the label rise out of a soft blur while kept letters glide (P4) and the width follows on a spring (P5); the trailing arrow leaves in the direction of the action, a spinner turns while `AsyncAction` runs, a check draws itself on success (P15), and the button returns to idle after `ResetAfter`. Pending keeps keyboard focus: activation is swallowed instead of disabling the button.
trans-unit.target: 用于一次异步提交的行动按钮（保存、发布）：等待与成功状态直接显示在按钮上。标签中变化的字母从柔和模糊中升起，未变化的字母平滑滑动（P4），宽度沿弹簧跟随变化（P5）；末尾箭头朝操作方向离开，`AsyncAction` 运行时加载图标旋转，成功时对勾自行绘制（P15），并在 `ResetAfter` 之后恢复空闲状态。等待期间保持键盘焦点：激活操作会被忽略，而不是禁用按钮。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `AsyncAction` throws.
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 抛出异常时引发。

trans-unit.source: The work to run. The button is pending until the task completes; a fault returns it to idle and raises `ActionFailed`. `Command` and `Click` run first and, without an async action, count as an immediate success.
trans-unit.target: 要运行的工作。在任务完成前按钮处于等待状态；出错会使其恢复空闲并引发 `ActionFailed`。`Command` 与 `Click` 会先运行，若没有异步操作，则视为立即成功。

trans-unit.source: The idle label and, always, the accessible name (default "Save").
trans-unit.target: 空闲时的标签，同时始终作为无障碍名称（默认为“保存”）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while `AsyncAction` runs (default "Saving").
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 运行期间显示的标签（默认为“保存中”）。

trans-unit.source: How long success stays before returning to idle (default 2.4s); zero keeps it.

trans-unit.source: Shown after the action succeeds (default "Saved").
trans-unit.target: 操作成功后显示的标签（默认为“已保存”）。

trans-unit.source: A contribution-style calendar (Arc "Activity heatmap"): one square per day, weeks as columns, four accent tints for how busy a day was. Cells wave in once on first view; a single tooltip glides between cells on hover or keyboard focus; a new range recolors the grid in a diagonal sweep instead of redrawing it; the legend previews (hover, focus) or pins (click) one level. ↑ / ↓ move by day, ← / → by week, Home / End to the ends, Enter / Space select.
trans-unit.target: 贡献式日历（Arc “Activity heatmap”）：每天一个方块，周为列，四种强调色浅深表示当天的活跃程度。单元格在首次显示时依次浮入；单个提示框在悬停或键盘焦点变化时在单元格之间平滑滑动；切换范围时以对角扫过的方式重新着色，而不是整体重绘；图例在悬停、焦点时预览某一级别，点击时锁定该级别。↑ / ↓ 按天移动，← / → 按周移动，Home / End 跳到首尾，Enter / Space 选择。

trans-unit.source: Arc alert: a persistent message that helps people recover or continue. Keep one instance and change `Tone`, `Title` and the content to morph it between states: the icon pops into the new tone, new text rises out of a soft blur and the height springs to fit. Hiding it (`IsOpen`) collapses the height while it fades, so the content below closes the gap. A string `Content` is the description line; any other content is shown as is.
trans-unit.target: Arc 警示：持久显示的消息，帮助使用者恢复或继续操作。保持同一实例，改变 `Tone`、`Title` 和内容即可在各状态间变形：图标以弹出方式切换为新色调，新文字从柔和模糊中升起，高度以弹簧适配内容。隐藏（`IsOpen`）时高度在淡出的同时收缩，使下方内容填补空隙。字符串类型的 `Content` 为描述行；其他类型的内容按原样显示。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a dismissed alert finished collapsing.
trans-unit.target: 已关闭的警示完成收缩后引发。

trans-unit.source: Shows the dismiss button. Dismissing collapses the alert, then raises `Dismissed`.
trans-unit.target: 显示关闭按钮。关闭时先收缩警示，然后引发 `Dismissed`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the alert is shown. Hiding collapses its height and fades it out. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 警示是否显示。隐藏时收缩高度并淡出。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: The headline. A new title rises in from below while the old one lifts away.
trans-unit.target: 标题。新标题从下方升入，旧标题同时向上移出。

trans-unit.source: Tone (default `Info`).
trans-unit.target: 色调（默认 `Info`）。

trans-unit.source: A number that rolls digit by digit like an odometer: only changed columns turn (in the direction the whole number moved), separators slide in and out, and the label crossfades with a short rise. With `AnimateOnView` every digit rolls up from zero the first time 60% of the counter is visible.
trans-unit.target: 一个像里程表一样逐位滚动的数字：只有变化的位会转动（转动方向与整个数字的变化方向一致），分隔符滑入滑出，标签以短促上升的方式交叉淡入。设置 `AnimateOnView` 后，计数器首次有 60% 可见时，每一位都会从零滚动上来。

trans-unit.source: Roll every digit up from zero the first time the counter scrolls into view.
trans-unit.target: 计数器首次滚动进入视野时，所有位从零滚动到目标值。

trans-unit.source: Formatting culture; fixed (en-US) by default so every machine renders the same digits.
trans-unit.target: 格式化所用的文化；默认固定为 en-US，使每台机器显示相同的数字。

trans-unit.source: Digits after the decimal point (default 0); negative values count as 0.
trans-unit.target: 小数点后的位数（默认 0）；负值按 0 计。

trans-unit.source: Accessible label announced before the value.
trans-unit.target: 数值之前朗读的无障碍标签。

trans-unit.source: Text placed before the number, such as a currency sign.

trans-unit.target: 置于数字之后的文字，例如单位或百分号。

trans-unit.source: The number to display; changes animate the digits to the new value.
trans-unit.target: 要显示的数字；数值变化时，各位数字会以动画过渡到新值。

trans-unit.source: One message of an `AnnouncementBar`.
trans-unit.target: `AnnouncementBar` 的一条消息。

trans-unit.source: Arc announcement bar: a slim banner for the top of a page. It rotates 2–4 short messages (the next one rises from below while the bar springs to the new height), pauses on hover, focus or a minimized window, and with `IsNavigationVisible` adds previous, next and a pause ring that fills over `Interval`. Messages can carry a call to action and a live countdown. Dismissing collapses the height so the page below eases up; with a `DismissalKey` the dismissal is remembered (`IMessageStorage`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 公告栏：用于页面顶部的细长横幅。它轮播 2–4 条简短消息（下一条从下方升起，同时横幅以弹簧变为新高度），鼠标悬停、获得焦点或窗口最小化时暂停；设置 `IsNavigationVisible` 后会增加上一条、下一条按钮，以及一个在 `Interval` 时间内逐渐填满的暂停圆环。消息可以带有行动按钮和实时倒计时。关闭时高度收缩，使下方页面平滑上移；若设置了 `DismissalKey`，关闭状态会被记住（`IMessageStorage`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a message's call to action is invoked.
trans-unit.target: 消息的行动按钮被触发时引发。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the bar was dismissed.
trans-unit.target: 横幅被关闭时引发。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a message's countdown reaches zero.
trans-unit.target: 消息的倒计时归零时引发一次。

trans-unit.source: Remembers the dismissal under this key; change the key to show a new campaign to everyone again.
trans-unit.target: 以此键记住关闭状态；更改该键可让所有人重新看到新的活动。

trans-unit.source: Time each message stays before the next one (default 6s).

trans-unit.source: Rotate automatically (default true); off under reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: 自动轮播（默认为 true）；在减少动效模式下关闭。

trans-unit.source: Show the dismiss button (default true).
trans-unit.target: 显示关闭按钮（默认为 true）。

trans-unit.target: 消息有多条时，显示上一条、下一条按钮和暂停圆环（默认为 false）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the bar is shown (two-way). A remembered dismissal keeps it hidden.

trans-unit.source: A person as a photo or initials. A photo that is still downloading fades in from a soft blur (cached photos show at once); a failed photo falls back to initials; the status dot pops in on a snappy spring.
trans-unit.target: 以照片或姓名首字母表示的人员。仍在下载的照片会从柔和模糊中淡入（已缓存的照片立即显示）；照片加载失败时回退为姓名首字母；状态点以灵敏的弹簧弹出。

trans-unit.target: 头像尺寸：Small、Medium（默认）、Large 或 XLarge。

trans-unit.source: Photo to show. A photo that fails to load falls back to initials.
trans-unit.target: 要显示的照片。照片加载失败时回退为首字母。

trans-unit.target: 在线状态圆点：None（默认，不显示圆点）、Online 或 Offline。

trans-unit.source: A team or set of contributors in a small space (Arc AvatarGroup): overlapping avatars with a 2px surface ring and a 1px border ring, later people stacked over earlier ones, and a "+N" chip for everyone past `MaxVisibleCount`. People who join or leave open or close their slot on the morph spring so the stack slides (P19); the overflow count rolls the way it moved (P14). Pointing at the stack (fine pointers only) loosens it from the center (P28) and lifts the person under the pointer with a crisp ring and their name while the neighbours ease aside (P27). Only the visible people get controls, so long member lists stay cheap. Items may be `AvatarGroupMember`, `Avatar` or plain names.
trans-unit.target: 少量空间内的团队或一组贡献者（Arc AvatarGroup）：头像相互叠放，带有 2px 的表面环和 1px 的边框环，较晚加入的人叠在较早的人之上；超过 `MaxVisibleCount` 的人员以“+N”标签表示。加入或离开的人员会以变形弹簧展开或收起其位置，使头像堆叠平滑滑动（P19）；溢出数字的变化方向与其实际变化一致（P14）。指针悬停在堆叠上（仅限精确指针）时，头像会从中心松散开（P28），指针下的人员会以清晰的环和姓名突出显示，相邻头像同时让开（P27）。只有可见的人员才会创建控件，因此长成员列表依然轻量。项可以是 `AvatarGroupMember`、`Avatar` 或纯文本姓名。

trans-unit.source: Bound members (`AvatarGroupMember`, `Avatar` or names); takes precedence over `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 绑定的成员（`AvatarGroupMember`、`Avatar` 或姓名）；优先于 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the group, also used for the overflow chip ("2 more team members").
trans-unit.target: 群组的无障碍名称，也用于溢出标签（“另外 2 位团队成员”）。

trans-unit.source: People shown before the rest fold into the overflow count (Arc `max`, 4).
trans-unit.target: 显示的人数上限，其余人员折叠进溢出数字（Arc 的 `max`，为 4）。

trans-unit.source: How many people are folded into the "+N" chip.
trans-unit.target: 折叠进“+N”标签的人数。

trans-unit.source: The person's name: initials, tooltip and accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 人员姓名：用于首字母、工具提示和无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Optional photo; initials show while it loads or when it fails.
trans-unit.target: 可选的照片；加载中或加载失败时显示首字母。

trans-unit.source: Optional online / offline dot.
trans-unit.target: 可选的在线/离线状态点。

trans-unit.source: A small pill for status, category or metadata (Arc Badge): a tone, an optional leading icon and a short label. It is a standalone inline label, not a count overlay. When a string or number label changes while the badge stays mounted, the new text rises out of a soft blur, the old one lifts away, and the pill width springs to fit (P2, P5); a new icon pops in from 0.6. Other content is shown as is. Reduced motion crossfades and the width jumps.
trans-unit.target: 用于状态、分类或元数据的小型药丸标签（Arc Badge）：包含一种色调、可选的前置图标和简短文字。它是独立的行内标签，而不是数量角标。当字符串或数字标签在徽章保持挂载时发生变化，新文字从柔和模糊中升起，旧文字向上移出，药丸宽度以弹簧适配（P2、P5）；新图标从 0.6 倍大小弹出。其他内容按原样显示。减少动效模式下改为交叉淡入，宽度直接跳变。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon (for example an `ArcGlyph`); it takes the tone color and is hidden from assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 前置图标（例如 `ArcGlyph`）；采用色调颜色，并对辅助技术隐藏。

trans-unit.source: Medium (26px, default) or Small (22px).
trans-unit.target: Medium（26px，默认）或 Small（22px）。

trans-unit.source: Color treatment (Arc `tone`, neutral by default).
trans-unit.target: 颜色样式（Arc `tone`，默认为中性）。

trans-unit.source: Arc's bar chart: one measure across a run of days, weeks or months, with an average reference line and a headline that reads the average at rest and the scrubbed bar while exploring. Bars grow in a left-to-right wave the first time the chart is seen; a new range zooms the slots around the latest bar while bars that keep their key morph, new ones grow beside them and leaving ones sink into the baseline. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` per bar) because bar heights, slots and the scale are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot, which ControlTheme transitions cannot reach.
trans-unit.target: Arc 柱状图：跨越一段天、周或月的单一指标，带有平均值参考线；标题在静止时显示平均值，探索时显示被扫过的柱。图表首次出现时，柱子按从左到右的波浪依次增长；切换范围时，图表围绕最新的柱缩放各槽位，保留键值的柱子会变形，新柱子在其旁边生长，被移除的柱子则下沉至基线。动画由代码驱动（每根柱子一个 `MotionValue`），因为柱高、槽位和刻度都是自绘绘图区域中的坐标，ControlTheme 的过渡无法触及。

trans-unit.source: Headline label at rest, above the average.
trans-unit.target: 静止时标题中平均值上方的标签。

trans-unit.source: The range on show, such as "Sep 15–21, 2026". It rests under the headline.
trans-unit.target: 当前显示的范围，例如“Sep 15–21, 2026”。它位于标题下方。

trans-unit.source: Draws the average as a dashed reference line that springs to each new range.
trans-unit.target: 将平均值绘制为虚线参考线，并以弹簧过渡到每个新范围。

trans-unit.source: Draws the gridlines behind the plot (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在图表背后绘制网格线（默认 true）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the category (time) axis labels under the plot (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在绘图区下方显示类别（时间）轴标签（默认 true）。

trans-unit.source: A billing page in one view: the current plan with its status, price and next charge; the card on file and the billing email; and the invoice history with a download button per invoice. Every action raises a routed event for the host to handle (change or cancel the plan, update the card, edit the email, download an invoice). Older invoices beyond `VisibleInvoiceCount` fold behind "Show all invoices". Composed of `SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow`, `Badge` and `Button`.

trans-unit.source: Arc billing toggle: a billing period switch. One thumb glides between the options on a critically damped spring, and the savings note on the cheaper period tints with `BadgeAccent` and rewrites itself in place once it is chosen. Defaults to Monthly / Yearly ("Save 20%"); supply `BillingToggleOption` items (inline or via `ItemsSource`) for other periods. `Value` is two-way. Pair it with `BillingPrice` for prices that roll to the new amount.

trans-unit.source: A modal sheet that rises from the bottom edge and rests at one or more heights (detents): trip details, share options, filters, map and media views where a peek is useful before the full view. One motion value drives the sheet: a drag follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands past the tallest detent, and on release projects 0.2s of its velocity to pick the nearest detent or close; a flick faster than 320px/s always moves at least one detent. The dim is a function of the sheet position. The grabber answers ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End and toggles between the lowest and highest detent; reading keys on the sheet open it fully before scrolling; touch drags on the content move the sheet until it is fully open. Under reduced motion detents jump and the sheet fades. The sheet position is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition: a drag writes it every move, a release hands the pointer velocity to the spring, and the scrim is computed from it each frame.
trans-unit.target: 从底部边缘升起、停留在一个或多个高度（档位）上的模态面板：适用于行程详情、分享选项、筛选器、地图和媒体视图等需要先预览、再查看完整内容的场景。一个动作值驱动整个面板：拖动时面板 1:1 跟随指针，越过最高档位时产生橡皮筋回弹；松开时，按 0.2s 内的速度投射位置，选择最近的档位或关闭；速度超过 320px/s 的快速轻扫至少会移动一个档位。遮罩的暗度由面板位置决定。拖柄响应 ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End，并在最低与最高档位之间切换；面板上的阅读键会先将其完全展开再滚动；在内容上进行触摸拖动会移动面板，直到其完全展开。减少动效模式下，档位直接跳转，面板淡入淡出。面板位置是 `MotionValue`，而不是 ControlTheme 过渡：拖动时每次移动都会写入它，松开时将指针速度交给弹簧，遮罩则在每一帧由它计算。

trans-unit.source: The sheet came to rest on another detent.
trans-unit.target: 面板停留在另一个档位时引发。

trans-unit.source: Arc breadcrumb: where a page sits in a hierarchy, from the root to the current page. Crumbs are separated by chevrons; the last one is the current page (accent, medium weight, not a link) and every crumb reserves the width of its medium-weight label so becoming current never shifts the path. Crumbs present at first render stay still; crumbs added later slide in 8px from the path before them out of a subtle blur while their siblings make room on the smooth spring, and removed crumbs slide 4px back as they fade. Items are `BreadcrumbItem`s written inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (`ItemTemplate` renders the label). Choosing a crumb raises `ItemClick`, runs its `Command` and opens its `NavigateUri`. `MaxVisibleItems` (off by default, as in Arc) folds the middle of a long path into an overflow menu.
trans-unit.target: Arc 面包屑：显示页面在层级中的位置，从根到当前页。各级之间以箭头分隔；最后一级为当前页（强调色、中等字重，不是链接）。每一级都会预留其中等字重标签的宽度，因此成为当前页时路径不会移位。首次渲染时已存在的级别保持静止；之后新增的级别会从前一级的路径位置滑入 8px，并在柔和模糊中出现，同级的其他项则以平滑弹簧让出空间；被移除的级别在淡出时滑回 4px。项为内联编写的 `BreadcrumbItem`，或由 `ItemsSource` 生成（`ItemTemplate` 渲染标签）。选择某一级会引发 `ItemClick`，运行其 `Command` 并打开其 `NavigateUri`。`MaxVisibleItems`（与 Arc 一样默认关闭）会将较长路径的中间部分折叠进溢出菜单。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a crumb or an overflow entry is chosen.
trans-unit.target: 选择某一级或溢出菜单项时引发。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.
trans-unit.target: 导航地标的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: When greater than 1 and the path is longer, the root and the last `MaxVisibleItems − 1` crumbs stay visible and the rest collapse into an overflow menu. 0 (Arc default) never collapses.
trans-unit.target: 大于 1 且路径更长时，保留根级和最后 `MaxVisibleItems − 1` 个层级可见，其余折叠进溢出菜单。0（Arc 默认）则从不折叠。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the overflow button.
trans-unit.target: 溢出按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Arc's brush chart: a long, dense time series with an overview strip. Drag the window to pan, drag a handle to resize, drag across empty track to draw a new window, tap to recenter, double-click to reset. When the view is zoomed far out a seven-point average and its low-to-high band replace the raw line, crossfading by density. Events are marked on both charts and labelled where they fit. The value axis springs to the tallest point in view; the line draws in from the left the first time the chart is seen. Dragging is followed 1:1 by a local tracker (`ChartDragTracker`); presets, resets and bound `Range` changes glide the window on a smooth spring (`MotionValue`), because the window is a coordinate pair inside the self-drawn overview.
trans-unit.target: Arc 刷选图表：带有概览条的长而密集的时间序列。拖动窗口可平移，拖动把手可调整大小，在空白轨道上拖动可绘制新窗口，轻点可重新居中，双击可重置。视图被缩放得很远时，七点平均值及其低到高的带状区域会取代原始折线，并按数据密度交叉淡入。事件会同时标记在两个图表上，并在有空间时标注文字。数值轴以弹簧贴合视野中最高的点；折线在图表首次出现时从左侧绘制。拖动由本地跟踪器（`ChartDragTracker`）1:1 跟随；预设、重置以及绑定的 `Range` 变化会以平滑弹簧（`MotionValue`）滑动窗口，因为窗口是自绘概览内的一对坐标。

trans-unit.source: Events drawn as markers on both charts.
trans-unit.target: 在两个图表上以标记绘制的事件。

trans-unit.target: 在提示与播报中格式化日期。默认为 “Tue, Sep 15, 2026”。

trans-unit.source: The visible window. A new value glides the window there; drags and keys write it back. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 可见窗口。赋新值时窗口会平滑滑动到该位置；拖动与键盘操作会回写此值。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Raised while the window is dragged, resized, stepped or reset.
trans-unit.target: 在窗口被拖动、调整大小、逐步移动或重置时引发。

trans-unit.source: Arc button: a clear, responsive action with quiet secondary states. Presses scale on a snappy spring, label changes crossfade with a short blur while the width springs to fit, and `IsLoading` shows a spinner while keeping keyboard focus (clicks are swallowed instead of disabling the button).
trans-unit.target: Arc 按钮：清晰、灵敏的操作，次要状态安静低调。按下时以轻快的弹簧缩放；文字变化时以短暂模糊交叉淡化，宽度以弹簧适配内容。`IsLoading` 显示加载指示器，同时保留键盘焦点（点击会被忽略，而不是禁用按钮）。

trans-unit.source: Puts the button in its loading state while true.
trans-unit.target: 为 true 时，按钮进入加载状态。

trans-unit.source: Anchors of popups and menus must not scale on press (the popup measures the pressed size); they answer with color only. Defaults to true.
trans-unit.target: 弹层与菜单的锚点按钮在按下时不得缩放（弹层需测量按下时的尺寸）；它们仅以颜色作出反馈。默认为 true。

trans-unit.source: Button height: Small, Medium (default) or Large.
trans-unit.target: 按钮高度：Small、Medium（默认）或 Large。

trans-unit.source: Visual style: Primary (default), Secondary, Ghost or Danger.
trans-unit.target: 视觉样式：Primary（默认）、Secondary、Ghost 或 Danger。

trans-unit.source: Two to five related actions joined into one surface with hairline dividers (Arc button group): Share, Duplicate and Archive on a document, zoom controls, Reply / Reply all / Forward. One soft highlight glides between segments under the pointer or keyboard focus (the dividers beside it step aside), the pressed segment answers in place, and an optional chevron segment (`Menu`) opens rarer or destructive actions in a menu aligned to the group's edge. Segments are `ButtonGroupItem`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (plain data becomes the label). When a horizontal row does not fit, segments with an icon drop their label (it moves to the tooltip and the accessible name); if it still does not fit the row scrolls sideways without a scrollbar. Keyboard: every segment is a Tab stop; the arrow keys along the orientation (mirrored right to left), Home and End move between segments and wrap; Enter or Space activates. On the chevron, Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu on the first row and Escape returns focus. A label that changes right after its segment was pressed (Share to Copied) is announced once.
trans-unit.target: 将两到五个相关操作合并为一个带细分隔线的整体（Arc 按钮组）：例如文档上的“分享”“复制”“归档”，缩放控件，“回复 / 全部回复 / 转发”。指针或键盘焦点所在的分段下方有一个柔和高亮平滑滑动（旁边的分隔线随之让开），被按下的分段原地作出反馈；可选的下拉箭头分段（`Menu`）会在一个与组边缘对齐的菜单中打开较少用或具破坏性的操作。分段可以是内联声明的 `ButtonGroupItem`，也可以由 `ItemsSource` 生成（普通数据会成为标签）。水平排列放不下时，带图标的分段会隐藏文字（文字移至提示与无障碍名称）；若仍放不下，整行会横向滚动且不显示滚动条。键盘操作：每个分段都是 Tab 停靠点；沿排列方向的方向键（从右到左时镜像）、Home 与 End 在分段间移动并循环；Enter 或空格键激活。在下拉箭头上，Enter、空格或 ArrowDown 会在第一行打开菜单，Escape 将焦点移回。分段被按下后立即改变的标签（如“分享”变为“已复制”）只播报一次。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a segment's own click handlers and command.
trans-unit.target: 在分段自身的点击处理程序与命令执行之后引发。

trans-unit.source: True while segments show only their icons because the row did not fit.
trans-unit.target: 因排列空间不足，分段只显示图标时为 true。

trans-unit.source: When a horizontal row does not fit, segments with an icon drop their label (default true).
trans-unit.target: 水平排列放不下时，带图标的分段隐藏其文字（默认为 true）。

trans-unit.target: 按钮组的无障碍名称（Arc 中必填），例如“文档操作”。

trans-unit.target: Small（36px）或 Medium（44px，默认）。Large 按 Medium 处理。

trans-unit.source: Outline (default) for a bordered surface, or Solid for the main action of a screen (use at most once).
trans-unit.target: Outline（默认）用于带边框的表面，Solid 用于页面的主要操作（最多使用一次）。

trans-unit.source: A single-date month calendar. Months slide on one spring-driven strip (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Today and a bound `DisplayMonth` all travel the same way), the title slides with them, and the selected disc glides between days while each number flips color as the disc passes it. Every month shows six weeks, so the height never changes. Full keyboard model: arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown (Shift = year), Enter/Space; disabled days are skipped in the direction of travel.
trans-unit.target: 单日期的月历。月份沿同一条弹簧驱动的带状区域滑动（箭头、PageUp/PageDown、“今天”以及绑定的 `DisplayMonth` 都以相同方向移动），标题随之滑动；选中的圆点在日期之间平滑移动，经过时数字的颜色随之翻转。每个月显示六周，因此高度永不改变。完整的键盘操作：方向键、Home/End、PageUp/PageDown（按住 Shift 为整年）、Enter/空格；被禁用的日期会沿移动方向跳过。

trans-unit.source: Culture for month and weekday names (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 月份与星期名称所用的区域文化（null 表示当前 UI 文化）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user picks a day (click, Enter / Space, or Today).
trans-unit.target: 用户选择某一天时引发（点击、Enter / 空格，或“今天”）。

trans-unit.source: Extra disabled days (weekends, booked dates...).
trans-unit.target: 额外禁用的日期（周末、已被预订的日期等）。

trans-unit.source: Any date in the displayed month (normalized to its first day). Defaults to the selection's month, else today's.
trans-unit.target: 显示月份中的任意日期（会规范化为该月第一天）。默认为所选日期所在的月份，否则为今天所在的月份。

trans-unit.source: The first day of each week row (default Sunday).
trans-unit.target: 每一周行的第一天（默认为星期日）。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable date; later days are disabled. Null means no upper limit.
trans-unit.target: 可选择的最晚日期；之后的日期会被停用。null 表示没有上限。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable date; earlier days are disabled. Null means no lower limit.
trans-unit.target: 可选择的最早日期；之前的日期会被停用。null 表示没有下限。

trans-unit.source: Label of the next-month button (default "Next month").
trans-unit.target: 下个月按钮的标签（默认 “下个月”）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the previous-month button (default "Previous month").
trans-unit.target: 上个月按钮的标签（默认 “上个月”）。

trans-unit.source: The selected date, or null when nothing is selected. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 选中的日期；未选中时为 null。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Adds a Today button that slides back to the current month and selects today when it is available.
trans-unit.target: 添加一个“今天”按钮：点击后平滑回到当前月份，并在可用时选中今天。

trans-unit.source: Text of the Today button (default "Today").
trans-unit.target: 今天按钮的文字（默认 “今天”）。

trans-unit.source: A considerate cancellation flow in one card: it asks why, offers an alternative that fits the reason, shows what ends and when, and asks the person to hold a button to confirm; the last step thanks them or lets them reactivate. A step bar on top shows where they are. Steps slide in the direction of travel while the card's height follows on a spring; each step's controls are built once and reused. Enter runs the step's main action, Alt+Left goes back, and focus moves to the new step's title after every change.
trans-unit.target: 一张卡片内的体贴取消流程：先询问原因，提供与该原因相符的挽留方案，说明哪些内容何时终止，并要求用户按住按钮确认；最后一步会感谢用户，或允许其重新激活。顶部的步骤栏显示当前位置。步骤沿前进方向滑入，卡片高度通过弹簧动效跟随变化；每个步骤的控件只构建一次并重复使用。按 Enter 执行当前步骤的主要操作，Alt+Left 返回上一步，每次变更后焦点都会移至新步骤的标题。

trans-unit.source: The last day of paid access after canceling (usually the renewal date); null when access ends at once.
trans-unit.target: 取消后可继续使用付费权限的最后一天（通常为续订日期）；为 null 时表示立即结束访问。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) draws the flow's own frame; Plain drops it for a flow inside a dialog or another card.
trans-unit.target: Card（默认）绘制流程自身的边框；Plain 则去掉边框，用于对话框或其他卡片内的流程。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the hold to cancel completes (the flow moves to Canceled), with the reason and the feedback.
trans-unit.target: 按住取消操作完成时引发（流程转为 Canceled），附带原因和反馈。

trans-unit.source: The offer for reasons without one of their own; null skips the offer step for them.
trans-unit.target: 供没有专属方案的原因使用的挽留方案；为 null 时，这些原因将跳过挽留方案步骤。

trans-unit.source: What the person wrote in the optional feedback field (two-way); null when empty.
trans-unit.target: 用户在可选反馈栏中填写的内容（双向绑定）；为空时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Keep my plan" and by "Done" after an accepted offer: the person is staying, so close the flow.
trans-unit.target: 由“保留我的套餐”以及接受挽留方案后的“完成”引发：用户选择留下，因此应关闭流程。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text and date culture; replace the whole object to localize the flow.
trans-unit.target: 内置文本和日期区域设置；替换整个对象即可本地化该流程。

trans-unit.source: What ends with the plan, listed on the confirmation step (for example "Shared projects become read-only").
trans-unit.target: 随套餐一同终止的内容，列在确认步骤中（例如“共享项目变为只读”）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person accepts the offer (the flow moves to Retained), with the reason and the offer.
trans-unit.target: 用户接受挽留方案时引发（流程转为 Retained），附带原因和该方案。

trans-unit.source: The plan's name as people know it, such as "Studio"; used in the titles and sentences.
trans-unit.target: 套餐的名称，即用户所熟知的叫法，例如“Studio”；用于标题和句子中。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Reactivate plan" on the canceled step. Unless a handler marks it handled, the flow then calls `Reset`.
trans-unit.target: 在已取消步骤中按下“重新激活套餐”时引发。除非处理程序将其标记为已处理，否则流程随后调用 `Reset`。

trans-unit.source: The reasons to choose from, written inline or bound. Empty (the default) uses the five reasons in `DefaultReasons`.
trans-unit.target: 可供选择的原因，可直接写入或绑定。为空（默认值）时使用 `DefaultReasons` 中的五个原因。

trans-unit.source: The chosen reason (two-way); Continue is disabled while it is null.
trans-unit.target: 所选原因（双向绑定）；为 null 时“继续”按钮不可用。

trans-unit.source: The step on screen: Reason, Offer, Confirm, Canceled or Retained. Changes through the flow's buttons, `GoBack` and `Reset`.
trans-unit.target: 当前显示的步骤：Reason、Offer、Confirm、Canceled 或 Retained。通过流程中的按钮、`GoBack` 和 `Reset` 更改。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the step changes, with the old and the new step.
trans-unit.target: 步骤变化后引发，附带旧步骤和新步骤。

trans-unit.source: Arc card: a contained group of related content and actions for browsable grid items (projects, listings, posts), with optional media, an owner byline and a status line that updates in place. A pointed-at card lifts 2px on a snappy spring while its border and shadow deepen and the media drifts to 1.04 (mouse only). Set `Details` and the title becomes a button and the whole card a trigger: the card grows into a larger quick look without leaving the page (P8): its surface, media, title, description, byline and action fly into a `DialogSurface` on the overlay layer on one critically damped spring (0.3s; 0.26s back) while the corners morph, the details rise in after 120ms and the page dims behind a 7px backdrop blur. Escape, the scrim or the close button send it back into the card and return focus to the title. Reduced motion fades the quick look instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 卡片：用于可浏览的网格项目（项目、房源、帖子）的一组相关内容与操作，可选包含媒体、所有者署名以及会原地更新的状态行。指针悬停时，卡片以轻快的弹簧上浮 2px，边框与阴影加深，媒体缓慢放大至 1.04（仅限鼠标）。设置 `Details` 后，标题变为按钮，整张卡片变为触发器：卡片会扩展为更大的快速预览而不离开页面（P8）：其表面、媒体、标题、描述、署名与操作会以临界阻尼弹簧（0.3 秒；收回为 0.26 秒）飞入覆盖层上的 `DialogSurface`，同时圆角变形，细节在 120 毫秒后浮现，页面则在 7px 的背景模糊下变暗。按 Escape、点击遮罩或关闭按钮可使其收回卡片，并将焦点返回标题。减少动效时，快速预览改为淡入淡出。

trans-unit.source: Trailing footer control (a button); stays separately focusable and clickable over the card.
trans-unit.target: 底部尾随的控件（按钮）；在卡片上仍可单独获得焦点并点击。

trans-unit.source: Small leading footer visual, such as the owner's `Avatar` (shown in a 32px circle).
trans-unit.target: 底部前导的小型视觉元素，例如所有者的 `Avatar`（显示在 32px 的圆形中）。

trans-unit.source: Backdrop blur behind the quick look in px (the theme sets Arc's 7; off under ReduceTransparency).
trans-unit.target: 快速预览背后的背景模糊程度，单位为 px（主题设定为 Arc 的 7；在 ReduceTransparency 下关闭）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the quick look's close button.
trans-unit.target: 快速预览关闭按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Supporting line under the title (at most 34 characters per line).
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的辅助文字（每行最多 34 个字符）。

trans-unit.source: Quick look content. When set, the whole card opens and grows into a larger view.
trans-unit.target: 快速预览的内容。设置后，整张卡片会打开并扩展为更大的视图。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the quick look opens or closes (the close motion may still be playing).
trans-unit.target: 快速预览打开或关闭时引发（关闭动效可能仍在播放）。

trans-unit.source: Quick look open state (Arc open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange). Two-way; ignored without `Details`.
trans-unit.target: 快速预览的打开状态（Arc 中的 open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange）。双向绑定；没有 `Details` 时忽略。

trans-unit.source: Image or visual at the top; it drifts in slightly while the card is pointed at.
trans-unit.target: 顶部的图片或视觉元素；指针悬停时会轻微放大。

trans-unit.source: Who the card belongs to, such as the owner's name.
trans-unit.target: 卡片所属的对象，例如所有者的名称。

trans-unit.source: Scrim behind the quick look (the theme sets Arc's oklch(10% 0 0 / 0.46)).
trans-unit.target: 快速预览背后的遮罩（主题设定为 Arc 的 oklch(10% 0 0 / 0.46)）。

trans-unit.source: A short status under the meta ("Updated 2 hours ago"); new words rise in and are announced politely.
trans-unit.target: 位于 meta 下方的简短状态（“2 小时前更新”）；新文字会上浮出现，并以礼貌方式播报。

trans-unit.source: Heading (required). Becomes the quick look trigger when `Details` is set.
trans-unit.target: 标题（必填）。设置 `Details` 后，标题会成为快速预览的触发器。

trans-unit.source: A deck of cards reviewed one at a time (Arc card stack): drag or flick the top card left or right, or use the buttons and arrow keys. Use it for quick, one-by-one triage where each item deserves a moment of attention: shortlisting destinations, candidates or design options. The top card tilts with the drag and shows a stamp; a flick or a long enough drag throws it out with the release velocity, the cards behind rise into place, Undo flies the last card back from where it left, and Start over deals the deck back. Only the top four cards (and cards still in flight) are realized, however long the stack. Keyboard on the focused stage: ← / → decide, Backspace or Ctrl / Cmd + Z undo. Decisions, undo and reset are announced politely. Items come from `Items` / `ItemsSource` with `ItemTemplate`; changing the items starts the stack over.
trans-unit.target: 一叠逐张审阅的卡片（Arc 卡片堆叠）：拖动或轻扫顶部卡片向左或向右，也可使用按钮与方向键。适用于需要逐个细看的快速筛选，例如候选目的地、候选人或设计方案的初选。顶部卡片会随拖动倾斜并显示印章；轻扫或足够长的拖动会以松开时的速度将其甩出，后面的卡片上升就位；“撤销”会将上一张卡片从离开的位置飞回；“重新开始”会把整叠卡片重新发牌。无论堆叠多深，只会实例化顶部四张卡片（以及仍在飞行中的卡片）。焦点位于舞台上时的键盘操作：← / → 作出决定，Backspace 或 Ctrl / Cmd + Z 撤销。决定、撤销与重置均以礼貌方式播报。项目来自 `Items` / `ItemsSource`，并配合 `ItemTemplate`；更改项目会使卡片堆重新开始。

trans-unit.source: True when there is a decision to undo.
trans-unit.target: 存在可撤销的决定时为 true。

trans-unit.source: Index of the top card (equals the item count once every card is decided).
trans-unit.target: 顶部卡片的索引（所有卡片都已决定后等于项目总数）。

trans-unit.source: A card was decided (by drag, key, button or `Decide`).
trans-unit.target: 某张卡片已被决定（通过拖动、按键、按钮或 `Decide`）。

trans-unit.source: The last decision was undone; the card is back on top.
trans-unit.target: 上一个决定已被撤销；该卡片回到顶部。

trans-unit.source: Shown once every card has been decided, instead of "All cards reviewed" and Start over.
trans-unit.target: 所有卡片都已决定后显示，代替“所有卡片已审阅”和“重新开始”。

trans-unit.source: Data template that builds the empty-state content; used when `EmptyContent` is not set.
trans-unit.target: 用于构建空状态内容的数据模板；未设置 `EmptyContent` 时使用。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the stack (default "Cards").
trans-unit.target: 卡片堆的无障碍名称（默认为“Cards”）。

trans-unit.source: A short name for a card, used in its accessible label and in announcements ("Lisbon"). Defaults to the item's text (a string, a control's automation name, or `ToString()`).
trans-unit.target: 卡片的简短名称，用于其无障碍标签与播报（例如“Lisbon”）。默认为项目的文本（字符串、控件的自动化名称或 `ToString()`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the left action, on its button and on the stamp while dragging left (default "Pass").
trans-unit.target: 左侧操作的名称，显示在其按钮上，以及拖向左侧时的印章上（默认为“Pass”）。

trans-unit.source: Past tense of the left action for announcements, such as "skipped". Without it: "Lisbon: Pass."
trans-unit.target: 用于播报的左侧操作过去时形式，例如“skipped”。未设置时为：“Lisbon: Pass.”

trans-unit.source: Brings every card back (for custom empty content: `Command="{Binding $parent[arc:CardStack].ResetCommand}"`).
trans-unit.target: 将所有卡片全部恢复（用于自定义空内容：`Command="{Binding $parent[arc:CardStack].ResetCommand}"`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the right action (default "Keep").
trans-unit.target: 右侧操作的名称（默认为“Keep”）。

trans-unit.source: Past tense of the right action for announcements, such as "shortlisted".
trans-unit.target: 用于播报的右侧操作过去时形式，例如“shortlisted”。

trans-unit.source: All cards were brought back.
trans-unit.target: 所有卡片已全部恢复。

trans-unit.source: A row of slides people browse by dragging, flicking, a trackpad swipe, the arrow keys, or the controls below it (Arc carousel). Use it for a short, ordered set of peers such as products or case studies, where the neighbours stay in view as a hint that there is more. The active slide sits in the center, its neighbours shrink and dim with distance, and the page indicator stretches into a pill that travels with the slides frame by frame. Slides come from `Items` / `ItemsSource` (with `ItemTemplate`); `SelectedIndex` is the active slide (two-way). Set `Interval` to add a play control that rotates through the slides; rotation pauses on hover, keyboard focus, drag, while the carousel is scrolled out of view or the window is minimized, and is unavailable with reduced motion. Only the slides near the current position are realized.
trans-unit.target: 一排幻灯片，用户可通过拖动、轻扫、触控板滑动、方向键或其下方的控件进行浏览（Arc 轮播）。适用于一组简短、有序的同类内容，例如产品或案例研究，相邻项目保持可见，以提示还有更多内容。当前幻灯片位于中央，相邻幻灯片会随距离缩小并变暗，页面指示器会拉伸成一个胶囊，并随幻灯片逐帧移动。幻灯片来自 `Items` / `ItemsSource`（配合 `ItemTemplate`）；`SelectedIndex` 为当前幻灯片（双向绑定）。设置 `Interval` 可添加一个播放控件，使幻灯片循环轮换；指针悬停、键盘焦点、拖动、轮播滚出视野或窗口最小化时轮换会暂停，减少动效时则不可用。只有当前位置附近的幻灯片会被实例化。

trans-unit.source: True when rotation is available (an interval, two or more slides, full motion).
trans-unit.target: 可以轮换时为 true（需要有间隔时间、两张或更多幻灯片，且为完整动效）。

trans-unit.source: Time per slide. A positive value adds a play control that rotates through the slides.
trans-unit.target: 每张幻灯片的停留时间。正值会添加一个播放控件，使幻灯片循环轮换。

trans-unit.source: Whether the slides rotate (two-way; the play control toggles it). Off by default, so motion begins with the viewer; set it to start rotating on load.
trans-unit.target: 幻灯片是否轮换（双向绑定；播放控件会切换此值）。默认关闭，使动效由用户开始；若希望加载后即开始轮换，请将其设为 true。

trans-unit.source: True while the rotation timer is actually running (playing and not paused).
trans-unit.target: 轮换计时器确实在运行（正在播放且未暂停）时为 true。

trans-unit.source: Names the carousel for assistive technology, for example "From the Harbour suites".
trans-unit.target: 为辅助技术命名该轮播，例如“From the Harbour suites”。

trans-unit.source: Largest slide width in px (340).
trans-unit.target: 幻灯片的最大宽度，单位为 px（340）。

trans-unit.source: Gap between slides in px (16).
trans-unit.target: 幻灯片之间的间距，单位为 px（16）。

trans-unit.source: Names each slide and its indicator; defaults to "2 of 5".
trans-unit.target: 为每张幻灯片及其指示器命名；默认为“2 of 5”。

trans-unit.source: Share of the carousel width one slide takes (Arc default `min(80cqw, 340px)`: 0.8).
trans-unit.target: 单张幻灯片占轮播宽度的比例（Arc 默认 `min(80cqw, 340px)`：0.8）。

trans-unit.source: The point being read (crosshair, scrubbed bar, hovered segment), or null at rest. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 正在读取的数据点（十字准线、被拖动的柱子、悬停的分段），静止时为 null。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Raised as the readout moves between points, and with a null index when it is released.
trans-unit.target: 读数在各数据点之间移动时引发；释放时以 null 索引引发。

trans-unit.source: The latest polite announcement (what Arc's live region reads), such as "Loading".
trans-unit.target: 最新的礼貌播报内容（即 Arc 实时区域所朗读的文字），例如“Loading”。

trans-unit.source: Name of the category column in the data table and the explore label, such as "Date".
trans-unit.target: 数据表中类别列的名称以及探索标签，例如“Date”。

trans-unit.source: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
trans-unit.target: 平滑的单调曲线（永不超出数据范围），或直线段。

trans-unit.source: The accessible data table as text: a header line, then one line per row (tab separated).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式呈现的无障碍数据表：一行表头，然后每行数据一行（以制表符分隔）。

trans-unit.source: Shown when there is nothing to draw.
trans-unit.target: 没有可绘制内容时显示。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden series. Two-way; the legend toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 已隐藏系列的键。双向绑定；图例会切换此值。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series.
trans-unit.target: 图例显示或隐藏某个系列时引发。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the current shapes on screen, dimmed and breathing, while the next range loads.
trans-unit.target: 在加载下一个范围期间，保持当前图形在屏幕上，并以变暗与呼吸式的动效呈现。

trans-unit.source: The data items. Values are read with `YSelector`/`YBinding` (or per series), categories with `XSelector`/`XBinding`.
trans-unit.target: 数据项。数值通过 `YSelector`/`YBinding`（或按系列）读取，类别通过 `XSelector`/`XBinding` 读取。

trans-unit.source: What is measured, such as "Signups". Names the chart, its summary and its data table.
trans-unit.target: 所度量的内容，例如“Signups”。用于命名图表、其摘要和数据表。

trans-unit.source: Plot height in pixels; the width follows the container.
trans-unit.target: 绘图区的高度，单位为像素；宽度随容器变化。

trans-unit.source: Horizontal gridlines at the value ticks.
trans-unit.target: 在数值刻度处显示水平网格线。

trans-unit.source: Series toggles. Null shows the legend when there is more than one series.
trans-unit.target: 系列切换开关。为 null 时，若有多个系列则显示图例。

trans-unit.source: The category (time) axis labels under the plot.
trans-unit.target: 绘图区下方的类别（时间）轴标签。

trans-unit.source: The value axis labels in the right-hand gutter.
trans-unit.target: 右侧边距中的数值轴标签。

trans-unit.source: A one-paragraph description for assistive technology, such as "Signups, Sep 1 to Sep 30. ...".

trans-unit.source: Reads each item's value for a single-series chart.
trans-unit.target: 为单系列图表读取每个项目的数值。

trans-unit.source: A message (Arc `ChatMessage`). Update `Text`, `Status`, `Reactions` or `Attachments` in place and the thread follows (the message raises `PropertyChanged`).
trans-unit.target: 一条消息（Arc `ChatMessage`）。原地更新 `Text`、`Status`、`Reactions` 或 `Attachments`，会话随之更新（消息会引发 `PropertyChanged`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a property changes.
trans-unit.target: 属性改变时引发。

trans-unit.source: A chat or support thread (Arc `ChatThread`): messages grouped by person and time with day separators, reactions, read receipts that glide to the latest read message, a typing indicator and a composer with attachments. The list stays pinned to the newest message and offers a pill when new messages land out of view.
trans-unit.target: 聊天或支持会话（Arc `ChatThread`）：消息按人员与时间分组，并带有日期分隔、表情回应、已读回执（平滑移动到最新的已读消息）、输入中提示，以及带附件的编辑区。列表始终固定在最新消息处；当有新消息落在可视范围之外时，会显示一个提示胶囊。

trans-unit.source: File types the attach button offers (Arc `accept`); null offers everything.

trans-unit.source: Formatting culture of times and day separators (Arc `locale`); null uses en-US.
trans-unit.target: 时间与日期分隔所用的格式化区域文化（Arc `locale`）；为 null 时使用 en-US。

trans-unit.source: The current user (Arc `currentUserId`): their messages sit on the right in the accent color.
trans-unit.target: 当前用户（Arc `currentUserId`）：其消息以强调色显示在右侧。

trans-unit.source: Messages from one person closer together than this share a group (Arc `groupWindow`, 5 minutes).
trans-unit.target: 同一人员在此时间间隔内发送的消息归为一组（Arc `groupWindow`，5 分钟）。

trans-unit.source: Lets the composer take files by button, paste or drop (Arc `allowAttachments`, default true).
trans-unit.target: 允许编辑区通过按钮、粘贴或拖放接收文件（Arc `allowAttachments`，默认为 true）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the composer (Arc `composer`, default true).
trans-unit.target: 显示编辑区（Arc `composer`，默认为 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list follows the newest message (the reader is within 48px of the end).
trans-unit.target: 列表是否跟随最新消息（阅读者距离末尾在 48px 以内）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the message log (Arc `label`, "Conversation").

trans-unit.source: Every word the thread shows or announces (Arc `labels`).

trans-unit.source: StreamMark services for Markdown bodies; null uses `DefaultMarkdownServices`.
trans-unit.target: 用于 Markdown 正文的 StreamMark 服务；为 null 时使用 `DefaultMarkdownServices`。

trans-unit.source: How message text renders unless a message sets `Format` (default Markdown).
trans-unit.target: 除非消息设置了 `Format`，否则消息文本的渲染方式（默认为 Markdown）。

trans-unit.source: The people in the conversation (Arc `participants`).
trans-unit.target: 会话中的参与者（Arc `participants`）。

trans-unit.source: The composer's placeholder and accessible name ("Message").
trans-unit.target: 输入框的占位文字，也是其无障碍名称（“Message”）。

trans-unit.source: A reaction was picked or a chip clicked (Arc `onReact`). Without an ItemsSource the thread also toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 选中了一个表情回应或点击了一个回应标签（Arc `onReact`）。没有设置 ItemsSource 时，会话也会切换该回应。

trans-unit.source: Emoji offered by the reaction picker (Arc default 👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 👀 🙏).
trans-unit.target: 表情回应选择器提供的表情（Arc 默认 👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 👀 🙏）。

trans-unit.source: Invoked with the failed `ChatMessage` when Retry is clicked; Retry shows when this or a handler is set.

trans-unit.target: 点击了你最后一条失败消息的重试（Arc `onRetry`）。

trans-unit.source: Your message from the composer (Arc `onSend`). Without an ItemsSource the thread also appends it.
trans-unit.target: 来自输入框的你的消息（Arc `onSend`）。没有设置 ItemsSource 时，会话也会将其追加进去。

trans-unit.source: Time zone of times and day separators; null uses the local zone (as Arc's browser does).

trans-unit.source: Messages from other people that arrived while the reader was scrolled up.
trans-unit.target: 阅读者向上滚动时，其他人发来的消息数量。

trans-unit.source: Arc checkbox: a binary choice with a precise, legible state. The fill grows in on a snappy spring, the check draws itself, and the indeterminate state morphs the same three-point path into a dash and back. Only the 18px square answers a press (it dips to 0.95); the 44px hit area and the label never move. Clicking an indeterminate box checks it (Radix behavior). `IsChecked` is the tri-state value (null = indeterminate); `CheckedState` is the same value as an enum.
trans-unit.target: Arc 复选框：二元选择，状态精确且清晰。选中框以轻快的弹簧效果填充，勾号自行绘出，半选状态会将同一条三点路径变形为短横线，再变回来。只有 18px 方框响应按压（会下沉至 0.95）；44px 点击区域和标签都不会移动。点击半选框会将其选中（Radix 行为）。`IsChecked` 为三态值（null 表示半选）；`CheckedState` 是同一个值的枚举形式。

trans-unit.source: The tri-state value as an enum; kept in sync with `IsChecked`.
trans-unit.target: 以枚举表示的三态值；与 `IsChecked` 保持同步。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the state changes, with the old and new `CheckboxState`.
trans-unit.target: 状态变化时触发，附带旧的和新的 `CheckboxState`。

trans-unit.source: Secondary text under the label; also the help text read by assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 标签下方的次要文字，同时也是辅助技术朗读的帮助文字。

trans-unit.source: Marks the choice as invalid (the square takes the danger border).
trans-unit.target: 将该选项标记为无效（方框采用危险色边框）。

trans-unit.source: The field must be checked before a form is submitted (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 表单提交前必须勾选此字段（会告知辅助技术）。

trans-unit.source: Arc chip group: toggle chips for facets people switch often (topics, statuses, tags). Picking a chip morphs it: a check grows in, the label slides over and the chip's edge follows on a spring while the neighbours glide to their new places, even across lines. Long sets fold behind a "+N more" chip (selected chips always stay in view); expanding staggers the revealed chips in and the group height springs. With `IsMultiple` false it is a single choice that can still be cleared. Keyboard: one tab stop; arrows move between chips and wrap, Home / End jump to the ends; Enter or Space toggles the focused chip or expands the folded ones.
trans-unit.target: Arc 标签组：用于人们经常切换的筛选项（主题、状态、标签）的可切换标签。选中标签时会变形：勾号生长出来，文字滑动，标签边缘以弹簧跟随，相邻标签滑动到新位置，即使跨行也是如此。项目较多时，会折叠到一个 "+N more" 标签之后（已选中的标签始终可见）；展开时，被显示的标签依次淡入，组的高度以弹簧变化。`IsMultiple` 为 false 时为单选，但仍可清除选择。键盘操作：只有一个 Tab 停留点；方向键在标签之间移动并循环，Home / End 跳到两端；Enter 或空格切换焦点标签，或展开折叠的标签。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsExpanded` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `IsExpanded` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsMultiple` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `IsMultiple` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the group, such as "Topics".
trans-unit.target: 组的无障碍名称，例如“Topics”。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxVisibleItems` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `MaxVisibleItems` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SelectedItems` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `SelectedItems` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Values of the selected options, in option order (Arc keeps `value` in option order).
trans-unit.target: 已选选项的值，按选项顺序排列（Arc 按选项顺序保留 `value`）。

trans-unit.source: Label of a data item (AOT-safe alternative to `DisplayMemberBinding`).
trans-unit.target: 数据项的标签（AOT 安全的 `DisplayMemberBinding` 替代方案）。

trans-unit.source: Value of a data item (AOT-safe alternative to `SelectedValueBinding`).
trans-unit.target: 数据项的值（AOT 安全的 `SelectedValueBinding` 替代方案）。

trans-unit.source: A source viewer with a file-name header, syntax highlighting (TextMate grammars painted in Arc's role palette), a copy action and optional collapsing. Long sources collapse to `MaxLines` lines with a toggle that expands the rest in place on a smooth height spring; new code fades in with a short rise. Long lines scroll horizontally inside the block.
trans-unit.target: 源代码查看器，带文件名标题栏、语法高亮（使用 TextMate 语法，以 Arc 角色调色板着色）、复制操作，以及可选的折叠功能。较长的源代码会折叠到 `MaxLines` 行，点击切换按钮可在原位以平滑的高度弹簧展开其余部分；新代码以短暂的上浮动画淡入。过长的行会在代码块内水平滚动。

trans-unit.source: Source shown in the block and copied by the action.
trans-unit.target: 在代码块中显示并由复制操作复制的源代码。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the copy action put the code on the clipboard.
trans-unit.target: 复制操作将代码放入剪贴板后触发。

trans-unit.source: Label of the copy button in the header (default "Copy code").
trans-unit.target: 标题栏中复制按钮的标签（默认 “复制代码”）。

trans-unit.source: File name in the header; `SourceCodeLabel` when null.
trans-unit.target: 标题栏中的文件名；为 null 时使用 `SourceCodeLabel`。

trans-unit.source: Collapses sources longer than `MaxLines` lines behind a "Show all" toggle (Arc `maxLines`).
trans-unit.target: 超过 `MaxLines` 行的源代码会折叠，并显示“Show all”切换按钮（Arc `maxLines`）。

trans-unit.target: 标题标签与语法高亮所用的语言（Arc 默认 “tsx”）：围栏式的名称或别名，如 `cs`、`ts`、`json`、`xml`/`axaml`、`py`、`sh`。没有 TextMate 语法的语言将显示为纯文本。

trans-unit.source: Shows a line-number gutter (an extension; Arc has none).

trans-unit.source: Arc color field: a swatch whose box grows into the full picker (a clipped reveal on a spring, its shadow following the shape). Pick saturation and brightness on the area, hue and opacity on the sliders, or type a value in hex, RGB, HSL or OKLCH; the format button morphs its label and the value between formats. A contrast readout counts to the WCAG ratio against `ContrastBackground` with its grade, and saved swatches pop in, reorder by drag or Alt + arrows and go with Delete. Arrow keys move every thumb (Shift and Page keys by ten); Escape drops a draft, then closes and returns focus. The eyedropper is not offered: Avalonia has no cross-platform screen color API.
trans-unit.target: Arc 颜色字段：色块的外框会展开为完整的取色器（以弹簧形式裁剪显现，阴影随形状变化）。在面板上选择饱和度与亮度，在滑块上选择色相与不透明度，或以 hex、RGB、HSL 或 OKLCH 输入数值；格式按钮会将标签与数值在各格式之间变形切换。对比度读数会计数到相对于 `ContrastBackground` 的 WCAG 比率并给出等级；已保存的色块会弹出显示，可拖动或按 Alt + 方向键重新排序，按 Delete 删除。方向键移动所有滑块（Shift 与 Page 键以十为单位）；Escape 先丢弃草稿，再关闭并把焦点交还。不提供吸管工具：Avalonia 没有跨平台的屏幕取色 API。

trans-unit.source: Text after the contrast ratio that compares the color with the background (default "against background").
trans-unit.target: 对比度数值之后的文字，用于比较颜色与背景（默认 “against background”）。

trans-unit.source: The color (two-way). Arc's default is #2F6BFF.

trans-unit.source: Shown under the value field for text that is not a color.
trans-unit.target: 数值字段中输入的内容不是颜色时，显示于其下方。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 面板是否打开（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: Name shown on the swatch, such as "Accent" (Arc: "Color").
trans-unit.target: 显示在色块上的名称，例如“Accent”（Arc 为“Color”）。

trans-unit.source: Most saved swatches; saving past it drops the oldest (Arc: 7).

trans-unit.source: Saved swatches, newest first (two-way; every change produces a new list).

trans-unit.source: Arc combobox: a searchable single-choice field. Typing filters the options (label and keywords) and the list springs to its new height; arrow keys move a highlight while focus stays in the field, Enter picks, Escape closes and drops the query. The chosen label settles into the field from below; a clear button pops in while something is selected. Use it for long lists people know by name (time zones, countries).

trans-unit.source: Muted hint under the field.
trans-unit.target: 字段下方的次要提示文字。

trans-unit.source: Returns true for data items that are shown but cannot be picked.

trans-unit.source: Status row when nothing matches (Arc: "No matches found").
trans-unit.target: 没有匹配项时显示的状态行（Arc 为“No matches found”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list is open (two-way).

trans-unit.source: Visible label above the field; also names the field and its list.

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SearchText` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `SearchText` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Label of the selected option, or null.
trans-unit.target: 所选选项的标签；无选中项时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Label of a data item (AOT-safe alternative to `DisplayMemberBinding`).
trans-unit.target: 数据项的标签（AOT 安全的 `DisplayMemberBinding` 替代方案）。

trans-unit.source: Arc command palette: the keyboard entry point to product-wide actions and navigation. A search field over grouped results with icons, descriptions and shortcut caps. Typing filters the commands (label, description, group and keywords); ↓ / ↑ / Home / End move one shared highlight (a 70ms slide for keys, a snappy spring for the pointer), Enter runs the highlighted command (or, after typing, the top match), Escape clears the query and then raises `CloseRequested`. Cmd/Ctrl+K anywhere in the window focuses the field. While filtering, the remaining rows glide into place and the results frame springs to the new height. Ported from Arc's free command-palette block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: Arc 命令面板：用键盘进入产品级操作与导航的入口。搜索框下方是带图标、描述和快捷键提示的分组结果。输入内容会筛选命令（按名称、描述、分组和关键词）；↓ / ↑ / Home / End 在同一个共享高亮之间移动（键盘移动为 70ms 滑动，指针移动为灵敏的弹簧动画），Enter 执行高亮的命令（输入后则执行排在最前的匹配项），Escape 先清空查询，再触发 `CloseRequested`。窗口内任意位置按 Cmd/Ctrl+K 均可聚焦搜索框。筛选时，其余行会滑动到新位置，结果框会以弹簧动画调整到新高度。移植自 Arc 免费的命令面板模块（MIT 许可，版权所有 (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: A threaded discussion (Arc's Comment thread): replies nest under their comment and collapse, reactions toggle with a count that rolls, authors edit and delete their own comments in place, mentions autocomplete in the composer, and resolving folds the whole thread into a single chip that reopens it. Use it for review discussions on documents, designs, tickets or pull requests; use `MentionInput` when only the input is needed.

trans-unit.source: A button for destructive or important actions that asks in place: pressing it morphs the same pill into an inline question with Cancel and Confirm, then into a spinner, then into a result with Undo. Only the pill's width moves (growing on the morph spring, shrinking on smooth, P5 / P9); each face sits at its natural width and its parts clear a small blur in reading order (P20) while the old face fades (P2). Unanswered questions and results time out on a pausable timer (P22, held while the pointer rests on the control), Escape and an outside press return it to rest, and focus follows the morph. Answer with a press, a hold, or a press followed by a short countdown.
trans-unit.target: 用于破坏性或重要操作的按钮，会就地询问：按下后，同一个胶囊会变形为带“取消”和“确认”的内联问题，然后变为加载指示器，再变为带“撤销”的结果。只有胶囊的宽度会变化（展开时使用变形弹簧，收缩时使用平滑动画，P5 / P9）；每个界面都保持自然宽度，其各部分按阅读顺序清除小幅模糊（P20），旧界面同时淡出（P2）。未作答的问题与结果会在可暂停的计时器上超时（P22，指针停留在控件上时暂停），Escape 键与外部按压会使其回到静止状态，焦点随变形移动。可以一次按压、一次长按，或按压后接一段短倒计时来作答。

trans-unit.source: Secondary actions kept close to the selected object (Arc context menu). Wraps its `Content` and opens a menu at the pointer on right-click, or under the target (12px in, 8px below) on a plain click, a tap, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10. The menu grows from the pointer on a snappy spring, rows press with a tint, and it closes on any scroll, resize or outside press instead of repositioning. Avoid it on targets that need their own click. To give any control a right-click menu without wrapping it, attach a surface: `<Border><arc:ContextMenu.Menu><arc:MenuSurface>…</arc:MenuSurface></arc:ContextMenu.Menu></Border>`.
trans-unit.target: 靠近所选对象的次要操作（Arc 上下文菜单）。包裹其 `Content`，在右键时于指针处打开菜单，或在普通点击、轻触、ContextMenu 键或 Shift+F10 时在目标下方（向内 12px、向下 8px）打开。菜单以轻快的弹簧从指针处展开，菜单项按下时会着色，滚动、调整大小或外部按压时会关闭而不是重新定位。避免用于本身需要单击功能的目标。若要让任意控件拥有右键菜单而无需包裹，可附加一个表面：`<Border><arc:ContextMenu.Menu><arc:MenuSurface>…</arc:MenuSurface></arc:ContextMenu.Menu></Border>`。

trans-unit.source: One group of cookies a visitor can allow or refuse.
trans-unit.target: 访客可以允许或拒绝的一组 Cookie。

trans-unit.source: Arc cookie consent: a consent bar that morphs into a preferences panel and, once a choice is saved, folds into a small floating button that reopens it. One surface springs between the three shapes. Optional categories start off, refusing is as easy as accepting, and the choice is reported through `ConsentChanged` and can be remembered (`StorageKey`, read back with `Read`). The control is a layer: place it over the page (for example as the last child of the window's root grid, or of a preview panel); it lets clicks through everywhere except on its surface, which hangs 16px from the bottom.
trans-unit.target: Arc Cookie 同意组件：一个同意条，可变形为偏好设置面板；保存选择后，会收缩为一个小的浮动按钮，用于重新打开面板。同一个表面在三种形态之间以弹簧动画切换。可选类别默认关闭，拒绝与接受同样简单；选择结果通过 `ConsentChanged` 报告，并可被记住（`StorageKey`，用 `Read` 读回）。该控件是一个覆盖层：将其放在页面之上（例如作为窗口根 Grid 或预览面板的最后一个子元素）；除表面本身外，点击都会穿透该控件，表面距底部 16px。

trans-unit.source: Copies a value with immediate, in-place confirmation: the icon swaps to a hand-drawn check, the label morphs to "Copied", and everything returns to idle after 1.9s. The label cell reserves its widest state so the button never changes width.

trans-unit.source: Label of the button in its idle state (default "Copy").
trans-unit.target: 按钮空闲状态下的标签（默认 “复制”）。

trans-unit.source: Time the button keeps the copied or error state before it returns to idle (default 1.9 seconds).
trans-unit.target: 按钮保持“已复制”或错误状态的时长，之后恢复为空闲（默认 1.9 秒）。

trans-unit.source: Current copy state: Idle, Copied or Error (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 当前复制状态：Idle、Copied 或 Error（只读）。

trans-unit.source: Text copied to the clipboard when the button is clicked.
trans-unit.target: 点击按钮时复制到剪贴板的文本。

trans-unit.source: Visual style: Outline (default) or Plain.
trans-unit.target: 视觉样式：Outline（默认）或 Plain。

trans-unit.source: Counts down to a fixed moment, or through a duration, with rolling digit wheels (Arc Countdown), and morphs into a live label at zero. The clock ticks just after each whole second, only while the countdown is on screen; a separate `PausableTimer` makes `Completed` land on time even while ticking is paused. A `Duration` countdown can be paused and resumed (`IsPaused`, `Pause`, `Resume`); a `Target` countdown counts to a fixed instant, so pausing only freezes the display. Wheels turn the short way round; the shell springs to the size of whatever it holds.
trans-unit.target: 倒计时至一个固定时刻，或在一段时长内倒数，以滚动数字轮显示（Arc Countdown），归零时变形为实时标签。时钟仅在倒计时显示于屏幕上时，于每个整秒之后稍后滴答；单独的 `PausableTimer` 使 `Completed` 即使在暂停滴答时也能准时触发。`Duration` 倒计时可暂停和恢复（`IsPaused`、`Pause`、`Resume`）；`Target` 倒计时则倒数至一个固定时刻，因此暂停只会冻结显示。数字轮沿最短路径转动；外壳会弹簧式地调整为所容纳内容的尺寸。

trans-unit.source: Shown once the countdown reaches zero, beside a pulsing live dot (Arc `completeLabel`, "Live now").
trans-unit.target: 倒计时归零后显示，位于脉动的实时圆点旁（Arc `completeLabel`，“Live now”）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once, the moment the countdown reaches zero while it is shown.
trans-unit.target: 在倒计时显示期间刚好归零的那一刻引发，仅引发一次。

trans-unit.source: Counts down this long from when the countdown is shown (or restarted); pausable.
trans-unit.target: 从倒计时显示（或重新开始）时起倒数这么长时间；可暂停。

trans-unit.source: True once the countdown has reached zero.
trans-unit.target: 倒计时一旦归零即为 true。

trans-unit.source: Pauses a duration countdown (remaining time is kept); freezes the display of a target countdown.
trans-unit.target: 暂停时长倒计时（保留剩余时间）；冻结目标倒计时的显示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name (Arc `label`, "Time remaining").
trans-unit.target: 无障碍名称（Arc `label`，“Time remaining”）。

trans-unit.source: Time left, read from the clock on every tick.
trans-unit.target: 剩余时间，每次滴答时从时钟读取。

trans-unit.source: The moment to count down to. Takes precedence over `Duration`.
trans-unit.target: 倒数至的时刻。优先于 `Duration`。

trans-unit.source: Clock source; pass a server-synced provider when device time cannot be trusted.
trans-unit.target: 时钟来源；当设备时间不可信时，传入与服务器同步的提供程序。

trans-unit.source: Units to show, largest first; the largest absorbs the rest. Defaults to days through seconds.
trans-unit.target: 要显示的单位，从大到小排列；最大的单位吸收其余部分。默认为天至秒。

trans-unit.source: Large display digits with unit names (default) or one compact pill.
trans-unit.target: 带单位名称的大号显示数字（默认），或紧凑的单个胶囊。

trans-unit.source: An animated data pipeline: events leave their sources, queue up in an event stream, are validated and enriched in batches (some are filtered out) and land in a warehouse, with part of them pushed to live dashboards. Readouts show throughput and what has been stored.
trans-unit.target: 动画数据管道：事件从各来源发出，在事件流中排队，分批验证和丰富（部分事件会被过滤掉），最终存入数据仓库，其中一部分会推送到实时仪表板。读数显示吞吐量及已存储的数量。

trans-unit.source: How many events per second the sources emit (1–60).
trans-unit.target: 来源每秒发出的事件数（1–60）。

trans-unit.source: Share of events the transform filters out (0–0.5).
trans-unit.target: 转换步骤过滤掉的事件比例（0–0.5）。

trans-unit.source: Node titles, details and caption text of the diagram; set it to rename or translate the scene.
trans-unit.target: 图示的节点标题、详情和说明文字；设置此项即可重命名或翻译场景。

trans-unit.source: The event sources (1–4); defaults to a web app, a mobile app and webhooks.
trans-unit.target: 事件来源（1–4）；默认为网页应用、移动应用和 Webhook。

trans-unit.source: Every visible word of a `DataFlow` (override for another language or domain).
trans-unit.target: `DataFlow` 中所有可见的文字（可覆盖，以用于其他语言或领域）。

trans-unit.source: A spreadsheet grid for editing tabular data in place: range selection, a fill handle, Excel and Google Sheets clipboard, undo, multi-column sort, a filter row and quick search, pinned and hidden columns, row checks with bulk actions, a totals row, grouping with subtotals, CSV and Excel export, and rows and columns that render only while in view. Every piece of view state (sort, filters, search, checked rows, hidden and pinned columns, density, grouping) is a two-way property, so it works bound or left to the grid. Rows come from `ItemsSource` (`DataGridRow` objects or any class read through column bindings or accessors), or block by block from a `DataSource`. Edits write back into the row items and raise `CellsChanged`; editing never re-sorts or re-filters, so rows never jump under the cursor.
trans-unit.target: 就地编辑表格数据的电子表格式表格：范围选择、填充柄、与 Excel 和 Google Sheets 互通的剪贴板、撤销、多列排序、筛选行和快速搜索、固定与隐藏列、行勾选与批量操作、合计行、分组小计、CSV 与 Excel 导出，行和列只在可见时渲染。所有视图状态（排序、筛选、搜索、勾选行、隐藏和固定的列、行密度、分组）都是双向属性，既可以绑定，也可以交给表格自己管理。行来自 `ItemsSource`（`DataGridRow` 对象，或通过列的绑定或访问器读取的任意类），或者通过 `DataSource` 按块加载。编辑会写回行对象并触发 `CellsChanged`；编辑不会重新排序或筛选，行不会在光标下跳走。

trans-unit.source: The active cell (display row and visible column), or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 活动单元格（显示行号与可见列序号）；表格没有单元格时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a bulk action is clicked (its command runs too).
trans-unit.target: 点击批量操作时触发（它的命令也会执行）。

trans-unit.source: Shows Delete for checked rows; deleting can be undone.
trans-unit.target: 为勾选的行显示“删除”；删除可以撤销。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to redo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可重做的步骤。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to undo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可撤销的步骤。

trans-unit.source: Raised before an edit is written; cancel it to keep the editor open with an error.
trans-unit.target: 编辑写入前触发；取消它可让编辑器保持打开并显示错误。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an edit, paste, cut, clear, fill, fill down, undo or redo wrote cells.
trans-unit.target: 编辑、粘贴、剪切、清空、填充、向下填充、撤销或重做写入单元格后触发。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the checked rows, in data order (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 勾选行的键，按数据顺序（双向）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for formatting and parsing values; null follows the AtomUI language.
trans-unit.target: 格式化和解析值所用的文化；为 null 时跟随 AtomUI 的语言。

trans-unit.source: Loads rows from a server one block at a time as people scroll, instead of `ItemsSource`. The grid is then read only, does not group, hides Select all and exports only checked rows.
trans-unit.target: 代替 `ItemsSource`，在滚动时从服务器按块加载行。此时表格只读、不分组、隐藏全选，并且只导出勾选行。

trans-unit.source: Row density (two-way): Compact 32px, Standard 40px or Comfortable 48px rows.
trans-unit.target: 行密度（双向）：Compact 32px、Standard 40px 或 Comfortable 48px。

trans-unit.source: Shown when there are no rows at all; null uses the built-in "No rows yet".
trans-unit.target: 完全没有行时显示的文字；为 null 时使用内置的“暂无数据”。

trans-unit.source: Export file name without the extension; null derives one from `Label`.
trans-unit.target: 导出文件名（不含扩展名）；为 null 时由 `Label` 生成。

trans-unit.source: Formats Export offers; with more than one, Export opens a menu.
trans-unit.target: “导出”提供的格式；多于一种时，“导出”会打开菜单。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the save dialog of an export opens.
trans-unit.target: 导出的保存对话框打开前触发。

trans-unit.source: Column filters by column key (two-way). The filter row opens when any filter is set at start.
trans-unit.target: 按列键的列筛选（双向）。开始时设置了任何筛选，筛选行就会展开。

trans-unit.source: Group-by column keys, outermost first (two-way). Group rows show a toggle, the value, a count and subtotals.
trans-unit.target: 分组列键，外层在前（双向）。分组行显示折叠按钮、分组值、行数和小计。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the hidden columns (two-way); null uses each column's `IsHidden`.
trans-unit.target: 隐藏列的键（双向）；为 null 时使用各列的 `IsHidden`。

trans-unit.source: Whether a cell editor is open.
trans-unit.target: 单元格编辑器是否打开。

trans-unit.source: Whether the filter row is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 筛选行是否展开（双向）。

trans-unit.source: Shows six placeholder rows while data loads.
trans-unit.target: 数据加载时显示六行占位行。

trans-unit.source: Shows the row gutter with row numbers and checkboxes for checking rows.
trans-unit.target: 显示带行号和勾选框的序号列，用于勾选行。

trans-unit.source: Row items: `DataGridRow` objects or any objects the columns can read. `INotifyCollectionChanged` sources are followed.
trans-unit.target: 行对象：`DataGridRow` 或列能读取的任意对象。会跟踪 `INotifyCollectionChanged` 数据源的变化。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the grid; also names exported files and the xlsx worksheet.
trans-unit.target: 表格的无障碍名称；也用于命名导出文件和 xlsx 工作表。

trans-unit.source: Tallest the scrolling area grows before it scrolls, in px (default 400); infinity fills the available height.
trans-unit.target: 滚动区域开始滚动前的最大高度，单位 px（默认 400）；无穷大表示占满可用高度。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the pinned columns (two-way); null uses `IsPinned`, or the first column when no column sets it.
trans-unit.target: 固定列的键（双向）；为 null 时使用 `IsPinned`，没有任何列设置时固定第一列。

trans-unit.source: Stable row identity; defaults to `Key`, else the item itself. Required with `DataSource`.
trans-unit.target: 稳定的行标识；默认用 `Key`，否则用行对象本身。使用 `DataSource` 时必须设置。

trans-unit.source: Raised after checked rows were deleted (removed from the source when it is a writable list).
trans-unit.target: 勾选的行被删除后触发（数据源是可写列表时会从中移除）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a delete was undone (rows put back into a writable source at their old indices).
trans-unit.target: 删除被撤销后触发（行按原来的位置放回可写的数据源）。

trans-unit.source: Quick search text (two-way): every word must appear in some visible column.
trans-unit.target: 快速搜索文字（双向）：每个词都必须出现在某个可见列中。

trans-unit.source: The selected range, or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 选中的范围；表格没有单元格时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Shows the row number in the gutter. When false the gutter narrows to 40px and its checkboxes always show.
trans-unit.target: 在序号列显示行号。为 false 时序号列收窄到 40px，勾选框始终显示。

trans-unit.source: Shows the selection address and the Sum, Average and Count of the selected cells in the status bar.
trans-unit.target: 在状态栏显示选区地址以及所选单元格的求和、平均值和计数。

trans-unit.source: Shows the toolbar with search, undo and redo, filters, columns, density and export.
trans-unit.target: 显示工具栏：搜索、撤销与重做、筛选、列、行密度和导出。

trans-unit.source: Shows the sticky totals row; it covers every row the filters keep, collapsed groups included.
trans-unit.target: 显示吸底的合计行；它统计筛选后保留的全部行，包括折叠分组中的行。

trans-unit.source: Sort keys in priority order (two-way). Header clicks, Shift-clicks and the column menu change it.
trans-unit.target: 按优先级排列的排序键（双向）。单击表头、按住 Shift 单击和列菜单都会改变它。

trans-unit.source: Steps kept for undo (default 100; 0 turns undo off).
trans-unit.target: 撤销保留的步数（默认 100；0 表示关闭撤销）。

trans-unit.source: Number of rows the filters keep (the data source's row count with a `DataSource`).
trans-unit.target: 筛选后保留的行数（使用 `DataSource` 时为数据源报告的行数）。

trans-unit.source: An extra toolbar action for checked rows, shown between Export and Delete.
trans-unit.target: 勾选行时工具栏上的额外操作，显示在“导出”和“删除”之间。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the checked rows (an `IReadOnlyList<object>` in data order) as its parameter.
trans-unit.target: 执行时以勾选的行（按数据顺序的 `IReadOnlyList<object>`）作为参数。

trans-unit.source: A 24x24 Lucide geometry shown before the label (such as `ArcIcons.Archive`).
trans-unit.target: 显示在标签前的 24x24 Lucide 几何图形（例如 `ArcIcons.Archive`）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the button in the danger color.
trans-unit.target: 用危险色绘制按钮。

trans-unit.source: Button text; also the accessible name. The label hides below 640px of grid width.
trans-unit.target: 按钮文字，也是无障碍名称。表格宽度小于 640px 时隐藏标签。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `DataGrid`. The cell value comes from `ValueGetter`, else from `Binding` (a compiled binding against the row item, written back two-way), else from the `DataGridRow` field (or dictionary entry) named by `Key`. Values are normalized to a string, a `Decimal`, a `DateOnly` or null by `Type`.
trans-unit.target: `DataGrid` 的一列。单元格的值来自 `ValueGetter`，其次是 `Binding`（针对行对象的编译绑定，双向写回），再次是 `Key` 指定的 `DataGridRow` 字段（或字典项）。值按 `Type` 归一为字符串、`Decimal`、`DateOnly` 或 null。

trans-unit.source: What the totals row and group subtotals show; null sums numbers and currency, averages percent and shows nothing otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 合计行和分组小计显示的内容；为 null 时数字和货币求和、百分比求平均，其他类型不显示。

trans-unit.source: Symbol of a Currency column (default "$"); it does not change with the interface language.
trans-unit.target: 货币列的符号（默认 "$"）；不随界面语言变化。

trans-unit.source: .NET format of a Date column (such as "yyyy-MM-dd"); null uses the language's short date with the month name.
trans-unit.target: 日期列的 .NET 格式（例如 "yyyy-MM-dd"）；为 null 时使用该语言带月份名称的日期格式。

trans-unit.source: Decimal places of Number, Currency and Percent values.
trans-unit.target: Number、Currency 和 Percent 值的小数位数。

trans-unit.source: Header text; also used for copied header rows, exports and accessible names.
trans-unit.target: 表头文字；也用于复制的表头行、导出和无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: False makes the column read only: edits, pastes, fills and clears skip it.
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时列只读：编辑、粘贴、填充和清空都会跳过它。

trans-unit.source: False leaves the filter cell empty and drops Filter from the column menu.
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时筛选格留空，列菜单中也没有“筛选”。

trans-unit.source: Offers Group by in the column menu; null allows it for Text, Select and Date columns.
trans-unit.target: 列菜单是否提供“按此列分组”；为 null 时 Text、Select 和 Date 列可以分组。

trans-unit.source: Starts hidden; people can show it again from the Columns menu.
trans-unit.target: 初始隐藏；用户可以在“列”菜单中重新显示它。

trans-unit.source: Starts pinned to the left edge. When no column sets it, the first column is pinned.
trans-unit.target: 初始固定在左侧。没有任何列设置它时，固定第一列。

trans-unit.source: False disables the header sort button and the sort items of the column menu.
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时禁用表头的排序按钮和列菜单中的排序项。

trans-unit.source: Row field the column reads and writes; also the id used by sorting, filters, pinning and hiding.
trans-unit.target: 该列读写的行字段；也是排序、筛选、固定和隐藏使用的标识。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a resize can reach (default 72). Resizing stops at 560px.
trans-unit.target: 调整列宽能达到的最小宽度（默认 72）。最大到 560px 为止。

trans-unit.source: Choices of a Select column, in sort order; null uses up to 200 distinct values already in the column.
trans-unit.target: Select 列的选项，按排序顺序；为 null 时取该列已有的最多 200 个不同值。

trans-unit.source: Kind of data: Text, Number, Currency, Percent, Select or Date.
trans-unit.target: 数据类型：Text、Number、Currency、Percent、Select 或 Date。

trans-unit.source: Starting width in px (default 140). The last column absorbs spare width on a wide grid.
trans-unit.target: 初始宽度，单位 px（默认 140）。表格较宽时，最后一列吸收多余的宽度。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `SortableDataTable`. The cell value comes from `ValueSelector` or `Binding` (compiled against the table's item type in XAML); sorting uses `SortValueSelector` / `SortBinding` when given, else the cell value, and `Comparer` when given, else Arc's comparison (numbers numerically, text with natural ordering, empty values last in both directions). Cells are drawn as text; `CellTemplate` hosts custom content.
trans-unit.target: `SortableDataTable` 的一列。单元格值来自 `ValueSelector` 或 `Binding`（在 XAML 中针对表格的项类型编译）；排序时，若提供了 `SortValueSelector` / `SortBinding` 则使用它们，否则使用单元格值；若提供了 `Comparer` 则使用它，否则使用 Arc 的比较方式（数字按数值比较，文本按自然顺序，空值在两个方向上都排在最后）。单元格以文本绘制；`CellTemplate` 用于承载自定义内容。

trans-unit.source: Custom cell content (Arc `render`); the data context is the row item.
trans-unit.target: 自定义单元格内容（Arc `render`）；数据上下文为该行的项。

trans-unit.source: Column label; also the default `EffectiveKey`.
trans-unit.target: 列标签；同时也是默认的 `EffectiveKey`。

trans-unit.source: Right-aligns the column. Null detects it: every non-empty value is a number.
trans-unit.target: 使该列右对齐。为 null 时自动检测：所有非空值均为数字。

trans-unit.source: When false the header is a plain label (Arc `sortable: false`).
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时，表头仅为普通标签（Arc `sortable: false`）。

trans-unit.source: Stable id reported by `SortKey` and sort events (defaults to `SortMemberPath`, then `Header`).
trans-unit.target: 稳定的标识，由 `SortKey` 和排序事件报告（默认为 `SortMemberPath`，其次为 `Header`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the member the column sorts by, reported as the sort key. The sorted value itself comes from `SortBinding`, `SortValueSelector` or the cell value.
trans-unit.target: 该列排序所依据的成员名称，作为排序键报告。实际用于排序的值来自 `SortBinding`、`SortValueSelector` 或单元格值。

trans-unit.source: Format for cell text: a composite format (`{0:N0} items`) or a format string (`C0`).
trans-unit.target: 单元格文本的格式：复合格式（`{0:N0} items`）或格式字符串（`C0`）。

trans-unit.source: Pixel widths are fixed; Auto columns are measured once and held so sorting never reflows them; star columns share the rest.
trans-unit.target: 像素宽度固定；Auto 列在首次测量后保持不变，因此排序时不会重新排版；星号列平分剩余空间。

trans-unit.source: Arc date field: type a date (parsed with `Culture`) or open the calendar popup (click, Alt+Down or ArrowDown) and pick a day. The shown date rolls part by part in time's direction (a later date rises from below, an earlier one drops from above; parts after a wider or narrower part slide along), the picked day's disc glides in the calendar and the footer confirms it before the popup returns to the field. Escape closes and keeps focus in the field; `MinDate`, `MaxDate` and `DisabledDates` reach the calendar and also reject typed dates. Label, description, error and size come from the field foundation.
trans-unit.target: Arc 日期字段：输入日期（按 `Culture` 解析），或打开日历弹出层（点击、Alt+Down 或 ArrowDown）并选择某一天。显示的日期按时间方向逐段滚动（较晚的日期从下方升起，较早的日期从上方落下；位于较宽或较窄部分之后的部分沿其滑动）；所选日期的圆点在日历中滑动，页脚确认选择后弹出层返回字段。按 Escape 关闭并使焦点留在字段中；`MinDate`、`MaxDate` 和 `DisabledDates` 同时作用于日历，并拒绝输入的日期。标签、说明、错误和尺寸由字段基础组件提供。

trans-unit.source: Footer button that clears the value (Arc: "Clear").
trans-unit.target: 用于清除值的页脚按钮（Arc：“Clear”）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for formatting, parsing and the calendar (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 用于格式化、解析和日历的区域性（null = 当前 UI 区域性）。

trans-unit.source: Arc date range picker: a compact trigger whose surface grows into the panel it opens (P9) — two months beside a preset rail, or one month under a scrolling preset row when the boundary is narrower than 712px. The range highlight stretches across each week as you hover or move with the keyboard, its solid ends glide between days, months slide in the direction you travel, the preset highlight glides between presets, and on Apply the formatted label flies back into the trigger as the surface shrinks around it (P8). Picking is a draft: only Apply commits (`SelectedRangeChanged`); Cancel, Escape or a press outside discard it.
