trans-unit.source: A focused surface for decisions that need attention: confirmations, short forms, step flows whose title crossfades. Declare it anywhere in XAML; it renders nothing in place and shows its panel above a blurred scrim while `IsOpen` is true: The overlay fades in while the panel rises 8px from 0.96 on the smooth spring; closing is shorter and starts from wherever the entrance is. Escape and a press on the scrim close it (cancellable through `Closing`); Tab cycles inside; focus returns to the opener. Code can await a result with `ShowAsync` or `ConfirmAsync`.
trans-unit.target: 用于需要关注的决策的聚焦表面：确认、简短表单、标题淡入切换的分步流程。可在 XAML 中任意位置声明；它不在原位渲染任何内容，当 `IsOpen` 为 true 时，会在模糊遮罩之上显示其面板。覆盖层淡入，面板以平滑弹簧从 0.96 缩放并上升 8px；关闭比进入更短，并从进入动画当前所在的位置开始。Escape 和在遮罩上按下都会关闭（可通过 `Closing` 取消）；Tab 在内部循环；焦点返回到打开它的元素。代码可通过 `ShowAsync` 或 `ConfirmAsync` 等待结果。

trans-unit.source: Set on a button inside a dialog, drawer or bottom sheet: clicking it closes that overlay with this value as its `CloseResult` (and the result of `ShowAsync`).
trans-unit.target: 设置在对话框、抽屉或底部面板内的按钮上：点击后将以此值作为其 `CloseResult` 关闭该覆盖层（同时也是 `ShowAsync` 的结果）。

trans-unit.source: Panel width: Small 360, Medium 440 (Arc), Large 560 — always within the viewport minus 32px.
trans-unit.target: 面板宽度：Small 360、Medium 440（Arc）、Large 560——始终不超过视口宽度减去 32px。

trans-unit.source: Arc's donut chart: a few parts of one whole. The legend and the ring show and hide segments together, the center reads the active segment (or the total at rest) and rolls like a drum between readouts, small parts fold into "Other", and new data moves every arc from where it is on screen, keeping its velocity. The first time the chart is seen all segments sweep out of the top together, each trailing edge a beat behind. Arc interpolates start and end angles rather than paths; every angle is a `MotionValue` written into one self-drawn ring, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 环形图：表示一个整体的若干部分。图例与圆环同步显示和隐藏分段；中心显示当前激活分段（静止时显示总计），并在读数之间像滚筒一样滚动；过小的部分合并为“Other”；新数据会让每段圆弧从其在屏幕上的当前位置出发，并保留其速度。首次看到该图表时，所有分段会一同从顶部扫出，每段的后缘比前缘晚一拍。Arc 对起始角与结束角进行插值，而非路径；每个角度都是写入一个自绘圆环的 `MotionValue`，这是 ControlTheme 过渡无法表达的。

trans-unit.source: The selected (pinned) segment key. Hover and focus preview other segments without changing it. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 所选（固定）分段的键。悬停和聚焦只预览其他分段，不会改变它。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the selected segment changes.
trans-unit.target: 当所选分段变化时引发。

trans-unit.source: Ring diameter in pixels; the ring scales down to fit narrower containers.
trans-unit.target: 圆环直径（像素）；当容器较窄时，圆环会等比缩小以适应。

trans-unit.source: Segments below this share of the total join "Other" (only when at least two would).
trans-unit.target: 占总量比例低于此值的分段合并为“Other”（仅当至少有两个分段符合条件时）。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden segments. A hidden segment closes and the rest of the ring redistributes. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 隐藏分段的键。隐藏的分段会收起，其余圆环重新分配空间。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a segment.
trans-unit.target: 当图例显示或隐藏某个分段时引发。

trans-unit.source: What clicking a legend row does.
trans-unit.target: 点击图例行时执行的操作。

trans-unit.source: The most segments drawn, counting "Other".
trans-unit.target: 最多绘制的分段数，包含“Other”。

trans-unit.source: Label of the segment that holds the grouped small parts.
trans-unit.target: 容纳合并小部分的分段的标签。

trans-unit.source: Ring thickness in pixels.
trans-unit.target: 圆环粗细（像素）。

trans-unit.source: The synced legend beside (at least 460px wide) or below the ring.
trans-unit.target: 与圆环同步的图例，位于圆环旁（宽度至少 460px）或其下方。

trans-unit.source: Center label at rest, above the total.
trans-unit.target: 静止时位于中心的标签，显示在总计上方。

trans-unit.source: A temporary side surface for focused work that keeps the page in context: filters, settings, record details, forms too long for a dialog. Declare it anywhere; while `IsOpen` its panel springs in from `Side` above a lightly blurred scrim. The header is a drag handle: it follows the pointer toward the edge and rubber-bands the other way; past a third of the panel, or on a flick toward the edge faster than 500px/s, the drawer closes and keeps the flick's velocity; otherwise it springs back. A click, Escape or the scrim closes it with a quicker tween. The close button is always there; under reduced motion dragging is off and the panel only fades.
trans-unit.target: 用于聚焦工作的临时侧边表面，可让页面保持上下文：筛选器、设置、记录详情、过长而不适合对话框的表单等。可在任意位置声明；当 `IsOpen` 为 true 时，其面板会从 `Side` 方向以弹簧弹入，并位于轻微模糊的遮罩之上。标题栏是拖动手柄：它跟随指针向边缘移动，向另一方向则产生橡皮筋回弹；超过面板的三分之一，或以快于 500px/s 的速度朝边缘轻扫时，抽屉会关闭并保留轻扫的速度；否则会弹回。点击、Escape 或遮罩会以较快的补间动画关闭它。关闭按钮始终存在；在减少动效模式下，拖动功能关闭，面板只淡入淡出。

trans-unit.source: Edge the panel is anchored to (default Right).
trans-unit.target: 面板所固定的边缘（默认为 Right）。

trans-unit.source: A focused list of actions anchored to a labelled trigger (Arc dropdown menu). The trigger shows an optional icon, the `Label` (a new label rises in from a soft blur while the trigger width springs) and a chevron that turns on the CSS spring while open. The menu grows from the trigger edge on Arc's 580ms CSS spring with a 160ms fade, one highlight glides between rows for the pointer and jumps for the keyboard, and rows fade in with a short stagger. Rows are declared inline (`<arc:MenuEntry Header="Rename" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}"/>`) or supplied with `ItemsSource`. Replace the built-in trigger with `Trigger` (any control; buttons toggle the menu on click and never press-scale). Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger open the menu on the first row; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 锚定在带标签触发器上的聚焦操作列表（Arc 下拉菜单）。触发器显示可选图标、`Label`（新标签从柔和模糊中升起，同时触发器宽度以弹簧变化）以及在打开时通过 CSS 弹簧转动的箭头。菜单以 Arc 的 580ms CSS 弹簧从触发器边缘展开，伴随 160ms 淡入；一个高亮会在行之间为指针滑动，为键盘则直接跳转；各行以短促的错落时序淡入。行可以内联声明（`<arc:MenuEntry Header="Rename" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}"/>`），也可通过 `ItemsSource` 提供。可用 `Trigger` 替换内置触发器（任意控件；按钮在点击时切换菜单，且从不产生按压缩放）。在触发器上按 Enter、Space 或 ArrowDown 会在第一行打开菜单；Escape 关闭菜单并将焦点返回触发器。

trans-unit.source: Menu alignment against the trigger (Arc: end).
trans-unit.target: 菜单相对触发器的对齐方式（Arc：end）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 菜单关闭时引发。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon of the built-in trigger (a 24x24 Lucide geometry such as `ArcIcons.Settings`).
trans-unit.target: 内置触发器的前置图标（24x24 Lucide 几何图形，例如 `ArcIcons.Settings`）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 菜单是否打开（双向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row is activated.
trans-unit.target: 当某一行被激活时引发。

trans-unit.source: Template that renders each ItemsSource item as a row.
trans-unit.target: 将每个 ItemsSource 项渲染为一行的模板。

trans-unit.source: Data items shown as one row each; ItemTemplate renders them when set.
trans-unit.target: 以每项一行显示的数据项；设置后由 ItemTemplate 渲染。

trans-unit.source: Trigger text (Arc: required). Changing it morphs the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 触发器文字（Arc：必填）。更改时触发器会变形。

trans-unit.source: Turns any control into a dropdown trigger for a `MenuSurface`: clicks (buttons) or taps toggle the menu, Enter / Space / ArrowDown open it on the first row, ArrowUp on the last, Escape returns focus to the control, and Arc buttons stop press-scaling while they anchor the menu. Used by split buttons, button groups and row "more" buttons: `<arc:Button arc:DropdownMenu.Menu="{StaticResource RowMenu}"/>`.
trans-unit.target: 将任意控件转换为 `MenuSurface` 的下拉触发器：点击（按钮）或轻触会切换菜单，Enter / Space / ArrowDown 在第一行打开菜单，ArrowUp 在最后一行打开，Escape 将焦点返回该控件；当 Arc 按钮锚定菜单时会停止按压缩放。用于拆分按钮、按钮组和行内“更多”按钮：`<arc:Button arc:DropdownMenu.Menu="{StaticResource RowMenu}"/>`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu opens.
trans-unit.target: 菜单打开时引发。

trans-unit.source: Edge of the trigger the menu opens from: Bottom (default), Top, Left or Right.
trans-unit.target: 菜单从触发器的哪一边展开：Bottom（默认）、Top、Left 或 Right。

trans-unit.source: Custom trigger content that replaces the built-in button (the menu anchors to it).
trans-unit.target: 替换内置按钮的自定义触发器内容（菜单锚定于此）。

trans-unit.source: Arc elastic slider: a single value slider made of something that gives. The thumb swells to 1.28× under the finger (P24), the track stretches like rubber up to 26px past either end and springs back with the release velocity (0.5s, bounce 0.42), the end icons are pushed outward with the stretch, a value tag hangs off the thumb and sways with its speed (up to 11°), and marks act as detents the thumb clicks into within 7px. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit hits the wall and bounces. `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to.
trans-unit.target: Arc 弹性滑块：一个带有回弹感的单值滑块。拇指在手指按下时放大至 1.28×（P24），轨道在任一端之外最多如橡皮筋般拉伸 26px，并以释放速度回弹（0.5s，bounce 0.42）；两端图标随拉伸向外推移；数值标签悬挂于拇指上，并随其速度摆动（最多 11°）；刻度充当档位，拇指在 7px 之内会“咔哒”一声卡入。方向键、Shift+方向键、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的用法与原生 range 输入相同；键在极限处会碰壁并回弹。`SmallChange` 是数值吸附的步长。

trans-unit.source: Icon after the track; pushed outward when the track is pulled past its end.
trans-unit.target: 轨道之后的图标；当轨道被拉过末端时向外推移。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value beside the label. The tag still appears while dragging or using keys.
trans-unit.target: 在标签旁显示数值。拖动或使用键盘时数值标签仍会出现。

trans-unit.source: Visible label; it also names the thumb.
trans-unit.target: 可见标签；同时也作为拇指的名称。

trans-unit.source: Detents: a dragged thumb clicks into each one and holds for a few pixels. Labels print under the track.
trans-unit.target: 档位：拖动的拇指会在每个档位处“咔哒”一声卡入，并在几个像素范围内停留。标签打印在轨道下方。

trans-unit.source: Icon before the track; pushed outward when the track is pulled past its start.
trans-unit.target: 轨道之前的图标；当轨道被拉过起点时向外推移。

trans-unit.source: Runs once a drag is released, a key changes the value or a mark label is clicked.
trans-unit.target: 拖动释放、按键更改数值或点击刻度标签后执行一次。

trans-unit.source: Formats the value in the value tag and readout; when not set, the value is shown with the slider's Decimals.
trans-unit.target: 设置数值标签和读数的格式；未设置时，数值按滑块的 Decimals 显示。

trans-unit.source: Arc empty state: a useful next step when there is nothing to show yet (an empty list, zero search results, first use). A centered icon block, a title, one or two sentences and an optional action. Keep it mounted and change its properties to morph between states: the icon pops into the new one, the copy rises in while the old copy leaves, and the text block's height springs to fit. The icon block settles in once when it first appears.
trans-unit.target: Arc 空状态：在尚无内容可显示时（空列表、搜索结果为零、首次使用）提供有用的下一步。包括居中的图标区块、标题、一到两句说明以及可选的操作。保持其挂载，通过更改属性在各状态之间变形：图标弹入新的图标，文案升起，旧文案离开，文字区块的高度以弹簧适应内容。图标区块在首次出现时仅稳定地进入一次。

trans-unit.source: The call to action, usually a button (or a panel of two).
trans-unit.target: 引导操作，通常为一个按钮（也可为两个按钮的面板）。

trans-unit.source: One or two sentences on why it is empty and what to do next.
trans-unit.target: 说明为何为空以及下一步该做什么，一到两句。

trans-unit.source: The icon: a control, or a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry`. Default: Lucide Folder at stroke 1.5.
trans-unit.target: 图标：一个控件，或 24×24 的 Lucide `Geometry`。默认为 Lucide Folder，描边宽度 1.5。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the region.
trans-unit.target: 该区域的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: The headline (a heading, level 3).
trans-unit.target: 标题（三级标题）。

trans-unit.source: Four empty states in one illustration whose shapes morph between scenes as you switch tabs. Each `EmptyStatesItem` is a tab with a scene (no results, offline, caught up, not found) and its copy; every shape of the drawing travels to its new position, size, radius, rotation and color on a spring, outlines morph point by point and line accents draw in a beat later. The primary action raises `ActionInvoked` (and runs `ActionCommand`); the app does the work and moves `Phase` to Loading and then Done, and the drawing and copy follow. With no items the block shows Arc's four scenes and copy.
trans-unit.target: 同一幅插图中的四种空状态，切换标签时图形会在各场景之间变形。每个 `EmptyStatesItem` 是一个标签，包含场景（无结果、离线、已全部处理、未找到）及其文案；图形中的每个形状都会以弹簧动画移动到新的位置、尺寸、圆角、旋转角度和颜色，轮廓逐点变形，线条强调会稍后绘制。主操作会触发 `ActionInvoked`（并执行 `ActionCommand`）；应用负责执行操作，并将 `Phase` 设为 Loading，随后设为 Done，插图与文案随之变化。若没有任何项，该区块会显示 Arc 的四个场景及其文案。

trans-unit.source: Arc expandable card: a summary card whose header opens a details panel below it. Opening is one morph: width and height grow on the same smooth spring (real size, never a scale, so text and corners never stretch) and the chevron turns with it; the details fade in once the box has made room, and on close they fade first and the box follows 60ms later. A second click mid-flight reverses from the current size and velocity. The summary line rolls only the words that changed. Escape closes the card from anywhere inside it and returns focus to the header.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可展开卡片：摘要卡片，其标题可在下方打开详情面板。展开为一次连续的形变：宽度与高度沿同一平滑弹簧同时增长（使用真实尺寸而非缩放，因此文字与圆角不会变形），箭头随之转动；详情在盒子腾出空间后淡入，收起时则先淡出，盒子再延迟 60ms 收拢。飞行途中再次点击会从当前尺寸与速度反向运动。摘要行只滚动变化的词语。Escape 可在卡片内任何位置将其关闭，并把焦点交回标题。

trans-unit.source: Width cap while collapsed, in px; NaN fills the container (Arc width).
trans-unit.target: 折叠时的宽度上限，单位 px；NaN 表示填满容器（Arc width）。

trans-unit.source: Summary line under the title; changed words roll in.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的摘要行；变化的词会滚入。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the card opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 卡片展开或收起后触发。

trans-unit.source: Width cap while open, so the card can grow sideways; NaN uses `CollapsedWidth` (Arc expandedWidth).
trans-unit.target: 展开时的宽度上限，使卡片可向侧边扩展；NaN 时使用 `CollapsedWidth`（Arc expandedWidth）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the details are open. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 详情是否展开。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Arc expandable text: long text clamped to `Lines` lines with a soft fade over the last one. Read more opens it to its full height with a calm ease out (500–600ms, growing with the distance) and Show less closes it (400–450ms); the height, the fade and the chevron follow one progress value, so they always move in step, and a click mid-flight reverses from the current height. The toggle only appears when the text really overflows, and stays correct as the width or font changes. The whole text is always available to assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可展开文本：过长的文本被截断为 `Lines` 行，末行带柔和的渐隐效果。“阅读更多”会以平缓的 ease out 缓动（500–600ms，随距离增加）展开至完整高度，“收起”则以 400–450ms 收拢；高度、渐隐与箭头共用同一进度值，因此始终同步移动，飞行途中点击会从当前高度反向。仅当文本确实溢出时才显示切换按钮，并在宽度或字体变化时保持正确。完整文本始终可供辅助技术使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the text opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 文本展开或收起后触发。

trans-unit.source: Rich text with runs and inline links (`InlineUIContainer`); used instead of `Text` when set.
trans-unit.target: 富文本，包含多段文字与行内链接（`InlineUIContainer`）；设置后代替 `Text` 使用。

trans-unit.source: Whether the full text shows. Two-way.

trans-unit.target: 折叠时显示的行数（Arc 默认为 3）。

trans-unit.source: Toggle label while collapsed.
trans-unit.target: 折叠时切换按钮的文字。

trans-unit.source: The text (paragraphs separated by line breaks).
trans-unit.target: 文本内容（段落以换行分隔）。

trans-unit.source: A compact pill of icon buttons for 3 to 6 related actions (message, file and card actions). One action always shows its label; the one you point at or focus takes it over while its neighbours slide aside (width springs inside one row, P5), and an action can confirm in place: the icon draws a check and the label becomes a past tense word (P2, P15). On touch the first tap reveals the label and a second tap runs the action. One Tab stop; arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter and Space run.
trans-unit.target: 紧凑的胶囊形图标按钮组，用于 3 至 6 个相关操作（消息、文件和卡片操作）。始终有一个操作显示其标签；鼠标指向或获得焦点的操作会接管标签，相邻项同时滑开（宽度在同一行内以弹簧变化，P5）。操作可原地确认：图标变为勾选，标签变为过去式词语（P2、P15）。触屏上，第一次点按显示标签，第二次点按执行操作。整组只占一个 Tab 焦点；方向键移动并循环，Home 与 End 跳转，Enter 与空格执行。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever an action runs, before its own `AsyncAction`.
trans-unit.target: 每次操作执行时触发，早于其自身的 `AsyncAction`。

trans-unit.source: How long a confirmation stays (default 1.4s).
trans-unit.target: 确认状态保持的时长（默认 1.4s）。

trans-unit.source: The action (item or its container) whose label shows at rest; null uses the first enabled action.
trans-unit.target: 静止时显示标签的操作（项或其容器）；为 null 时使用第一个启用的操作。

trans-unit.source: The action currently showing its label.
trans-unit.target: 当前显示标签的操作。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Message actions".
trans-unit.target: 工具栏的无障碍名称，例如“消息操作”。

trans-unit.source: Small (28px, 14px icons) or Medium (36px, 16px icons; default). Large is treated as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（28px，图标 14px）或 Medium（36px，图标 16px；默认）。Large 按 Medium 处理。

trans-unit.source: One action of an `ExpandingButtonGroup`: an icon that grows to reveal its label. The width rides the morph spring between the icon and the icon plus the longer of `Label` and `DoneLabel`; the label slides out from behind the icon and tucks back faster. Code-driven because the reveal is asymmetric (240ms with a delay in, 120ms out) and blurs, which a ControlTheme transition cannot express.
trans-unit.target: `ExpandingButtonGroup` 的一个操作：图标会展开以显示标签。宽度沿形变弹簧在图标与“图标加上 `Label` 与 `DoneLabel` 中较长者”之间变化；标签从图标后滑出，收回时更快。由代码驱动，因为展开与收起不对称（展开 240ms 并带延迟，收起 120ms）且带模糊效果，ControlTheme 过渡无法表达。

trans-unit.source: Runs the action. The button is busy until the task completes; returning false, or throwing, skips the confirmation. Without it, `Click` and `Command` count as success.
trans-unit.target: 执行该操作。任务完成前按钮处于忙碌状态；返回 false 或抛出异常则跳过确认。未设置时，`Click` 与 `Command` 视为成功。

trans-unit.target: 操作执行后原位显示的过去式词语（如“已归档”）；打开内容的操作请省略。

trans-unit.source: 16px Lucide glyph shown while collapsed (sized by the group).

trans-unit.source: True while the confirmation shows.
trans-unit.target: 确认状态显示期间为 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc expanding search: a search that waits as an icon button until it is needed (headers, toolbars). The button morphs into the field on the morph spring (its corners follow the width, from a circle to the control radius), results unfold beneath it in groups with the match in medium weight, and a highlight glides between them on the snappy spring. ArrowUp / ArrowDown move (wrapping), Enter chooses, Escape folds it back into the icon; leaving an empty field folds it too. Before anything is typed it shows `Suggestions`. Place it in the lane the field may grow into: it fills that lane's width and keeps the button on the `Anchor` edge; the field never grows past `ExpandedWidth` or the lane.
trans-unit.target: Arc 展开式搜索：平时以图标按钮形式出现，需要时才展开（用于标题栏、工具栏）。按钮沿形变弹簧变形为输入框（圆角随宽度变化，从圆形过渡到控件圆角），结果在其下方按分组展开，匹配部分以中等字重显示，高亮项以灵敏弹簧在各结果之间滑动。ArrowUp / ArrowDown 移动（循环），Enter 选择，Escape 将其收回为图标；输入框为空时离开也会收回。尚未输入任何内容时显示 `Suggestions`。请将其放在输入框可以扩展的区域内：它会填满该区域的宽度，并把按钮保持在 `Anchor` 所在的边缘；输入框的宽度永远不会超过 `ExpandedWidth` 或该区域。

trans-unit.source: The edge the button sits on. Default End.
trans-unit.target: 按钮所在的边缘。默认为 End。

trans-unit.source: A short tip under the empty state.
trans-unit.target: 空状态下方的简短提示。

trans-unit.source: The widest the field grows (it never grows past its lane). Default 360.
trans-unit.target: 输入框可展开的最大宽度（不会超过其所在区域）。默认 360。

trans-unit.source: Results gather under this heading, in the order groups first appear.
trans-unit.target: 结果按此标题归组，分组按首次出现的顺序排列。

trans-unit.source: An 18px leading icon: a Lucide `Geometry` or any control.
trans-unit.target: 18px 的前导图标：Lucide `Geometry` 或任意控件。

trans-unit.source: Arc's generous target for dropping one or more files: drag files from the system onto it, click (or Enter / Space) to choose from the device, or paste a file while the pointer is over it. Files are checked against `Accept`, `MaxFileSize` and `MaxFiles`; refusals shake the target. The list shows each file with an upload state driven by `UploadHandler` or by the app, with Retry and Remove.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的文件拖放区，目标区域较大，便于放入一个或多个文件：可从系统拖入文件，点击（或按 Enter / 空格）从设备选择，或在指针悬停时粘贴文件。文件会按 `Accept`、`MaxFileSize` 与 `MaxFiles` 检查；被拒绝时目标区域会抖动。列表显示每个文件的上传状态（由 `UploadHandler` 或应用程序驱动），并提供重试与移除。

trans-unit.source: Once the list holds this many files, the prompt folds to a slim bar; a file dragged over brings the icon back.

trans-unit.source: The line under the label (default "Drop files here or choose from your device").

trans-unit.source: Raised when the visitor's files change (added or removed; Arc's `onFilesChange`).

trans-unit.source: True while files are dragged over the target.

trans-unit.source: Arc's filter toolbar: keep collection filters close and easy to reset. Applied filters are removable chips ("Status · Open") whose slots open and close on a spring so neighbors slide along, a changed value morphs in place, Clear all appears while any filter is applied, and the Add filter menu picks a field, then a value (one chip per field). An optional search field sits with the actions. `ActiveFilters` is two-way and a mutable list is updated in place; `FiltersChanged` reports every change, and changes are announced.
trans-unit.target: Arc 筛选工具栏：让集合的筛选条件保持在手边，并易于重置。已应用的筛选为可移除的标签（“状态 · 未解决”），其位置以弹簧展开或收起，使相邻标签滑动让位；变化的值会原位形变；只要应用了任一筛选，就会出现“全部清除”；“添加筛选”菜单先选字段，再选值（每个字段一个标签）。操作按钮旁可放置可选的搜索框。`ActiveFilters` 为双向绑定，可变列表会原地更新；`FiltersChanged` 报告每一次变化，并会向辅助技术播报。

trans-unit.source: Separate soft buttons in a quiet tray for floating editors and canvas toolbars (Undo, Redo, Share, Present). One shared highlight (P7 `GlidingIndicator`) morphs in position and size to whichever button the pointer or keyboard focus is on, holds still across gaps and separators, fades when the pointer leaves the tray, and settles darker in place while a button is pressed; the buttons themselves never scale. Icon-only buttons and shortcut hints show the Arc `Tooltip`. One Tab stop; arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter and Space act.
trans-unit.target: 浮动编辑器与画布工具栏使用的独立柔和按钮，排列在安静的托盘中（撤销、重做、分享、演示）。一个共享的高亮（P7 `GlidingIndicator`）会在位置与尺寸上形变，移向指针或键盘焦点所在的按钮；经过间隙与分隔符时保持静止，指针离开托盘时淡出，按下按钮时原位变暗；按钮本身从不缩放。仅图标的按钮与快捷键提示会显示 Arc `Tooltip`。整组只占一个 Tab 焦点；方向键移动并循环，Home 与 End 跳转，Enter 与空格执行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an item's own click handlers and command.
trans-unit.target: 在某项自身的点击处理程序与命令之后触发。

trans-unit.source: Shows every item as an icon with its label in a tooltip; items with their own setting win.

trans-unit.source: A 270° ring gauge (Arc "Gauge"): one value against a known range, read as a percentage with an optional named state from `Thresholds`. The ring fills once when half of it scrolls into view, then springs to every new value while the percentage rolls (Core `RollingDigits`); the state color and label switch exactly when the moving count crosses a band. Reduced and Off motion land on the value at once.
trans-unit.target: 270° 环形仪表（Arc “Gauge”）：将一个值与已知范围进行对比，以百分比显示，并可选择来自 `Thresholds` 的命名状态。环形在其一半滚动进入视野时一次性填充，之后每个新值都会以弹簧过渡，百分比同时滚动（Core `RollingDigits`）；当滚动中的计数跨越某个区间时，状态颜色与标签会立即切换。Reduced 与 Off 动效直接跳到目标值。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Detail` property.

trans-unit.source: A band that starts at `From` (in value units). The highest band the value reaches sets the ring's tone and names the state under the number, so the state never rests on color alone.
trans-unit.target: 从 `From`（以数值单位计）开始的一个区间。数值所达到的最高区间决定环形的色调，并在数字下方标明状态，因此状态不仅依靠颜色来表达。

trans-unit.source: A button that commits only after it is held, for destructive or hard to undo actions where a stray tap must not count. The fill tracks the hold on a linear, pausable timeline (P22) and is revealed from the leading edge with the label inverted exactly at the edge (P29); letting go early rewinds it on a smooth spring, and finishing morphs the label and icon into the done state (P2, P5, P15). Space and Enter can be held too; the hint is in the help text.
trans-unit.target: 仅在按住之后才会确认的按钮，适用于破坏性或难以撤销的操作，避免误触即生效。填充进度沿线性、可暂停的时间轴（P22）推进，从前缘显露，文字在前缘处精确反色（P29）；提前松手时以平滑弹簧回退，完成时标签和图标变形为完成状态（P2、P5、P15）。空格键和 Enter 键同样可以按住，提示见帮助文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a hold completes (after which `Command` runs).

trans-unit.source: Fill color: Accent (default), Danger for irreversible actions, or Neutral.

trans-unit.source: A read-only preview of a person or link that opens after a short hover or keyboard focus: mentions, avatars, author names, link previews — where a click must stay free for navigation. It waits 500ms; moving to another trigger while a card is open (or within 300ms of one closing) opens the next after 80ms with a fade only. The pointer can travel into the card during a 140ms grace and it stays open while the pointer is over it. Tab focus opens at once, Enter skips the wait, Escape closes (and it stays closed while the pointer rests on the trigger); on touch a tap toggles it. One card is open at a time. The card grows from the trigger edge: scale 0.96 and 4px toward the trigger on the smooth spring, with its own fade; leaving mid-exit and coming back turns it around. Focus never enters the card, so keep its content read-only.
trans-unit.target: 在短暂悬停或键盘焦点之后打开的人员或链接只读预览：提及、头像、作者名、链接预览，即必须保留点击以便导航的场景。它等待 500ms；卡片打开时（或关闭后 300ms 内）移到另一个触发器，会在 80ms 后仅以淡入淡出打开下一张。指针可在 140ms 的宽限期内移入卡片，只要指针停留在卡片上，卡片就保持打开。Tab 焦点立即打开，Enter 跳过等待，Escape 关闭（指针停留在触发器上时保持关闭）；触摸时点按会切换。同一时间只打开一张卡片。卡片从触发器边缘生长：以平滑弹簧缩放至 0.96，并朝触发器方向移动 4px，同时带有自身的淡入淡出；在退出中途离开再返回时会反向。焦点不会进入卡片，因此其内容应保持只读。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge (default Start).
trans-unit.target: 沿触发器边缘的对齐方式（默认 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Attaches a hover card to any control.
trans-unit.target: 为任意控件附加悬停卡片。

trans-unit.source: The focusable trigger shown in place of the card (a mention, an avatar, a link).
trans-unit.target: 可获得焦点的触发器，显示在卡片的位置（提及、头像或链接）。

trans-unit.source: A person preview for `HoverCard`: portrait (or initials), name, role, a short bio, a few numbers and a quiet footer line. Each time the card opens its rows settle in from 4px below with a tiny stagger (40ms + 35ms per row, standard duration, ease enter); reduced motion shows them at rest. The stagger replays on every open, which a ControlTheme transition (first frame never animates) cannot express, so one linear `MotionValue` drives a shared timeline for all rows.
trans-unit.target: 用于 `HoverCard` 的人员预览：头像（或首字母）、姓名、角色、简短简介、若干数字以及一行低调的页脚。每次卡片打开时，各行会从下方 4px 处以细微的错开时序（40ms + 每行 35ms，标准时长，进入缓动）滑入；减少动效时直接显示在最终位置。错开动画每次打开都会重新播放，这是 ControlTheme 过渡（首帧从不播放动画）无法表达的，因此由一个线性的 `MotionValue` 为所有行驱动共享时间轴。

trans-unit.source: Portrait; a downloading portrait fades in from a soft blur.
trans-unit.target: 头像；下载中的头像会从柔和的模糊中淡入。

trans-unit.target: 在 `HoverCardProfile` 中显示的数字（数值位于标签之上）。

trans-unit.source: Icons that morph between two states instead of swapping: lines rotate and slide into place, outlines interpolate (P16 `PathMorph`), and a few carry a moment of their own (the bell rings, the heart bursts). Every morph rides an interruptible spring, so toggling quickly reverses from wherever the icon is. Drawn in one `Render` on the 24-unit grid. The icon is decorative: put it in a button that carries the name and the pressed or expanded state.
trans-unit.target: 在两种状态之间变形而非直接切换的图标：线条旋转并滑入就位，轮廓进行插值（P16 `PathMorph`），部分图标还带有自身的动效（铃铛会响，爱心会迸发）。每次变形都沿可被打断的弹簧运行，因此快速切换时会从图标当前位置反向。图标在 24 单位网格上通过一次 `Render` 绘制。该图标仅作装饰：请将其放入带有名称以及按下或展开状态的按钮中。

trans-unit.source: Before and after, split by a divider (Arc image compare). Drag anywhere to move it: the handle follows 1:1, rubber-bands past the edges and stays where it is released. A press on the image springs the divider there; on touch the press waits for a drag along the divider's axis so the page still scrolls, and a tap moves the divider. Arrow keys step 1% (Shift 10%), PageUp / PageDown 10%, Home and End reveal one side fully, and a double-click on the handle springs it back to the middle. Changing `Orientation` swings the divider a quarter turn. `Before` / `After` take any content (an `Image` with `Stretch="UniformToFill"`, a drawing, a control). `BeforeSource` / `AfterSource` load a picture with AtomUI's `AsyncImage` on top of that content: it fades in from a soft blur while downloading, and when it fails the content underneath shows instead.
trans-unit.target: 前后对比，由分隔线分开（Arc 图像对比）。拖动任意位置即可移动：手柄 1:1 跟随，越过边缘时有橡皮筋式回弹，松手后停留在原处。在图像上按下会将分隔线以弹簧方式移动到该处；触摸时需等待沿分隔线方向的拖动，以便页面仍可滚动，轻点则移动分隔线。方向键每次步进 1%（按住 Shift 为 10%），PageUp / PageDown 为 10%，Home 和 End 将一侧完整显示，双击手柄会将其弹回中间。更改 `Orientation` 会使分隔线旋转四分之一圈。`Before` / `After` 可接受任意内容（`Stretch="UniformToFill"` 的 `Image`、绘图或控件）。`BeforeSource` / `AfterSource` 通过 AtomUI 的 `AsyncImage` 在该内容之上加载图片：下载时从柔和的模糊中淡入，加载失败时则显示底层内容。

trans-unit.source: The result, shown on the right (or bottom).
trans-unit.target: 结果，显示在右侧（或底部）。

trans-unit.source: Arc inline edit: click-to-edit text for names and short fields read far more often than they change. The text turns into a field in place with the same metrics, so nothing around it moves, and the frame grows with what is typed. Enter commits (`TextCommitted`) and saves optimistically through `SaveHandler`: the new text shows at once, quieter until the save lands, then a check draws. Escape cancels and the text rolls back; a failed save restores the last saved `Value`, says why, and offers to try again. Tab or a click elsewhere saves like Enter. Multiline: Shift+Enter adds a line break.
trans-unit.target: Arc 行内编辑：点击即可编辑，适用于名称和短字段这类经常阅读、却很少变动的文字。文字会就地转为字段，度量保持一致，因此周围内容不会移动，框架会随输入内容增长。Enter 提交（`TextCommitted`），并通过 `SaveHandler` 乐观保存：新文字立即显示，保存完成前稍显淡化，随后绘制一个对勾。Escape 取消并回滚文字；保存失败时会恢复上一次保存的 `Value`，说明原因，并提供重试。Tab 或点击其他位置与 Enter 一样保存。多行模式下，Shift+Enter 添加换行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an edit is cancelled with Escape or the cancel button.
trans-unit.target: 按 Escape 或取消按钮取消编辑时触发。

trans-unit.target: 显示在字段下方的验证信息（如有）。

trans-unit.source: Arc input: a single-line field with a visible label, helper and error rows that open on a spring and rewrite only the words that change, and the Arc frame states (hover and focus darken the border, an error turns it danger, disabled fades). Everything from Avalonia's TextBox is kept: caret, selection, IME, undo, clipboard and a two-way `Text`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 输入框：带可见标签的单行字段，辅助文字行与错误行以弹簧展开，只改写变化的词；外框状态与 Arc 一致（悬停与聚焦加深边框，错误时变为危险色，禁用时变淡）。Avalonia TextBox 的能力全部保留：光标、选择、输入法、撤销、剪贴板与双向绑定的 `Text`。

trans-unit.source: A collapsible tree for JSON. Values are colored by type, branches unfold row by row on a smooth spring, search highlights every match and opens the branches that hold them, long arrays and objects load in pages, and each row can copy its value or path. Follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: arrows move and open, Home/End jump, Enter/Space toggle, Ctrl/Cmd+C copies the current value (Shift: its path) and / focuses the search. Rows are a flat, virtualized list (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`), so very large documents stay smooth. Input: `Json` (text), `Value` (`JsonNode`) or `Element`.
trans-unit.target: 用于 JSON 的可折叠树。值按类型着色，分支以平滑弹簧逐行展开，搜索会高亮每个匹配项并展开包含匹配项的分支，长数组和对象分页加载，每一行都可复制其值或路径。遵循 WAI-ARIA 树形模式：方向键移动和展开，Home/End 跳转，Enter/Space 切换展开，Ctrl/Cmd+C 复制当前值（Shift：复制其路径），/ 聚焦搜索。行是一个扁平的虚拟化列表（参见 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`），因此非常大的文档依然流畅。输入：`Json`（文本）、`Value`（`JsonNode`）或 `Element`。

trans-unit.source: Arc's line chart: one or more measures over time with series toggles, a crosshair that glides between points and a tooltip that follows on its own spring. Lines draw in from the left the first time the chart is seen, and a new range morphs every line from the shape on screen (resampled on shared x positions) while the value axis springs to its new range and the gridlines ride it. A hidden series flattens into the baseline as it fades. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` and a per-point spring array) because every animated value is a coordinate inside one self-drawn geometry, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 折线图：一个或多个随时间变化的度量，带有系列切换、在数据点之间滑动的十字准线，以及按自身弹簧跟随的提示框。图表首次出现时，线条从左侧绘制出现；切换到新范围时，每条线会从屏幕上的形状变形（在共享的 x 位置上重新采样），同时数值轴以弹簧移动到新范围，网格线随之移动。隐藏的系列会在淡出时压平到基线。动效由代码驱动（`MotionValue` 加上每个点的弹簧数组），因为每个动画值都是同一幅自绘几何图形中的一个坐标，而 ControlTheme 过渡无法表达这一点。

trans-unit.source: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
trans-unit.target: 平滑的单调曲线（不会超出数据范围），或直线段。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `MenuSurface`: a leading icon (a Lucide `Geometry` such as `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`, or any control), a header, an optional shortcut hint and the check or radio indicator of toggle rows. Rows never draw their own hover or focus fill: the surface's shared highlight glides to the row under the pointer and jumps to the keyboard position. Activation runs `Command`, raises `Click` and the surface's `ItemClicked`, then closes the menu unless `StaysOpenOnClick` is set.

trans-unit.source: Arc money input: a currency amount field. trans-unit.source: Arc morph select: a select whose trigger is the list. Opening grows the trigger itself into the options surface (width, height and corners spring together, P9), a single highlight glides between options (P7), and the chosen label lifts out of the list and settles into the trigger (P8) while the trigger springs to its new width (P5). Supports groups (`Group`), icons and trailing meta, type-ahead, search for long lists and the full listbox keyboard model. Use it for property pickers and form fields with up to a few hundred options. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open on the selected option (Home / End open on the first or last); arrows, PageUp / PageDown (8 at a time) and Home / End move; Enter or Space picks; Alt+Up picks and closes; typing jumps (or searches when search is on); Escape closes and returns focus; Tab closes without picking.
trans-unit.target: Arc 变形选择框：触发器本身即列表。打开时，触发器会直接变形为选项面板（宽度、高度与圆角一同以弹簧变化，P9），单个高亮在选项之间滑动（P7），所选标签从列表中浮起并落入触发器（P8），同时触发器以弹簧变为新宽度（P5）。支持分组（`Group`）、图标与尾随元数据、类型查找、长列表搜索以及完整的列表框键盘操作模型。适用于属性选择器以及最多数百个选项的表单字段。键盘：Enter、空格与方向键会在所选选项上打开（Home / End 在第一个或最后一个选项上打开）；方向键、PageUp / PageDown（每次 8 项）与 Home / End 用于移动；Enter 或空格用于选取；Alt+Up 选取并关闭；输入字符会跳转（开启搜索时则进行搜索）；Escape 关闭并返回焦点；Tab 关闭且不选取。

trans-unit.source: An animated multi-region deployment: a global load balancer sends users to the primary region while its database replicates to standby regions. When a region fails its health checks traffic shifts to the next healthy region and, if it held the primary database, a replica is promoted; a recovered region catches up as a replica.

trans-unit.source: A home for updates: a bell with an unread badge that opens a panel of notifications with read state, an All / Unread switch, expandable details and bulk actions ("Mark all read", "Clear read"). Use it when updates need a persistent place instead of a brief toast, and connect the read state to your data store through `IsRead` and the `ReadChanged` and `Dismissed` events. The panel grows out of the bell (6px toward it at scale 0.97, standard 240ms) and leaves in 120ms; counts roll, the summary rises into its new wording, the view highlight glides on the morph spring, rows collapse their height on the smooth spring as they leave (cascading 35ms apart after a bulk action) and settle in with a 4px rise when the panel opens. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the bell. Ported from Arc's free notification-center block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: 更新的常驻入口：一个带未读徽标的铃铛，点击后打开通知面板，面板包含已读状态、All / Unread 切换、可展开的详情以及批量操作（“Mark all read”、“Clear read”）。当更新需要持久的位置，而非短暂的消息提示时使用它，并通过 `IsRead` 与 `ReadChanged` 及 `Dismissed` 事件，将已读状态连接到你的数据存储。面板从铃铛处展开（朝铃铛方向偏移 6px，缩放至 0.97，标准时长 240ms），并在 120ms 内收起；计数滚动更新，摘要以向上推入的方式切换为新措辞，视图高亮沿变形弹簧滑动，行离开时以平滑弹簧收起高度（批量操作后按 35ms 间隔依次级联），面板打开时各行以 4px 上移的方式落定。按 Escape 关闭面板，并将焦点返回铃铛。移植自 Arc 免费的通知中心模块（MIT 许可，版权所有 (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: Arc number field: a bounded number with clear increment controls. The value rolls like an odometer, the steppers and ArrowUp / ArrowDown repeat and speed up while held, Shift, PageUp and PageDown take large steps, Home and End jump to the limits, and `IsScrubEnabled` lets the label be dragged sideways. Typing edits a plain draft that applies live while valid and commits on Enter, blur or the next step (snapped to the step grid and clamped). A press past a limit strains the value toward it, shakes the refused stepper and names the limit beside the label (`"Max 10 seats"`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 数字输入框：带有明确增减控件的有界数值。数值以里程表式滚动；步进按钮及 ArrowUp / ArrowDown 按住时会重复并逐步加速；Shift、PageUp 与 PageDown 以较大步长调整；Home 与 End 跳到上下限；`IsScrubEnabled` 允许左右拖动标签来调整数值。输入时编辑一份普通草稿：有效时即时生效，并在按下 Enter、失去焦点或执行下一步时提交（会对齐步长网格并限制在范围内）。按压超出上下限时，数值会向该限制拉伸，被拒绝的步进按钮会抖动，并在标签旁标出该限制（`"Max 10 seats"`）。

trans-unit.source: Formatting and parsing culture (Arc `locale`, default en-US, never the current culture).
trans-unit.target: 格式化与解析所用的区域性（Arc 的 `locale`，默认 en-US，从不使用当前系统区域性）。

trans-unit.target: 上限（默认 9007199254740991，即 Arc 的 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`）。

trans-unit.source: The frame of a project or record page (Arc page header block): a fixed header with breadcrumbs, a large title with a status badge, a description, a meta row, actions and tabs, over the scrolling body of the selected tab. Scrolling the body past 16px folds the header into a compact bar (the breadcrumbs give way to the title and its status, which scrolls back to the top when chosen); it opens again only near the top (4px), so it never flickers. Secondary actions fold into the "More actions" menu when the breadcrumbs would get less than 240px, and return at 272px. Tab counts roll digit by digit, a 2px indicator glides between tabs, and panels slide in from the side of travel. Breakpoints follow the control's own width: below 560px the padding tightens, the root crumb and the compact badge hide and the title steps down a size; below 460px the primary action shows only its icon. Ported from Arc's free page-header block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli) and made data driven: tabs are `PageHeaderTab` items (or data items with `ItemTemplate` and `ContentTemplate`), actions are `PageHeaderAction`s.
trans-unit.target: 项目或记录页面（Arc 页头区块）的框架：顶部固定的页头，包含面包屑、带状态徽标的大号标题、描述、元信息行、操作和标签，下方是所选标签的可滚动正文。正文滚动超过 16px 时，页头折叠为紧凑栏（面包屑让位于标题及其状态；选择标题时会滚回顶部）；只有回到顶部附近（4px 以内）才会重新展开，因此不会闪烁。当面包屑可用宽度将小于 240px 时，次要操作折叠进“More actions”菜单，宽度达到 272px 时重新展开。标签计数逐位滚动，2px 指示条在标签之间滑动，面板从移动方向一侧滑入。断点依据控件自身的宽度：低于 560px 时内边距收紧，根面包屑和紧凑徽标隐藏，标题降一级字号；低于 460px 时主要操作只显示图标。移植自 Arc 的免费页头区块（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli），并改为数据驱动：标签为 `PageHeaderTab` 项（或带有 `ItemTemplate` 和 `ContentTemplate` 的数据项），操作为 `PageHeaderAction`。

trans-unit.source: Arc pagination: previous and next buttons around a sliding window of five page buttons and one current-page mark that travels between them on a morph spring. When the window moves, the numbers travel like a belt by the number of slots it moved (smooth spring), entering numbers fade in and leaving ones fade out quickly. `CurrentPage` is 1-based, two-way and clamped to `1..PageCount`; with `ShowBoundaryPages` the first and last pages stay reachable behind an ellipsis.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分页：上一页、下一页按钮之间是由五个页码按钮组成的滑动窗口，以及一个当前页标记，它会借助形变弹簧在各按钮之间移动。窗口移动时，页码会按移动的格数像传送带一样平移（平滑弹簧）；新出现的页码淡入，离开的页码快速淡出。`CurrentPage` 从 1 开始计数，双向绑定，并限制在 `1..PageCount` 范围内；启用 `ShowBoundaryPages` 后，首页与末页仍可通过省略号访问。

trans-unit.source: The current page, 1-based. Two-way; values outside `1..PageCount` are clamped for display.
trans-unit.target: 当前页码，从 1 开始。双向绑定；超出 `1..PageCount` 范围的值在显示时会被限制。

trans-unit.source: Arc password field: a labeled password input with a reveal toggle inside the frame. The toggle's eye is crossed out by a slash that draws itself (it is never swapped for a second icon), and after the first toggle every switch between dots and characters resolves in place from a light blur. Enter or Space on the toggle shows or hides the password; the toggle reports its pressed state and switches its name between `ShowPasswordText` and `HidePasswordText`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 密码输入框：带标签的密码输入框，外框内有显示切换按钮。切换按钮的眼睛图标上有一条自行绘制的斜线（从不替换为第二个图标）；首次切换之后，圆点与字符之间的每次切换都会通过轻微模糊原地过渡。在切换按钮上按 Enter 或 Space 可显示或隐藏密码；该按钮会报告其按下状态，并在 `ShowPasswordText` 与 `HidePasswordText` 之间切换其名称。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is shown.
trans-unit.target: 密码显示时切换按钮的名称。

trans-unit.source: Shows the password as text (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式显示密码（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 密码隐藏时切换按钮的名称。

trans-unit.source: Arc password strength: a new-password field that shows how strong the password is while it is typed. Four segments fill in a staggered wave and change tone, the strength word rises when strength improves and drops when it falls, each requirement checks off with a drawn tick (unmet length rules show a rolling "4 more"), and a new `ErrorMessage` shakes the field once. Scoring runs on the device through a pluggable `Scorer` (default: `PasswordStrengthEstimator`, synchronous and cheap).
trans-unit.target: Arc 密码强度：新密码输入框，在输入时即显示密码的强度。四段分段条以交错波浪的方式填充并变换色调，强度文字在强度提升时上升、下降时下降；每项要求都会以绘制的勾号逐一打勾（未满足的长度规则会显示滚动的 "4 more"）；新的 `ErrorMessage` 会让输入框抖动一次。评分在本机通过可替换的 `Scorer` 完成（默认：`PasswordStrengthEstimator`，同步且开销小）。

After blur an incomplete or too long number shows "Numbers in United Kingdom have 10 digits" unless `IsValidationEnabled` is off or an `ErrorMessage` replaces it; a valid number shows a check. In the number, Backspace / Delete on a separator delete the digit beside it.

trans-unit.source: A small surface anchored to a trigger and opened by a click, for interactive content that should not block the page: share settings, a small filter form, a picker built from your own controls. Two ways to use it: Code can open any content anchored to any control with `ShowAt`. The panel starts 5px toward its trigger at scale 0.97, fades in fast and settles on a spring from the side it actually landed on; it leaves in about 160ms at half the travel, and an open and a close reverse each other mid-flight. Escape and a press outside close it and return focus to the trigger; focus moves into the panel on open. The trigger answers presses with color only (no press scale), since the panel is measured against it.
trans-unit.target: 一个锚定在触发器上、由点击打开的小型浮层，适用于不应阻塞页面的交互内容：分享设置、小型筛选表单、由您自己的控件组成的选择器。有两种用法：代码可通过 `ShowAt` 将任意内容锚定到任意控件上打开。面板从触发器方向偏移 5px 开始，缩放比例为 0.97，快速淡入并以弹簧从实际落位的一侧稳定下来；关闭时约 160ms 内完成，移动距离为一半，且打开与关闭在过程中可相互反转。按下 Escape 或在外部按下会关闭面板，并将焦点返回触发器；打开时焦点会移入面板。触发器仅以颜色响应按下（无按压缩放），因为面板是相对于它测量的。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge (default Start).
trans-unit.target: 沿触发器边缘的对齐方式（默认 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Attaches a popover to any control: a click on the control toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 将浮层附加到任意控件上：点击该控件即可切换其显示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the popover closes (the exit may still be playing).
trans-unit.target: 浮层关闭时触发（退出动画可能仍在播放）。

trans-unit.source: Modal: presses outside are swallowed (they only close the popover). Default false.
trans-unit.target: 模态：外部按下会被拦截（仅用于关闭浮层）。默认 false。

trans-unit.source: Open state (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 开启状态（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: Gap to the trigger in px (Arc: 6).
trans-unit.target: 与触发器之间的间距，单位 px（Arc 为 6）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the popover opens.
trans-unit.target: 浮层打开时触发。

trans-unit.source: Preferred side (flips when it does not fit; the motion follows the side it lands on).
trans-unit.target: 首选方向（放不下时会翻转；动效跟随实际落位的一侧）。

trans-unit.source: The control that opens the panel, shown in place of the popover (optional with `AttachProperty` or `ShowAt`).
trans-unit.target: 打开面板的控件，显示在浮层所在位置（可选，与 `AttachProperty` 或 `ShowAt` 配合使用）。

trans-unit.source: Shows how much of a known task is complete (Arc Progress). One smooth spring drives both the fill and the counted percentage, so the number always matches the bar; the fill slides in from the left (keeping its round end) and turns to the success color at 100%, where a check settles in beside the count. `Minimum` is treated as 0 like Arc; a non-positive `Maximum` counts as 100.
trans-unit.target: 显示已知任务的完成进度（Arc 进度条）。同一个平滑弹簧同时驱动填充与计数百分比，因此数字始终与进度条一致；填充从左侧滑入（保留圆形末端），达到 100% 时变为成功色，同时一个对勾在计数旁落定。`Minimum` 与 Arc 一致，视为 0；非正数的 `Maximum` 按 100 计算。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsComplete` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `IsComplete` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Shows the counted percentage and, at 100%, a check (Arc `showValue`).
trans-unit.target: 显示计数的百分比；达到 100% 时还会显示对勾（Arc 的 `showValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Visible label above the bar; it is also the accessible name (defaults to "Progress").
trans-unit.target: 进度条上方的可见标签；同时也是无障碍名称（默认为 "Progress"）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Percentage` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Percentage` 属性。

trans-unit.source: One option of `RadioCards` (Arc `RadioCardOption`): a label with optional description, a meta value (price, estimate), a decorative icon, and a reason shown in place of the description when the option is disabled.
trans-unit.target: `RadioCards` 的一个选项（Arc 的 `RadioCardOption`）：包含标签（可选描述）、元数据值（价格、预估时长）、装饰性图标，以及选项被禁用时代替描述显示的原因。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio cards: selectable option cards for choices that need more than a label (plans, shipping speeds, regions). One selection ring springs from card to card, so the eye follows the change, and a 6px dot pops into the chosen card's indicator. Behaves as a radio group: one tab stop, arrows (mirrored in right-to-left) move and select, Home / End jump to the ends and Enter / Space select. Disabled cards are skipped and show their reason. Cards come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioCardOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's value.
trans-unit.target: Arc 单选卡片：用于需要超过文字标签的选择（套餐、配送速度、地区）的可选选项卡片。单个选中环会从一张卡片弹向另一张，让视线跟随变化；选中卡片的指示器中会弹出一个 6px 的圆点。其行为与单选组一致：只有一个 Tab 停靠点，方向键（在从右到左的布局中镜像）移动并选中，Home / End 跳到两端，Enter / Space 选中。禁用的卡片会被跳过，并显示其原因。卡片来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `RadioCardOption` 项；`SelectedValue`（双向绑定）为所选选项的值。

trans-unit.source: A choice is required (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 必须进行选择（会告知辅助技术）。

trans-unit.source: Card placement: Grid (responsive columns, the default) or List (full-width rows with the meta at the end).
trans-unit.target: 卡片排列方式：Grid（响应式列，默认）或 List（全宽行，元信息位于末尾）。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a grid column may get before the grid drops a column (Arc default 180).
trans-unit.target: 网格列可收窄到的最小宽度，低于此宽度时网格会减少一列（Arc 默认 180）。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio group: choose one option from a visible set. One highlight (a `ControlOn` border with a faint fill) glides to the chosen row on the morph spring while the new dot springs in and the old one shrinks away, so a change reads as a single physical move. Arrow keys take the same path; the group is one tab stop (the selected row). Options come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's `Value`. The `Header` is the legend and the group's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: Arc 单选组：从一组可见选项中选择其一。一个高亮框（`ControlOn` 边框加淡色填充）会以形变弹簧滑动到所选行，新的圆点弹入，旧的圆点缩小消失，因此变化看起来像一次连贯的物理移动。方向键走同样的路径；整个组只有一个 Tab 停靠点（所选行）。选项来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `RadioOption` 项；`SelectedValue`（双向绑定）为所选选项的 `Value`。`Header` 为图例，也是该组的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `RadioGroup` (Arc `{ value, label, description? }`). Use it in `ItemsSource` or inline in XAML; the group reports `Value` as its `SelectedValue`.
trans-unit.target: `RadioGroup` 的一个选项（Arc 的 `{ value, label, description? }`）。可用于 `ItemsSource` 或 XAML 内联；该组会将 `Value` 作为其 `SelectedValue` 报告。

trans-unit.source: The state of one reaction (Arc's `Reaction`): how many people chose it and whether the viewer did. A reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.
trans-unit.target: 单个回应的状态（Arc 的 `Reaction`）：选择它的人数，以及观看者是否已选择。计数降为零的回应会离开回应栏。

trans-unit.source: One reaction the picker offers (Arc's `ReactionOption`): an id, a label and a 24×24 Lucide glyph.
trans-unit.target: 选取器提供的一个回应（Arc 的 `ReactionOption`）：包含 id、标签和一个 24×24 的 Lucide 图形。

trans-unit.source: Arc reactions: a bar of reaction pills with counts plus an add button that opens a compact picker, like Slack's reactions on a comment, post or release note. One tap adds or removes the viewer's reaction: the count rolls (only the digits that change, in the direction it moved), the icon gets a velocity kick that stacks on quick taps (P27), the viewer's own reactions take the accent and a filled glyph. Pills scale in out of a blur and leave the bar when their count reaches zero while the rest glide into place (P26, P19); a new row grows the bar on a spring (P6). Hovering or focusing a pill shows its label and who reacted (`Tooltip`). Keyboard: Enter / Space toggles a pill or opens the picker; in the picker every arrow moves and wraps, Home / End jump, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button. Each change is announced politely.
trans-unit.target: Arc 回应：一排带计数的回应胶囊，以及一个打开紧凑选取器的添加按钮，类似 Slack 在评论、帖子或发布说明上的回应。单击即可添加或移除观看者的回应：计数滚动（仅滚动变化的数字，方向与变化方向一致），图标会获得速度冲击，快速连点时叠加（P27）；观看者自己的回应使用强调色和实心图形。胶囊从模糊中缩放出现，计数降为零时离开回应栏，其余胶囊滑动就位（P26、P19）；新增一行时，回应栏会以弹簧扩展（P6）。悬停或聚焦到胶囊上会显示其标签以及谁做出了回应（`Tooltip`）。键盘操作：Enter / Space 切换胶囊或打开选取器；在选取器中，所有方向键都会移动并循环，Home / End 跳转，Enter 选取，Escape 关闭并将焦点返回添加按钮。每次变化都会以礼貌方式通报。

trans-unit.source: Name and tooltip of the add button (default "Add reaction").
trans-unit.target: 添加按钮的名称与提示（默认 "Add reaction"）。

trans-unit.source: True while the picker is open.
trans-unit.target: 选取器打开时为 true。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the bar (default "Reactions").
trans-unit.target: 回应栏的无障碍名称（默认 "Reactions"）。

trans-unit.source: Every reaction the picker offers, in picker order (inline children or a bound list).
trans-unit.target: 选取器提供的所有回应，按选取器中的顺序排列（内联子项或绑定列表）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the picker tray (default "Add a reaction").
trans-unit.target: 选取器托盘的无障碍名称（默认 "Add a reaction"）。

trans-unit.source: Gap between the picker and the add button (the theme sets Arc's sideOffset 8).
trans-unit.target: 选取器与添加按钮之间的间距（主题设置 Arc 的 sideOffset 为 8）。

trans-unit.source: How long a pointer rests on a pill before its tooltip shows (the theme sets Arc's 0.45s).
trans-unit.target: 指针停留在回应胶囊上多久后显示其提示（主题设置 Arc 的 0.45s）。

trans-unit.source: Builds a pill's tooltip from its option and reaction; null uses the label followed by who reacted ("Love · You, Ada and 2 others").
trans-unit.target: 根据选项与回应构建胶囊的提示；为 null 时使用标签加上谁做出了回应（"Love · You, Ada and 2 others"）。

trans-unit.source: The reactions shown, in bar order (two-way). A reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.
trans-unit.target: 显示的回应，按回应栏中的顺序排列（双向绑定）。计数降为零的回应会离开回应栏。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the viewer adds or removes a reaction (Arc's onValueChange), after `Value` changed.
trans-unit.target: 观看者添加或移除回应时触发（Arc 的 onValueChange），在 `Value` 变化之后。

trans-unit.source: Arc's reorderable list: organize items with direct drag and drop. Rows are dragged by their grip (pointer capture): the row lifts, follows the pointer, the rows it passes slide aside on springs and the drop settles on a quick spring with the release velocity; holding a row near the edge of a scrolling ancestor scrolls it. Keyboard: ↑/↓ on a grip moves the row one place at once (Arc), Space / Enter picks it up so arrows preview the move, Space / Enter drops it and Escape cancels; every step is announced. A mutable `ItemsSource` (or inline items) is reordered in place; `Reordered` reports each move. Drag motion is render transforms only.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可重排列表：通过直接拖放整理项目。行通过抓手拖动（指针捕获）：行会抬起并跟随指针，经过的行会以弹簧滑开，释放时以快速弹簧结合释放速度落定；将行按住在滚动祖先的边缘附近会滚动它。键盘操作：抓手上的 ↑/↓ 会立即将该行移动一位（与 Arc 一致），Space / Enter 拾起该行，此时方向键可预览移动，Space / Enter 放下，Escape 取消；每一步都会被通报。可变的 `ItemsSource`（或内联项）会就地重新排序；`Reordered` 报告每次移动。拖动动效仅使用渲染变换。

trans-unit.source: Title used in the grip's accessible name and in announcements (defaults to `Title` or the item text).
trans-unit.target: 用于抓手无障碍名称与通报的标题（默认为 `Title` 或项目文本）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list.
trans-unit.target: 列表的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) a mutable source is reordered in place; otherwise only `Reordered` is raised.
trans-unit.target: 为 true（默认）时，可变的数据源会就地重新排序；否则仅引发 `Reordered`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a row was moved by dragging or from the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 通过拖动或键盘移动某一行之后引发。

trans-unit.source: A row of a `ReorderableList` as Arc models it: an id, a title and an optional detail line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 建模的 `ReorderableList` 中的一行：包含一个 id、一个标题和一个可选的详细信息行。

trans-unit.source: One pane of a `ResizablePanels` group. It carries the pane's configuration (label, default share, limits, collapsibility) and shows its content. Below its minimum the content keeps its minimum width, stays anchored to the moving edge and fades, so a closing pane slides away like a drawer instead of being crushed.
trans-unit.target: `ResizablePanels` 组中的一个窗格。它承载窗格的配置（标签、默认占比、限制、是否可折叠）并显示其内容。低于最小尺寸时，内容保持最小宽度，锚定在移动的边缘并淡出，因此关闭中的窗格会像抽屉一样滑走，而不是被挤压。

trans-unit.source: Starting share of the group; shares are relative and need not add up to 100.
trans-unit.target: 组的起始占比；占比为相对值，不必加起来等于 100。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (dividers reference panes by id).
trans-unit.target: 稳定的 id（分隔线通过 id 引用窗格）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pane is hidden. Two-way; the initial value is Arc's defaultCollapsed (needs `IsCollapsible`).
trans-unit.target: 窗格是否已隐藏。双向绑定；初始值取 Arc 的 defaultCollapsed（需要 `IsCollapsible`）。

trans-unit.source: Dragging well past the minimum, or flicking toward the edge, snaps the pane closed.
trans-unit.target: 拖动明显超过最小尺寸，或朝边缘快速轻扫时，窗格会吸附关闭。

trans-unit.source: Names the pane for its divider, for example "Folders".
trans-unit.target: 为分隔线标注该窗格的名称，例如 "Folders"。

trans-unit.source: Maximum width in px (infinite by default).
trans-unit.target: 最大宽度，单位为 px（默认无限制）。

trans-unit.source: Width in px where the pane starts to resist (Arc: 80). Its content never reflows below it.
trans-unit.target: 窗格开始产生阻力的宽度，单位为 px（Arc 为 80）。低于此宽度时内容不会重排。

trans-unit.source: Arc resizable panels: a horizontal split view whose panes trade space when the dividers between them are dragged, the way a mail or code editor window works. Dividers follow the pointer 1:1, resist past a pane's limits (rubber band up to 44px) and snap collapsible panes closed when dragged well past their minimum or flicked toward the edge; on release the panes settle on the smooth spring keeping the pointer's velocity. Each divider is focusable: arrows resize by 16px (Shift 64px) on the snappy spring, Home / End jump to the limits, Enter hides or restores a collapsible neighbour, Escape during a drag puts the divider back, and a double-click resets the layout. The group needs a definite height. `Sizes` (two-way, percent) persists the layout.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可调整大小的窗格：水平分割视图，拖动其间的分隔线时窗格之间相互让出空间，与邮件或代码编辑器窗口的方式相同。分隔线以 1:1 紧随指针，超出窗格限制时产生回弹（最多 44px）；拖到明显超过最小尺寸，或朝边缘快速轻扫时，可折叠窗格会吸附关闭。松开后，窗格会以保留指针速度的平滑弹簧稳定下来。每条分隔线都可获得焦点：方向键每次调整 16px（按住 Shift 为 64px），使用灵敏弹簧；Home / End 跳到限制位置；Enter 隐藏或恢复可折叠的相邻窗格；拖动过程中按 Escape 会将分隔线复位；双击会重置布局。该组需要确定的高度。`Sizes`（双向，百分比）用于保存布局。

trans-unit.source: Names the group for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 为该组命名，供辅助技术使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised with each pane's share in percent after a resize settles.
trans-unit.target: 调整大小稳定后引发，附带每个窗格的占比（百分比）。

trans-unit.source: Each pane's share in percent. Updated after every resize settles; set it (for example from saved settings) to restore a layout. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 每个窗格的占比（百分比）。每次调整大小稳定后更新；设置它（例如从保存的设置中读取）即可恢复布局。双向绑定。

trans-unit.source: Arc's light rich text editor: Markdown shortcuts as you type, a floating selection toolbar that morphs into a link field, a slash menu for blocks, its own undo history, and HTML plus Markdown output. Blocks are paragraphs, three heading levels, nested bulleted and numbered lists, quotes, code blocks and dividers; inline marks are bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code and links.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的轻量富文本编辑器：输入时支持 Markdown 快捷语法，浮动的选区工具栏可变形为链接输入框，斜杠菜单用于插入块，拥有独立的撤销历史，并支持 HTML 和 Markdown 输出。块包括段落、三级标题、嵌套的无序和有序列表、引用、代码块和分隔线；行内标记包括粗体、斜体、删除线、行内代码和链接。

trans-unit.source: A ridgeline (joy plot, Arc "Ridgeline"): one smoothed density curve per group, overlapping like ridges and shaded by median. Every curve is sampled on a shared 96-point grid, so a new dataset or domain morphs each ridge from its on-screen shape on one 0.7s spring; the first view rolls the rows in from the top. Hover or ↑ / ↓ lifts a ridge (a copy drawn above the rest) with its middle half and median; ← / → move a reading cursor along the values.
trans-unit.target: 山脊图（joy plot，即 Arc 的 "Ridgeline"）：每组一条平滑的密度曲线，像山脊一样相互重叠，并按中位数着色。所有曲线都在共享的 96 点网格上采样，因此新的数据集或取值范围会通过一个 0.7s 的弹簧，使每条山脊从当前屏幕形状变形过渡；首次显示时各行从顶部滚入。悬停或按 ↑ / ↓ 可抬起一条山脊（在其他山脊上方绘制一份副本），并显示其中间一半和中位数；← / → 沿数值移动读数光标。

trans-unit.source: Arc scroll area: native scrolling (wheel, keyboard, touch inertia, snap points) with thin overlay scrollbars that appear while scrolling or hovering and fade away at rest, and edge fades that appear only where content continues, each exactly as long as the content hidden past that edge (up to `FadeLength`). The thumb thickens under the pointer, can be dragged, and pressing the track pages toward the pointer.
trans-unit.target: Arc 滚动区域：原生滚动（滚轮、键盘、触摸惯性、吸附点），搭配细窄的覆盖式滚动条，滚动或悬停时出现、静止时淡出；边缘淡出仅在内容继续延伸处出现，每段淡出的长度与该边缘之外被隐藏的内容相符（最长为 `FadeLength`）。滚动条滑块在指针下方会变粗、可拖动，按下轨道会朝指针方向翻页。

trans-unit.source: Arc's Scrub input: a compact, Figma-style number field for inspectors and property panels. Drag the label sideways to scrub the value (Shift ten times coarser, Alt ten times finer, switching live and shown in a tag above the field), or click in and type an exact value: entries accept arithmetic such as `12*2` or `(100-24)/2` and a unit from `Units` such as `50%` (see `ScrubExpression`). Arrow keys step, Enter commits, Escape restores the last value, and a double click on the label restores `ResetValue`. At `Minimum` and `Maximum` the field strains past the limit with rubber band resistance and springs back on release; a rejected entry shakes and turns the edge red for 900ms. The row has no label or message rows of its own (the label is the drag handle) and fills its column by default.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的 Scrub 输入框：紧凑的 Figma 风格数字字段，适用于检查器和属性面板。横向拖动标签即可调整数值（按住 Shift 时粗 10 倍，按住 Alt 时细 10 倍，切换时实时生效，并在字段上方的提示中显示），也可以点击进入并输入精确值：输入内容支持 `12*2` 或 `(100-24)/2` 等算术表达式，以及 `Units` 中的单位，例如 `50%`（参见 `ScrubExpression`）。方向键逐步调整，Enter 提交，Escape 恢复上一个值，双击标签会恢复 `ResetValue`。到达 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 时，字段会以橡皮筋式阻力越过限制，松开后回弹；被拒绝的输入会抖动，并将边缘变为红色 900ms。该行本身没有标签或消息行（标签即拖动手柄），默认填满其所在列。

trans-unit.source: Step with Shift held (null: ten times `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Shift 时的步长（null：为 `Step` 的 10 倍）。

trans-unit.source: Step with Alt held (null: a tenth of `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Alt 时的步长（null：为 `Step` 的十分之一）。

trans-unit.source: True for 900ms after a rejected entry.
trans-unit.target: 被拒绝的输入之后的 900ms 内为 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc's `pointerLock`, kept for API parity (default true). Avalonia has no pointer lock, so scrubbing always uses normal pointer capture, as Arc does when a browser refuses the lock: a long drag can reach the screen edge.
trans-unit.target: 对应 Arc 的 `pointerLock`，仅为保持 API 一致而保留（默认 true）。Avalonia 没有指针锁定，因此调整数值时始终使用普通的指针捕获，与浏览器拒绝锁定时 Arc 的做法相同：长距离拖动可能会到达屏幕边缘。

trans-unit.source: True while the label is being dragged.
trans-unit.target: 拖动标签期间为 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value's position between the limits as a quiet wash (null: on when both limits are finite).
trans-unit.target: 以柔和的底色显示数值在上下限之间的位置（null：两个上下限均为有限值时显示）。

trans-unit.source: Values wrap from the maximum to the minimum instead of stopping (needs both limits, Maximum > Minimum).
trans-unit.target: 数值从最大值回绕到最小值，而不是停止（需要两个上下限，且 Maximum > Minimum）。

trans-unit.source: The label, which is also the drag handle: text (weight 500) or a control such as a 14px `ArcGlyph`.
trans-unit.target: 标签，同时也是拖动手柄：文本（字重 500）或控件，例如 14px 的 `ArcGlyph`。

trans-unit.source: Raised for every real change of `Value`: each step of a scrub, typed entries, key steps and resets (Arc's `onValueChange`), and values set from code or a binding (`Programmatic`).

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a change settles: a scrub ends (or is cancelled), Enter or blur commits typing, a key step lands, or a reset. Like Arc it also fires when a commit leaves the value unchanged (a clamped entry at the limit).
trans-unit.target: 变化稳定后引发一次：拖动结束（或被取消）、按下 Enter 或失焦提交输入、方向键步进落定，或重置时。与 Arc 一致，即使提交后值未变（例如在上限处被钳制的输入）也会引发。

trans-unit.source: Arc search field: a labeled search input with a leading glass that wakes up (full contrast) while the field is focused or filled, and a clear button that pops into a reserved slot, so the field never changes width. Every keystroke updates the two-way `Text` (debounce expensive filtering yourself); Escape clears the field, Enter raises `SearchSubmitted`, and clearing with the button returns focus to the field.
trans-unit.target: Arc 搜索框：带标签的搜索输入框，左侧的放大镜图标在字段获得焦点或已填入内容时亮起（全对比度），清除按钮会出现在预留的位置，因此字段宽度永远不会改变。每次击键都会更新双向绑定的 `Text`（开销大的过滤请自行做防抖处理）；Escape 清空字段，Enter 引发 `SearchSubmitted`，用按钮清空后焦点会回到字段。
