trans-unit.source: A search results page for a workspace (an original TKCode design, after Algolia InstantSearch's search box, hits, highlight, refinement list and stats). A large search field, facet tabs for the kinds of content with live counts that roll as you type, a stats line, and the results: grouped by kind under All (a few per group with "See all"), or one kind at a time with "Show more". Every term of the query must match; matches are marked in titles and in a snippet window cut around the first match. One cursor block glides between the results: ArrowDown leaves the field for the list, arrows, Home, End and the page keys move it, Enter opens a result. Set `IsFilteringEnabled` to false when a server searches (counts and highlights still follow the query), and `IsLoading` while it does.
trans-unit.target: 工作区的搜索结果页（TKCode 原创设计，参考了 Algolia InstantSearch 的搜索框、命中结果、高亮、筛选列表和统计信息）。顶部是一个大型搜索框；各类内容的分面标签带有实时计数，输入时计数会滚动更新；下方是统计信息行和结果：在 All 下按类型分组显示（每组若干条，并附有“See all”），或每次只显示一种类型并附有“Show more”。查询的每个词都必须匹配；匹配内容会在标题中，以及围绕首个匹配项截取的摘要窗口中高亮标出。一个光标块在结果之间滑动：ArrowDown 将焦点从搜索框移到列表，方向键、Home、End 和翻页键移动光标，Enter 打开结果。由服务器负责搜索时，请将 `IsFilteringEnabled` 设为 false（计数和高亮仍会跟随查询），搜索进行时设置 `IsLoading`。

trans-unit.source: The result under the cursor, or null.
trans-unit.target: 游标所在的结果，或为 null。

trans-unit.source: Label of the facet that shows every kind.
trans-unit.target: 显示全部类型的分面的标签。

trans-unit.source: Empty state description when no facet has results.
trans-unit.target: 没有任何分面有结果时的空状态描述。

trans-unit.source: Empty state title; {0} is the query. Default "No results for “{0}”".
trans-unit.target: 空状态标题；{0} 为查询内容。默认为“No results for “{0}””。

trans-unit.source: Results shown per group under All before "See all N"; at least 1. Default 3.
trans-unit.target: 在 All 下，每组在“See all N”出现之前显示的结果数；至少为 1。默认为 3。

trans-unit.source: Executed with the opened `SearchResultItem`.
trans-unit.target: 以被打开的 `SearchResultItem` 执行。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) the items are matched and ranked here. Set it to false when a server searched: the items are shown as given and counted per kind, and the query's terms are still marked.
trans-unit.target: 为 true（默认）时，项目在此处进行匹配和排序。当服务器负责搜索时将其设为 false：项目会按原样显示并按类型计数，查询词仍会被高亮标出。

trans-unit.source: Shows skeleton rows in place of the results (keeping the previous results' height).
trans-unit.target: 以骨架行代替结果显示（保持先前结果的高度）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a result is opened with Enter or a click.
trans-unit.target: 通过 Enter 或点击打开结果时引发。

trans-unit.source: Items to search; when null the inline `Items` are used. Collection changes are followed.
trans-unit.target: 要搜索的项目；为 null 时使用内联的 `Items`。会跟随集合的变化。

trans-unit.source: Names the search landmark and the search field.
trans-unit.target: 为搜索地标与搜索字段指定名称。

trans-unit.source: Stats text while `IsLoading` is true. Default "Searching…".
trans-unit.target: `IsLoading` 为 true 时的统计信息文本。默认为“Searching…”。

trans-unit.source: Stats text (and empty title without a query) when nothing matches. Default "No results".
trans-unit.target: 没有任何匹配时的统计信息文本（无查询时也用作空状态标题）。默认为“No results”。

trans-unit.source: Stats text for one result. Default "1 result".
trans-unit.target: 只有一条结果时的统计信息文本。默认为“1 result”。

trans-unit.source: Empty state description when the current facet is empty but another is not; {0} is the count text ("4 results") and {1} the kind with the most results. Default "{0} in {1}.".
trans-unit.target: 当前分面为空而其他分面有结果时的空状态描述；{0} 为计数文本（“4 results”），{1} 为结果最多的类型。默认为“{0} in {1}.”。

trans-unit.source: Facet and group label of items without a `Kind`.
trans-unit.target: 没有 `Kind` 的项目所用的分面及分组标签。

trans-unit.source: Results first shown for a single facet; "Show more" adds as many again. Default 20.
trans-unit.target: 单个分面下首次显示的结果数；“Show more”每次再追加同样数量。默认为 20。

trans-unit.source: Hint in the empty search field.
trans-unit.target: 搜索框为空时的提示文字。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜索框中的文本（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The number of results in the current facet for the current query.
trans-unit.target: 当前查询在当前分面中的结果数量。

trans-unit.source: Stats text for several results; {0} is the count. Default "{0} results".
trans-unit.target: 多条结果时的统计信息文本；{0} 为数量。默认为“{0} results”。

trans-unit.source: Button in the empty state that switches back to All. Default "Search all".
trans-unit.target: 空状态中用于切换回 All 的按钮。默认为“Search all”。

trans-unit.source: Link under a group in All; {0} is the count and {1} the kind. Default "See all {0} {1}".
trans-unit.target: All 中每组下方的链接；{0} 为数量，{1} 为类型。默认为“See all {0} {1}”。

trans-unit.source: The current facet: a `Kind`, or null for All (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 当前分面：某个 `Kind`；选择 All 时为 null（双向）。

trans-unit.source: Button under a single facet's results when more are left. Default "Show more".
trans-unit.target: 单个分面结果下方的按钮，在仍有剩余结果时显示。默认为“Show more”。

trans-unit.source: Queries offered when nothing matches; choosing one fills the search field.
trans-unit.target: 没有任何匹配时提供的查询建议；选择其中一项会填入搜索框。

trans-unit.source: The word before the suggestions. Default "Try".
trans-unit.target: 建议列表之前的提示词。默认为“Try”。

trans-unit.source: The account security page: a checkup of four safeguards (password, two-step verification, passkeys, recovery codes), the password with a change form that opens in place, the two-step methods, and every signed-in session with a way to sign it out. Each action happens on the page; the host hears about it through routed events.
trans-unit.target: 账户安全设置页：检查四项安全保障（密码、两步验证、通行密钥、恢复码），提供可就地展开的密码修改表单、两步验证方式，以及所有登录会话，并可将其退出登录。每项操作都在页面内完成，宿主通过路由事件获知。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "Add passkey" is pressed; the host runs the passkey ceremony and updates `PasskeyCount`.
trans-unit.target: 按下“添加通行密钥”时引发；宿主执行通行密钥流程并更新 `PasskeyCount`。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the meter moves under the summary text and "Sign out other sessions" moves under the list (default 560).
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度时，进度条移至摘要文本下方，“退出其他登录会话”移至列表下方（默认 560）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the account has a password (default true). Without one the row offers "Set password" and the form asks only for the new password; a successful change sets it to true (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 账户是否已设置密码（默认为 true）。未设置时，该设置行提供“设置密码”，表单仅要求输入新密码；修改成功后将其设为 true（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins ask for a code from an authenticator app (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登录时要求输入验证器应用中的验证码（双向绑定，跟随其开关）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the password form is open.
trans-unit.target: 是否已展开密码表单。

trans-unit.source: Whether the security checkup card is shown at the top (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否在顶部显示安全检查卡片（默认为 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins send a code by text message (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登录时通过短信发送验证码（双向绑定，跟随其开关）。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text and the culture for dates; replace the whole object to localize.
trans-unit.target: 所有内置文本以及日期区域设置；替换整个对象即可本地化。

trans-unit.source: Raised after "Sign out other sessions" was confirmed and every other session's row has left.
trans-unit.target: 在“退出其他登录会话”获得确认且其他会话的各行均已移除后引发。

trans-unit.source: How many passkeys the account has.
trans-unit.target: 账户拥有的通行密钥数量。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the password form is submitted. Set `ErrorMessage` to reject it.
trans-unit.target: 提交密码表单时引发。设置 `ErrorMessage` 可拒绝此次提交。

trans-unit.source: When the password was last changed; null reads "Never changed". Set to the clock's time after a successful change (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 密码最后一次修改的时间；为 null 时显示“从未修改”。修改成功后设为时钟的当前时间（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: The phone number for text messages; only its last four digits are shown ("•••• 4821"). Without one the text message switch is disabled.
trans-unit.target: 短信使用的电话号码；仅显示末四位（“•••• 4821”）。没有号码时，短信开关会被禁用。

trans-unit.source: How many of the four safeguards are on (0–4): a password, two-step verification by either method, at least one passkey, and recovery codes.
trans-unit.target: 四项安全防护中已开启的数量（0–4）：密码、任一方式的两步验证、至少一个通行密钥，以及恢复码。

trans-unit.source: When the recovery codes were created; null means there are none.
trans-unit.target: 恢复码的创建时间；null 表示没有恢复码。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "View codes" or "Create codes" is pressed; the host shows or creates the codes and updates `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`.
trans-unit.target: 按下“查看恢复码”或“创建恢复码”时引发；宿主应用会显示或创建恢复码，并更新 `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`。

trans-unit.source: Which cards are shown (default all): show only the sessions, or only the password, on a page of your own.
trans-unit.target: 显示哪些卡片（默认全部）。例如在自己的页面上只显示登录会话，或只显示密码。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a session's "Sign out" row has left and the session was taken off `Sessions`.
trans-unit.target: 登录会话的“退出登录”行离开，且该会话已从 `Sessions` 中移除后引发。

trans-unit.source: The signed-in sessions, listed current first, then by most recent activity. A signed-out session leaves its row and is removed from this list when the list can be changed. Defaults to an empty observable list.
trans-unit.target: 已登录的会话，当前会话排在最前，其余按最近活动时间排序。已退出登录的会话会离开其行，并在列表可以修改时从此列表中移除。默认为空的可观察列表。

trans-unit.source: Arc segmented control: a row of buttons for switching between a small set of related views. One selection pill glides between them on the morph spring; segments never scale or change weight, only their label color follows. Arrows (wrapping), Home and End move the selection like a tab list and only the selected segment is a tab stop. When the options are wider than the control the row scrolls inside itself with faded edges, and the selected segment is always scrolled fully into view. `ItemIntent` fires when the pointer or focus reaches a segment before it is chosen (preload what it shows).
trans-unit.target: Arc 分段控件：一排按钮，用于在一小组相关视图之间切换。选中的胶囊会在变形弹簧上于各段之间滑动；分段从不缩放或改变字重，只有标签颜色随之变化。方向键（循环）、Home 和 End 会像标签列表一样移动选中项，且只有选中的分段才是 Tab 停靠点。当选项宽于控件时，该行会在内部滚动并带有淡出的边缘，选中的分段总是被完整滚动到可见范围内。`ItemIntent` 会在指针或焦点到达某个分段、但尚未被选中之前引发（可用于预加载其内容）。

trans-unit.source: The pointer or keyboard focus reached a segment (it may not be selected yet).
trans-unit.target: 指针或键盘焦点已到达某个分段（该分段可能尚未被选中）。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `SegmentedControl` (Arc `Segment`): a short label and optional accessory.
trans-unit.target: `SegmentedControl` 的一个选项（Arc 的 `Segment`）：一个简短的标签和可选的附件。

trans-unit.source: Arc select: a labelled, compact choice field with a keyboard friendly menu (Radix Select semantics). The shown value rolls in the direction of the list, the menu drops from the trigger, a highlight glides between options and the chosen option carries a check. Use it for short, fixed lists such as regions or sort orders. Options come from `ItemsSource` (any objects, `SelectOption` records) or inline `SelectItem` children; labels use `TextSelector`, `DisplayMemberBinding` or `ToString()`, values use `ValueSelector`, `SelectedValueBinding` or the item. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move the highlight; Enter or Space picks; Escape closes without a change; typing jumps to the next matching option (and picks it directly while the menu is closed).
trans-unit.target: Arc 选择框：带标签的紧凑型选择字段，配有对键盘友好的菜单（Radix Select 语义）。显示的值会沿列表方向滚动切换，菜单从触发器处展开，高亮在选项之间滑动，所选选项带有勾选标记。适用于地区或排序方式等简短的固定列表。选项来自 `ItemsSource`（任意对象，或 `SelectOption` 记录）或内联的 `SelectItem` 子元素；标签使用 `TextSelector`、`DisplayMemberBinding` 或 `ToString()`，值使用 `ValueSelector`、`SelectedValueBinding` 或选项本身。键盘操作：Enter、Space 和方向键可打开；方向键、Home / End 和 PageUp / PageDown 移动高亮；Enter 或 Space 选中；Escape 关闭且不做更改；键入字符会跳到下一个匹配的选项（菜单关闭时则直接选中该选项）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Description` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Description` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `DisabledSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `DisabledSelector` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsOpen` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `IsOpen` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Label` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxDropDownHeight` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `MaxDropDownHeight` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Placeholder` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Placeholder` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SelectedText` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `SelectedText` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `TextSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `TextSelector` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ValueSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `ValueSelector` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Declares one option of a `Select`, `Combobox`, `MultiSelect`, `MorphSelect` or `ChipGroup` inline in XAML: `<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`. The owning control draws the option itself (virtualized and filtered without containers), so this element only carries data; set `IsEnabled` to false for an option that can be seen but not picked.
trans-unit.target: 在 XAML 中以内联方式声明 `Select`、`Combobox`、`MultiSelect`、`MorphSelect` 或 `ChipGroup` 的一个选项：`<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`。所属控件自行绘制选项（虚拟化且过滤时无需容器），因此此元素只承载数据；若选项需要可见但不可选，请将 `IsEnabled` 设为 false。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Content` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Content` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Group` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Group` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Icon` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Icon` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Keywords` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Keywords` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Meta` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Meta` 属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Value` property.
trans-unit.target: 定义 `Value` 属性。

trans-unit.source: A plain option record for `ItemsSource` lists that every select in this category understands without selectors: `new SelectOption("us", "United States")`.
trans-unit.target: 供 `ItemsSource` 列表使用的普通选项记录，该分类中的所有选择框无需选择器即可识别：`new SelectOption("us", "United States")`。

trans-unit.source: A settings command palette: one search field that finds any setting and changes it in place. Toggles flip, choices cycle through their options and actions run, all without leaving the keyboard; focus stays in the search field while the arrow keys move a highlight that glides between rows. A notice in the footer confirms each change. Write the settings inline (`SettingsCommandToggle`, `SettingsCommandChoice`, `SettingsCommandAction`) or bind `Items`. Their values are styled properties, so `IsChecked` and `SelectedOption` bind two-way and the rows follow changes made elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: 设置命令面板：一个搜索框，可以找到任意设置并原位修改。开关会翻转，选项会在各个可选值之间循环，操作会直接执行，全程无需离开键盘；焦点保持在搜索框中，方向键移动高亮，高亮在各设置行之间滑动。页脚的提示会确认每次修改。可以内联编写设置（`SettingsCommandToggle`、`SettingsCommandChoice`、`SettingsCommandAction`），也可以绑定 `Items`。它们的值是样式属性，因此 `IsChecked` 和 `SelectedOption` 支持双向绑定，各设置行会跟随其他地方的修改。

trans-unit.source: The highlighted setting that Enter acts on, or null when nothing is on show.
trans-unit.target: 高亮的设置，按 Enter 即对其执行操作；没有可显示的设置时为 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Escape is pressed with an empty query: close the palette. Mark it handled so a surrounding Dialog does not handle the same Escape again.
trans-unit.target: 在查询为空时按下 Escape 时引发，用于关闭面板。将其标记为已处理，使外层的 Dialog 不会再次处理同一次 Escape。

trans-unit.source: Whether the palette draws its own panel (surface, border, radius and floating shadow). Turn it off inside a Dialog or another surface.
trans-unit.target: 是否由面板自行绘制外框（底色、边框、圆角和浮动阴影）。在 Dialog 或其他容器中使用时请关闭。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is invoked with Enter or a click, after its command ran.
trans-unit.target: 通过 Enter 或点击调用操作时引发，在其命令执行之后。

trans-unit.source: The settings to search, in the order they are listed when the query is empty.
trans-unit.target: 要搜索的设置，查询为空时按此顺序列出。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the whole object to localize the palette.
trans-unit.target: 内置文本；如需本地化面板，请替换整个对象。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜索框中的文本（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: The tallest the result list gets before it scrolls.
trans-unit.target: 结果列表在出现滚动之前可达到的最大高度。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user changes a toggle or a choice (not when the app sets the value).
trans-unit.target: 用户修改开关或选项时引发（应用通过代码设置值时不引发）。

trans-unit.source: A command such as "Change email" or "Sign out everywhere". Enter or a click runs `Command`, then the palette raises `ItemInvoked`. The row shows the `Shortcut` in key caps and, for links to another page, an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 一条命令，例如“修改邮箱”或“在所有设备上退出登录”。按 Enter 或点击会执行 `Command`，然后面板引发 `ItemInvoked`。该设置行以键帽形式显示 `Shortcut`；如果是跳转到其他页面的链接，则显示箭头。

trans-unit.source: The command to run.
trans-unit.target: 要执行的命令。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 传递给 `Command` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: Whether the action opens another page; the row shows an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 是否打开其他页面；设置行会显示箭头。

trans-unit.source: The app's shortcut for the action, shown in key caps, such as "mod+shift+d" (Command on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) or "Ctrl+,". The palette only shows it; the app handles the shortcut itself.
trans-unit.target: 应用为该操作设置的快捷键，以键帽形式显示，例如“mod+shift+d”（Mac 上为 Command，其他平台为 Ctrl）或“Ctrl+,”。面板只负责显示，快捷键由应用自行处理。

trans-unit.source: A setting with a few named values. Enter or a click moves to the next option (after the last comes the first); the left and right arrow keys, and the arrows beside the value, step without wrapping.
trans-unit.target: 具有若干命名值的设置。按 Enter 或点击切换到下一个选项（最后一个之后回到第一个）；左右方向键以及值旁边的箭头逐项移动，不循环。

trans-unit.source: The values in order. In XAML a comma-separated string works: `Options="Light, Dark, System"`.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序排列的值。在 XAML 中可以使用逗号分隔的字符串：`Options="Light, Dark, System"`。

trans-unit.source: The current value (two-way). When null it becomes the first option.
trans-unit.target: 当前值（双向绑定）。为 null 时变为第一个选项。

trans-unit.source: One line under the header (trimmed to a single line); also searched.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的一行文字（会截断为单行）；同时参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: The group the row is listed under, such as "Appearance"; also searched. Without one it is listed under "Settings" when other settings have a group.
trans-unit.target: 该设置行所在的分组，例如“外观”；同时参与搜索。未指定分组时，若其他设置有分组，则归入“设置”。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in the row and searched first.
trans-unit.target: 设置的名称，显示在设置行中，并优先参与搜索。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 描边图标（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成员），显示在标题前的图块中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting can be changed. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 是否可以修改该设置。禁用的设置行会变暗，并在键盘导航中被跳过。

trans-unit.source: Other words that find the setting (synonyms separated by spaces or commas), such as "dark light appearance".
trans-unit.target: 其他能搜到该设置的词语（用空格或逗号分隔的同义词），例如“深色 浅色 外观”。

trans-unit.source: An on / off setting. Enter or a click flips `IsChecked`; the row shows a switch.
trans-unit.target: 开 / 关设置。按 Enter 或点击会切换 `IsChecked`；该设置行会显示开关。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting is on (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 是否开启该设置（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: A group of related settings: an optional header with a description and actions, a stack of rows (usually `SettingsRow`, written inline or bound through `ItemsSource`), and an optional footer strip for a note or a save button. Drawn as a card by default, or plain inside a page.
trans-unit.target: 一组相关设置：可选的标题（含描述和操作）、一组设置行（通常为 `SettingsRow`，可直接写在 XAML 中，或通过 `ItemsSource` 绑定），以及可选的底部条，用于放置备注或保存按钮。默认以卡片形式绘制，在页面中则为平铺。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) or Plain.
trans-unit.target: 卡片（默认）或平铺。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方的一句说明。

trans-unit.source: Content of the strip under the rows, such as a note and a save button.
trans-unit.target: 设置行下方底部条中的内容，例如备注或保存按钮。

trans-unit.source: Content at the right of the header, such as a button.
trans-unit.target: 标题右侧的内容，例如按钮。

trans-unit.source: A full settings page. The left column holds the page `Title`, one navigation item per `SettingsSection` (icon, header, badge) under a raised selection pill that glides between them, and a `Footer` such as an account card; the chosen section fills the rest of the page. While the chosen section is `IsDirty`, a save bar rises at the bottom with Discard and Save. Narrower than `CompactWidth`, the page becomes one column with the sections as a scrolling row of pills. Write the sections inline (`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`) or bind them through `ItemsSource`; the first enabled section is selected by default.
trans-unit.target: 完整的设置页。左列显示页面的 `Title`，每个 `SettingsSection` 对应一个导航项（图标、标题、徽标），导航项之间有一个凸起的选中胶囊滑动切换；左列底部是 `Footer`，例如账户卡片。所选分区占满页面其余部分。所选分区有未保存的修改（`IsDirty`）时，底部会升起保存条，带有放弃和保存按钮。宽度小于 `CompactWidth` 时，页面变为单列，分区以一排可滚动的胶囊显示。可直接内联书写分区（`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`），也可通过 `ItemsSource` 绑定；默认选中第一个已启用的分区。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the page becomes one column with the sections as a row of pills (default 720).
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度时，页面变为单列，分区以一排胶囊显示（默认 720）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Discard is pressed in the save bar.
trans-unit.target: 在保存条中按下“放弃”时引发。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom of the navigation column, such as an account card. Hidden on compact pages.
trans-unit.target: 导航列底部的内容，例如账户卡片。在紧凑布局的页面中隐藏。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page is narrower than `CompactWidth` and shows one column.
trans-unit.target: 页面是否窄于 `CompactWidth` 并显示为单列。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text (save bar, accessible names). Replace the whole object to translate it.
trans-unit.target: 内置文本（保存条、无障碍名称）。替换整个对象即可翻译。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Save is pressed (or Ctrl/⌘+S) while the selected section has unsaved changes.
trans-unit.target: 所选分区有未保存的修改时，按下保存（或 Ctrl/⌘+S）时引发。

trans-unit.source: The page title above the navigation (default "Settings").
trans-unit.target: 导航上方的页面标题（默认为“设置”）。

trans-unit.source: One setting: an optional icon, a header and description on the left, and the control that changes it (`Content`) on the right. Below `StackWidth` the control moves under the text. Rows in a `SettingsGroup` (or any panel) are separated by a hairline; the first row has none. When the control is a toggle (Switch, Checkbox), clicking the header or description toggles it too, and the control takes the header as its accessible name and the description as its help text unless it has its own.
trans-unit.target: 一项设置：左侧是可选的图标、标题和描述，右侧是用于修改该设置的控件（`Content`）。宽度小于 `StackWidth` 时，控件会移到文字下方。`SettingsGroup`（或任意面板）中的设置行之间以细线分隔，第一行没有分隔线。当控件是开关（Switch）或复选框（Checkbox）时，点击标题或描述也会切换它；除非控件已有自己的名称和帮助文本，否则控件会以标题作为无障碍名称，以描述作为帮助文本。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header that explains the setting; also the control's help text.
trans-unit.target: 标题下方说明该设置的一句话；同时也是控件的帮助文本。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in medium weight; also the control's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 设置的名称，以中等字重显示；同时也是控件的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 线性图标（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成员），显示在标题前的图块中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the control currently sits under the text (the row is narrower than `StackWidth`).
trans-unit.target: 控件当前是否位于文字下方（即设置行宽度小于 `StackWidth`）。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the control moves under the header and description (default 440).
trans-unit.target: 低于此宽度时，控件移到标题和描述下方（默认 440）。

trans-unit.source: One section of a `SettingsPage`: its `Header`, `Icon` and `Badge` appear in the page's navigation, and while it is selected the section itself (header, `Description` and content) fills the page's content area. Set `IsDirty` while it has unsaved changes to show the page's save bar.
trans-unit.target: `SettingsPage` 的一个分区：其 `Header`、`Icon` 和 `Badge` 显示在页面导航中；选中时，分区本身（标题、`Description` 和内容）会占满页面的内容区域。分区有未保存的修改时，设置 `IsDirty` 即可显示页面的保存条。

trans-unit.source: A short marker at the end of the navigation item, such as "New" or a count.
trans-unit.target: 导航项末尾的简短标记，例如“New”或计数。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the section title in the content area.
trans-unit.target: 内容区域中分区标题下方的一句说明。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon shown before the header in the navigation.
trans-unit.target: 导航中标题前显示的 24×24 线性图标。

trans-unit.source: Whether the section has unsaved changes: the page shows its save bar while this section is selected.
trans-unit.target: 分区是否有未保存的修改：选中此分区时，页面会显示其保存条。

trans-unit.source: Arc shortcut recorder: a field that records a keyboard shortcut. Press it (Enter, Space or a click), then press the combination: held modifiers light up as key caps while the chord is built, the finished shortcut settles into place (caps pop in with a 35ms stagger), and a combination that is already taken (`Bindings`, or one the browser or system keeps such as ⌘W and ⌘C) asks before it is used. Escape cancels, Backspace / Delete clears, Tab stops recording and moves on, and the reset button restores `ResetValue`. Caps follow the platform: ⌘ ⇧ glyphs on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift names elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 快捷键录入框：记录键盘快捷键的字段。按下它（Enter、Space 或单击），再按下组合键：组合过程中，已按住的修饰键会以键帽形式点亮；完成的快捷键以 35ms 错开的节奏弹出键帽并定位。若组合键已被占用（`Bindings` 中的，或浏览器、系统保留的如 ⌘W 与 ⌘C），使用前会先询问。Escape 取消录入，Backspace / Delete 清除，Tab 停止录入并移动到下一项，重置按钮则恢复 `ResetValue`。键帽遵循平台约定：Mac 上显示 ⌘ ⇧ 符号，其他平台显示 Ctrl+Shift 文字。

trans-unit.source: Shortcuts already in use.
trans-unit.target: 已被占用的快捷键。

trans-unit.source: The conflict action that keeps the previous shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 保留原快捷键的冲突操作。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the clear button.
trans-unit.target: 清除按钮的无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the field, shown while no other message is.
trans-unit.target: 字段下方的辅助文字，在没有其他提示信息时显示。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is only read by assistive technology (Arc: `hideLabel`).
trans-unit.target: 为 false 时标签不显示，仅供辅助技术读取（Arc 中为 `hideLabel`）。

trans-unit.source: Require ⌘, Ctrl or ⌥ / Alt; function keys are always allowed (Arc: `requireModifier`, on by default).
trans-unit.target: 要求包含 ⌘、Ctrl 或 ⌥ / Alt；功能键始终允许（Arc 中为 `requireModifier`，默认开启）。

trans-unit.source: True while the recorder listens for a combination.
trans-unit.target: 录入器正在监听组合键时为 true。

trans-unit.source: Also warn about combinations the browser or system keeps (Arc: `warnReserved`, on by default).
trans-unit.target: 同时对浏览器或系统保留的组合键发出警告（Arc 中为 `warnReserved`，默认开启）。

trans-unit.source: The field label (Arc: required); also the start of the recorder's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 字段标签（Arc 中必填）；同时作为录入器无障碍名称的开头。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there is no shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 没有快捷键时显示。

trans-unit.source: Key cap conventions; null detects the platform (Mac on macOS and iOS).
trans-unit.target: 键帽显示约定；null 时自动检测平台（macOS 与 iOS 为 Mac）。

trans-unit.source: The message under the field while recording.
trans-unit.target: 录入过程中显示在字段下方的提示信息。

trans-unit.source: Shown while recording, before a key is held.
trans-unit.target: 录入中、尚未按下按键时显示。

trans-unit.source: What the reset button restores (Arc: `resetValue`, defaulting to `defaultValue`).
trans-unit.target: 重置按钮恢复的值（Arc 中为 `resetValue`，默认为 `defaultValue`）。

trans-unit.source: The conflict action that takes the shortcut.
trans-unit.target: 仍然使用该快捷键的冲突操作。

trans-unit.source: The recorded shortcut (two-way); null means none.
trans-unit.target: 已录入的快捷键（双向）；null 表示没有。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Value` changes (recorded, cleared, reset, or set by code).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 变化时触发（录入、清除、重置或由代码设置）。

trans-unit.source: The app's main navigation (an original TKCode design): a header for a workspace switcher, an optional filter box, sections of pages with icons, counts and one level of nested pages, and a footer for the signed-in user. The selected page carries a muted block with an accent bar that glides between rows on a snappy spring; parents open their pages with a height spring and a turning chevron. The sidebar collapses to a 64px icon rail on a width spring: labels and counts fade, counts become dots, every page gets a tooltip on the right and a parent shows its pages in a menu. Keyboard (WAI-ARIA tree model): the list is one tab stop; ↑ / ↓, Home / End move, → opens a parent or enters it, ← closes it or goes back to the parent, Enter / Space choose, typing jumps to a page by its first letters, and Cmd / Ctrl+B collapses or expands the sidebar while focus is inside it.
trans-unit.target: 应用的主导航（TKCode 原创设计）：顶部区域为工作区切换器，下面是可选的筛选框，然后是分区的页面（带图标和计数，并支持一层嵌套页面），底部区域显示已登录的用户。选中的页面带有柔和色块和强调色条，色条以轻快的弹簧动画在各行之间滑动；父级页面通过高度弹簧动画展开子页面，并带有旋转的 V 形箭头。侧边栏通过宽度弹簧动画收起为 64px 的图标窄栏：文字和计数淡出，计数变为圆点，每个页面在右侧显示工具提示，父级页面则以菜单形式显示其子页面。键盘操作（WAI-ARIA 树形模型）：列表只占一个 Tab 停靠点；↑ / ↓、Home / End 移动焦点，→ 展开父级或进入其中，← 收起或返回父级，Enter / Space 选择，输入字母可按页面首字母跳转，焦点在侧边栏内时 Cmd / Ctrl+B 可收起或展开侧边栏。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is open.
trans-unit.target: 侧边栏展开时，收起按钮的无障碍名称和工具提示。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is the rail.
trans-unit.target: 侧边栏为窄栏时，收起按钮的无障碍名称和工具提示。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder and accessible name of the filter box.
trans-unit.target: 筛选框的占位文字与无障碍名称。

trans-unit.source: The filter text (two-way). Pages whose label contains it stay; a parent with a matching page opens.
trans-unit.target: 筛选文本（双向）。标签包含该文本的页面将保留显示；含有匹配页面的父级会自动展开。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom (the signed-in user). It keeps its open-width layout on the rail, clipped to the rail; use the `:collapsed` pseudo-class to adapt it.
trans-unit.target: 底部内容（已登录用户）。在窄栏上仍保持展开时的宽度布局，并裁剪至窄栏内；可使用 `:collapsed` 伪类进行适配。

trans-unit.source: Content at the top, beside the collapse button (a workspace switcher). It is hidden on the rail while the collapse button shows.
trans-unit.target: 顶部内容，位于收起按钮旁边（工作区切换器）。在窄栏上，收起按钮显示时此区域隐藏。

trans-unit.source: Shows the collapse / expand button (PanelLeft icon) in the header row.
trans-unit.target: 显示标题行中的折叠或展开按钮（PanelLeft 图标）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the sidebar is the 64px icon rail (two-way). The width springs between the two.
trans-unit.target: 侧边栏是否为 64px 图标窄栏（双向）。宽度在两种状态之间以弹簧动画变化。

trans-unit.source: Shows the filter box under the header (hidden on the rail).
trans-unit.target: 在标题下方显示筛选框（窄栏中隐藏）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a page is chosen (click, Enter or Space, or a page in a rail menu), also when it already was the selected page.
trans-unit.target: 选择页面时触发（点击、Enter 或 Space 键，或在窄栏菜单中选择页面），即使该页面已是选中的页面也会触发。

trans-unit.source: Name of the navigation landmark.
trans-unit.target: 导航地标的名称。

trans-unit.source: Text shown when the filter matches no page.
trans-unit.target: 筛选无匹配页面时显示的文本。

trans-unit.source: Runs when a page is chosen; the parameter is the `SidebarItem`.
trans-unit.target: 选择页面时执行；参数为 `SidebarItem`。

trans-unit.source: The selected page (two-way). A parent cannot be selected: choosing it opens and closes its pages.
trans-unit.target: 选中的页面（双向）。父项不能被选中：选择父项会展开或收起其子页面。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the selected page (two-way), kept in step with `SelectedItem`; bind it to your route.
trans-unit.target: 选中页面的 `Key`（双向），与 `SelectedItem` 保持同步；可绑定到路由。

trans-unit.source: One page of a `Sidebar`: a row with an icon, a label and an optional count. An item with `Items` is a parent: it opens and closes its child pages instead of being selected (one level of nesting).
trans-unit.target: `Sidebar` 中的一个页面：一行，包含图标、文本和可选的计数。带有 `Items` 的项为父项：它会展开或收起其子页面，而不会被选中（仅支持一级嵌套）。

trans-unit.source: A short count at the end of the row (for example "12"); on the icon rail it becomes a dot on the icon. Null shows nothing.
trans-unit.target: 行末的简短计数（例如“12”）；在图标窄栏上会变为图标上的圆点。为 null 时不显示任何内容。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the page is chosen (with `CommandParameter`).
trans-unit.target: 选择页面时执行（使用 `CommandParameter`）。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 传递给 `Command` 的参数。

trans-unit.source: The 16px leading icon: a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` (for example an `ArcIcons` glyph) or any control.
trans-unit.target: 16px 的前置图标：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry`（例如 `ArcIcons` 图标），或任意控件。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page can be chosen. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 页面是否可以被选择。禁用的行会变淡，并在方向键导航时被跳过。

trans-unit.source: Whether the child pages of a parent are shown (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 父项的子页面是否显示（双向）。

trans-unit.source: A stable id for the page (a route or view name); `SelectedKey` selects by it.
trans-unit.target: 页面的稳定标识（路由或视图名称）；`SelectedKey` 通过它进行选择。

trans-unit.source: The row text; also the tooltip on the icon rail and the text that typing and the filter match.
trans-unit.target: 行文本；同时作为图标窄栏上的工具提示，并用于输入查找和筛选时的匹配。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the page is chosen.
trans-unit.target: 选择页面时返回的任意值。

trans-unit.source: One group of pages in a `Sidebar`: an optional small heading over its `Items`. A collapsible section folds its pages away under the heading; on the icon rail sections are separated by a thin line instead.
trans-unit.target: `Sidebar` 中的一组页面：`Items` 上方可选的小标题。可折叠分组会在标题下收起其页面；在图标窄栏上，分组之间改用细线分隔。

trans-unit.source: The small heading over the pages; null shows no heading (for example the first group: Home, Inbox).
trans-unit.target: 页面上方的小标题；为 null 时不显示标题（例如第一组：Home、Inbox）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the heading is a button that folds the pages away (it shows a small chevron). Needs a `Header`.
trans-unit.target: 标题是否为用于折叠页面的按钮（会显示一个小箭头）。需要设置 `Header`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pages of a collapsible section are shown (two-way). Ignored when the section is not collapsible.
trans-unit.target: 可折叠分组的页面是否显示（双向）。分组不可折叠时将被忽略。

trans-unit.source: Arc's signature field with real ink: width follows pen pressure, or speed for a mouse or finger, and the ends taper like a nib lifting off. It keeps undo and redo, clears with a wipe across the pad, replays the signature in its original rhythm, and exports a cropped PNG or SVG. A "Sign here" hint rests on the baseline until the first stroke.
trans-unit.target: Arc 签名板，带真实墨迹：线宽随笔压变化；使用鼠标或手指时则随速度变化，笔画两端像笔尖离纸一样逐渐收细。支持撤销与重做，用一次擦拭划过整个画板即可清空，并能按原有节奏回放签名，还可导出裁剪后的 PNG 或 SVG。在第一笔落下之前，基线上会保留一个“在此签名”提示。

trans-unit.source: True when an undone change can be redone.
trans-unit.target: 存在可重做的已撤销更改时为 true。

trans-unit.source: True when a change can be undone (the last 60 are kept).
trans-unit.target: 存在可撤销的更改时为 true（保留最近 60 次）。

trans-unit.source: File name for exports, without extension (default "signature").
trans-unit.target: 导出文件的文件名，不含扩展名（默认为 "signature"）。

trans-unit.source: The resting hint on the baseline before the first stroke (default "Sign here").
trans-unit.target: 第一笔落下之前，基线上的静置提示（默认为“在此签名”）。

trans-unit.source: The ink for new strokes (default black). Each stroke keeps the ink it was drawn with.
trans-unit.target: 新笔画使用的墨色（默认为黑色）。每一笔保留绘制时所用的墨色。

trans-unit.source: The nib for new strokes (default medium).
trans-unit.target: 新笔画使用的笔尖（默认为 medium）。

trans-unit.source: True before the first stroke and after a clear.
trans-unit.target: 第一笔落下之前以及清空之后为 true。

trans-unit.source: True while the signature is being replayed.
trans-unit.target: 签名正在回放时为 true。

trans-unit.source: Printed under the baseline, such as the signer's name.
trans-unit.target: 印在基线下方的内容，如签名人姓名。

trans-unit.source: The strokes of the signature, in pad units (600 × 260).
trans-unit.target: 签名的笔画，以画板单位表示（600 × 260）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every change: a stroke drawn, undo, redo or clear (Arc's `onChange`).
trans-unit.target: 每次变化后触发：画出一笔、撤销、重做或清空（Arc 中为 `onChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Reserves space while content is still loading (Arc Skeleton): an optional round avatar and 1–6 text lines that pulse top to bottom in a calm, finite wave. With `Content` it crossfades into the content when `IsLoading` turns false (the content rises 4px into place) while the height springs from the placeholder to the content. Without content the placeholder always shows.

trans-unit.source: Arc slider: a value or a range on a track. The thumb follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands up to 9px past its limits and settles on the step grid with the velocity of the release (on a coarse grid the release may carry it one step further); pressing the track springs the nearest thumb there. A bubble with rolling digits rides the thumb while it is dragged or keyboard focused and lingers 700ms after a release. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit makes the thumb strain toward the press and spring home. Unlike `Slider`, `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to. Set `IsRange` for two thumbs (`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 滑块：在轨道上选择一个值或一个范围。滑块跟随指针 1:1 移动，超出限制时会有 9px 的回弹，并以松开时的速度落到步进网格上（在粗网格上，松开时可能再多移动一步）；按下轨道会使最近的滑块弹到该处。拖动或键盘聚焦时，一个带滚动数字的气泡会跟随滑块，松开后再保留 700ms。方向键、Shift+方向键、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的行为与原生范围输入一致；在极限处按键时，滑块会向按压方向拉伸，然后弹回原位。与 `Slider` 不同，`SmallChange` 是数值吸附的步长。设置 `IsRange` 可使用两个滑块（`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`）。

Lines draw in from the first column to the second on first view; labels push apart instead of overlapping and connect back to their dots with thin leaders; rank movement sits beside each end value. A new dataset slides every line, dot and label to its new place on the shared morph spring. Hover or the arrow keys (in end-value order) bring one line forward and show a tooltip.

trans-unit.source: Arc's sortable data table: compare structured records with sortable columns. Click a header (or press Enter / Space on it) to sort ascending, again for descending; rows slide to their new places on a smooth spring and the sort arrow flips on a snappy one. `IsSelectable` adds a checkbox column, row-click selection, Shift range selection, Escape to clear and a count line with Clear selection. Rows are drawn as light text cells, virtualized for thousands of records, sorted by index (never by container), and the header sticks to the top of the visible area. Below 620px rows fold into two lines and the header becomes a strip of sort pills, as in Arc.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可排序数据表格：以可排序的列比较结构化记录。点击表头（或在表头上按 Enter / Space）升序排列，再点一次降序；行以平滑的弹簧滑动到新位置，排序箭头以更灵敏的弹簧翻转。`IsSelectable` 会添加复选框列、点击行选择、Shift 范围选择、Escape 清除选择，以及带“清除选择”的计数行。行以轻量文本单元格绘制，对数千条记录进行虚拟化，按索引（而非容器）排序，表头会吸附在可见区域顶部。宽度低于 620px 时，行会折叠为两行，表头则变为排序胶囊条，与 Arc 一致。

trans-unit.source: Arc's sparkline: a compact trend beside a value, for cards, table rows and KPI blocks. Scrub it with the pointer or the arrow keys: the cursor springs between points, the stretch after it dims as if it has not happened yet, and the headline and aside roll to the scrubbed point. The line draws once like a pen the first time it is half visible; the fill follows the tip, then the end dot lands. New data morphs the line from the shape on screen. Motion is code-driven because the pen tip, cursor and morph are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 迷你趋势图：紧挨数值旁的紧凑趋势图，适用于卡片、表格行和 KPI 区块。可用指针或方向键拖动浏览：光标在各数据点之间弹动，其后的区段会变暗，仿佛尚未发生；标题与附注会滚动到所浏览的数据点。首次半数可见时，折线会像画笔一样绘制一次；填充区随笔尖跟进，然后末端圆点落定。新数据会从屏幕上的形状变形为新折线。由于笔尖、光标和变形都是自绘绘图区内的坐标，因此动效由代码驱动。

trans-unit.source: One default action joined to a chevron menu of nearby alternatives (Arc split button): Merge pull request with Squash and merge or Rebase and merge, an export with its usual format, Copy page that answers Copied in place. The whole pill presses in for the main action; the chevron half anchors the menu, so it answers in color only and turns while the menu is open. The main label morphs letter by letter (shared runs glide, changed letters rise out of a soft blur), a new `Icon` grows in while the old one shrinks away, and the main half springs to the new width. Menu rows are `MenuEntry` items declared inline or supplied with `ItemsSource`; the menu opens 4px below the chevron, aligned to the end. Keyboard: Enter or Space runs the main action on the main half and opens the menu on the first row from the chevron (ArrowDown too); arrow keys move through the rows and loop, Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the chevron. Label changes are announced politely.
trans-unit.target: 将一个默认操作与一个相近替代项的下拉菜单（Arc 分段按钮）合并：例如“合并拉取请求”带有“Squash 并合并”或“Rebase 并合并”，导出操作带有其常用格式，“复制页面”操作则会就地显示“已复制”。主操作时整个药丸形按钮会按下；下拉箭头部分用于锚定菜单，因此仅以颜色作出反应，并在菜单打开时旋转。主标签逐字母变形（相同的部分平滑滑动，变化的字母从柔和的模糊中升起），新的 `Icon` 会渐显而旧图标缩小消失，主区域则以弹簧过渡到新宽度。菜单行为内联声明的 `MenuEntry` 项，或由 `ItemsSource` 提供；菜单在箭头下方 4px 处打开，并靠末端对齐。键盘：Enter 或 Space 在主区域执行主操作，从箭头处打开菜单并定位到第一行（ArrowDown 同样可以）；方向键在各行之间移动并循环，Escape 关闭菜单并将焦点返回箭头。标签变化时以礼貌方式朗读。

trans-unit.source: Shows where someone is in a strict multi-step flow and which steps are done (Arc Stepper). Drive it with `CurrentIndex` (the step count marks the whole flow complete). When progress jumps across several steps the connectors fill one after another (80ms apart) from the previous current step, then the halo grows around the new current step; numbers turn into drawn checks or alerts. With `IsNavigable` completed steps can be chosen by click or keyboard (arrows between reachable steps, Home / End, Enter / Space). Horizontal steppers narrower than 30rem fold into markers with the current step named underneath. Steps come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Steps`.
trans-unit.target: 显示用户在严格的多步流程中所处的位置，以及哪些步骤已完成（Arc 步骤条）。使用 `CurrentIndex` 驱动（步骤数表示整个流程已完成）。当进度跨越多个步骤时，连接线会从上一个当前步骤起逐一填充（每隔 80ms），然后光晕在新的当前步骤周围扩散；数字则变为绘制出的对勾或警示图标。设置 `IsNavigable` 后，已完成的步骤可通过点击或键盘选择（方向键在可到达的步骤之间移动，Home / End，Enter / Space）。宽度小于 30rem 的水平步骤条会折叠为标记，并在下方标明当前步骤名称。步骤来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `Steps`。

trans-unit.source: Arc's streamgraph: layers stacked on a wiggle baseline, flowing over time. Hovering a layer isolates it and reads every layer at that moment; switching ranges blends every layer from the shape on screen on a shared 161-point grid, a hidden layer thins to nothing while the others close over it, and the first time the chart is seen the whole stream swells out of a hairline along its center. Motion is code-driven (a per-sample spring array and `MotionValue`) because every layer edge is recomputed from the stack each frame inside one self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的流图：各图层堆叠在摆动基线上，随时间流动。悬停某一图层会将其单独突出，并读取该时刻每个图层的数值；切换范围时，所有图层会从屏幕上的形状出发，在共享的 161 点网格上过渡融合，隐藏的图层会收缩至消失，其余图层随之闭合；图表首次出现时，整个流从中线处的细线舒展开。动画由代码驱动（每个采样点的弹簧数组加 `MotionValue`），因为每个图层边缘都要在单个自绘绘图区内逐帧根据堆叠结果重新计算。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the series hidden from the plot; the legend toggles them (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 从图中隐藏的系列的键；图例可切换这些键（双向绑定）。

trans-unit.source: One action of a `SwipeActionsRow`: revealed under the row's edge by a swipe (icon over label), committed by a full swipe on the outermost action, a tap on the revealed action, or the row's More actions menu. An action that removes its item (the default) runs once the row has slid away and collapsed, so the handler can remove the item without a jump; set `KeepsRow` for actions such as Mark as unread, which run at once while the row springs home.
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActionsRow` 的一个操作：通过滑动显示在行的边缘下方（图标在上、文字在下），完整滑动最外侧的操作、点按已显示的操作或行的“更多操作”菜单即可执行。会移除其项目的操作（默认）会在行滑开并收起后执行，因此处理程序可以移除项目而不跳动；对于“标记为未读”等操作，请设置 `KeepsRow`，这类操作会立即执行，而行则以弹簧弹回原位。

trans-unit.source: A list whose rows reveal actions on a horizontal swipe, the way a mail inbox does (Arc swipe actions): short, touch-first triage lists such as mail, notifications or tasks. Rows are `SwipeActionsRow`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (with `LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` shared by every row that declares none, and `RowLabelBinding` naming each row). Only one row stays open at a time; pressing anywhere else or Escape puts it away. Every row also has a More actions menu with the same actions, so keyboard and screen reader users never need the gesture. Remove the item in `ActionInvoked` (or the action's own handler or command): removing actions run once their row has slid away and collapsed. The surface fades with the last row and hides when the list is empty. Rows are not virtualized; paginate long lists.
trans-unit.target: 一个列表，其行可以像邮件收件箱一样通过水平滑动显示操作（Arc 滑动操作）：适用于以触控为先的简短分类列表，如邮件、通知或任务。行为 `SwipeActionsRow`，可以内联声明，也可以由 `ItemsSource` 生成（`LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` 由未声明自身操作的所有行共享，`RowLabelBinding` 用于为每行命名）。同一时间只有一行保持展开；按下其他任何位置或按 Escape 即可将其收起。每行还提供“更多操作”菜单，包含相同的操作，因此键盘和屏幕阅读器用户无需使用手势。请在 `ActionInvoked`（或操作自身的处理程序或命令）中移除项目：会移除项目的操作会在该行滑开并收起后执行。表面随最后一行淡出，列表为空时隐藏。行不做虚拟化；长列表请分页。

trans-unit.source: Raised (bubbling from the row) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 操作执行后从行引发（并冒泡至列表）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action of rows that do not decide for themselves (default true).
trans-unit.target: 允许长距离滑动为不自行决定的行提交最外侧的操作（默认为 true）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list (Arc: required), such as "Inbox".
trans-unit.target: 列表的无障碍名称（Arc：必填），例如 “Inbox”。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of each row's More actions button; {0} is the row's label.
trans-unit.target: 每行“更多操作”按钮的无障碍名称；{0} 为该行的标签。

trans-unit.source: Binding that names generated rows (their `Label`), such as the message subject.
trans-unit.target: 为生成的行命名（其 `Label`）的绑定，例如邮件主题。

trans-unit.source: One row of `SwipeActions` (Arc SwipeActionsRow): its content follows a horizontal swipe to reveal `LeadingActions` under the left edge and `TrailingActions` under the right. Past the last stop the row still follows with rubber-band resistance; a full swipe commits the outermost action (the action stretches across the row, the row slides away and collapses), and a release settles open or closed on a spring that carries the release velocity. Vertical drags pass through to the page. Every row also has a More actions button with the same actions in a menu, so the gesture is never required: Enter or Space opens it on the first row, arrows move, Escape closes the menu or puts an open row away. Pressing outside an open row closes it, and only one row of a list is open at a time. Use it on its own or inside a `SwipeActions` list (whose actions it uses when it declares none of its own).
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActions` 的一行（Arc SwipeActionsRow）：其内容随水平滑动移动，以显示左边缘下方的 `LeadingActions` 和右边缘下方的 `TrailingActions`。超过最后一个停靠点后，行仍会以橡皮筋阻力跟随；完整滑动会提交最外侧的操作（该操作横跨整行，行滑开并收起）；松手后，行会以携带释放速度的弹簧停靠在展开或收起位置。垂直拖动会传递给页面。每行还提供“更多操作”按钮，菜单中包含相同的操作，因此手势并非必需：Enter 或空格键在第一行上打开菜单，方向键移动，Escape 关闭菜单或收起已展开的行。在已展开的行外按下即可将其关闭，列表中同一时间只有一行展开。可单独使用，也可置于 `SwipeActions` 列表中（未声明自身操作时使用列表的操作）。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the row (and bubbled to its list) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 操作执行后在该行引发（并冒泡至其列表）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action without a tap; null follows the list (default on).
trans-unit.target: 允许长距离滑动无需点按即可提交最外侧的操作；null 则跟随列表（默认开启）。

trans-unit.source: Names the row in its More actions button, for example the message subject (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 在其“更多操作”按钮中为该行命名，例如邮件主题（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: Arc switch: a tactile toggle for settings that take effect immediately. While pressed the thumb widens toward the other side (far edge anchored); on release it glides on a critically damped spring. Toggles that did not come from a press (keyboard, code) play a brief stretch instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 开关：用于即时生效设置的触感切换。按下时，滑块会向另一侧拉宽（远端固定）；松开后，它以临界阻尼弹簧滑动。非按下触发的切换（键盘、代码）则改为短暂拉伸。

trans-unit.source: Arc tabs: switch between related views of the same object. A single selection pill glides between the triggers on a morph spring, the incoming panel slides 8px in from the side of travel while the outgoing one is pinned in place and fades, and the panel area springs from the old panel height to the new one so the content below glides. Long tab lists scroll horizontally with soft edges and edge scroll buttons, and the selected or focused tab is always scrolled into view. Items are `TabItem` containers written inline (`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource`: `ItemTemplate` renders the trigger and `ContentTemplate` the panel.
trans-unit.target: Arc 标签页：在同一对象的相关视图之间切换。单个选中的胶囊形指示器在触发器之间沿弹簧曲线滑动，进入的面板从移动方向的一侧滑入 8px，而离开的面板固定在原处并淡出；面板区域从旧面板高度以弹簧过渡到新高度，使下方内容平滑滑动。标签较多时，标签列表可水平滚动，带柔和边缘和边缘滚动按钮，且选中或聚焦的标签始终滚动到可见范围内。项目可以内联书写为 `TabItem` 容器（`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`），也可由 `ItemsSource` 生成：`ItemTemplate` 渲染触发器，`ContentTemplate` 渲染面板。

trans-unit.target: 方向键是否同时选中移动到的标签（`Automatic`，Arc 默认）。

trans-unit.source: Arc tag input: turns short typed values into removable tags. Enter or a comma adds the trimmed draft (a duplicate, compared case-insensitively, pulses the tag that exists instead); Backspace at the start of the field picks the last tag and the next Backspace removes it; the arrow keys move the pick and a ring glides to it; leaving the field commits the draft. New tags blur in where they were typed, removed tags leave their slot and the rest glide in, and the shell follows wrapped rows on a spring; the field never scrolls sideways.
trans-unit.target: Arc 标签输入框：将简短输入的值转换为可移除的标签。按 Enter 或逗号可添加去除首尾空格后的草稿（重复的标签（不区分大小写比较）会改为使已存在的那个标签闪动）；插入点位于字段开头时按 Backspace 选中最后一个标签，再按一次 Backspace 将其移除；方向键移动选中项，光圈会滑动到该处；离开字段时提交草稿。新标签在输入位置淡入，被移除的标签离开原位，其余标签滑动补位；外壳随换行的行以弹簧跟随调整，字段本身从不横向滚动。

trans-unit.target: 添加后播报；`{0}` 为标签（粘贴后则为以逗号分隔的多个标签）。

trans-unit.source: Morphs one short label into the next in place (P4): letters both strings share glide to their new positions, new letters sharpen in with a short stagger, removed letters blur away, and the width follows on a spring. Single line; assistive technology reads the plain text. Rendered directly: no control per letter.

trans-unit.source: A headline that reveals itself once as it appears (Arc TextReveal): each word rises out of its own feathered clip while it sharpens from a soft blur and fades in, word after word (P20, P29). A title that mounts on screen starts with the first frame like Arc; one that mounts below the fold waits until it enters the viewport (S6, once). Whenever the animation cannot run (motion off, detached), the text shows at rest. Use `\n` for a deliberate line break; lines are at most `MaxWidthInChars` wide and balanced. Drawn as one control: no per-word controls.
trans-unit.target: 标题在出现时只播放一次的显现动画（Arc TextReveal）：每个词从各自带羽化边缘的裁剪区中升起，同时由柔和模糊逐渐清晰并淡入，逐词依次进行（P20、P29）。挂载于屏幕上的标题从第一帧开始，与 Arc 一致；挂载于视口之下的标题会等到进入视口后才播放（S6，仅一次）。无法播放动画时（动画关闭、已分离）文字直接以静止状态显示。使用 `\n` 来刻意换行；每行最多为 `MaxWidthInChars` 宽，且行宽均衡。作为一个控件绘制：没有逐词控件。

trans-unit.source: A calm light sweeping across a short status line (Arc TextShimmer), such as "Thinking" or "Generating summary": a bell-shaped band of the text color crosses a muted base, then pauses briefly before the next pass (P21). The sweep runs only while `IsActive`, within 64px of the viewport and visible, and resumes where it stopped. Turning `IsActive` off lets a band in flight glide off while the text settles to solid. A new label rises in place from a soft blur while the line springs to its width (P2, P5). Drawn as one control: the band is the text drawn again through a sliding opacity mask, so a frame allocates nothing.

trans-unit.source: Arc textarea: a labeled multiline field (Enter adds a line) with the same helper / error rows as `Input`; a live count in the description ("120 characters") rolls only the digits that change. Arc's textarea does not grow with its content, so neither does this one; it scrolls instead.

trans-unit.source: A single light / dark switch for a header: a secondary button that swaps sun and moon on a shared turn and names the next appearance. Pressing it raises `ThemeChangeRequested`; unless a handler marks it handled, the switcher applies the change through AtomUI's theme manager (toggling `ThemeAlgorithm.Dark` and keeping the rest of the current theme) inside the page transition of its `Variant`. Arc hands that transition to the View Transitions API; here the old window is snapshotted into an overlay whose animated clip reveals the new theme beneath (`RunTransitionAsync`, also usable from a handler). Reduced motion switches without a transition.
trans-unit.target: 用于页眉的单一明暗切换：一个次要按钮，在共享的转动动画中切换太阳与月亮图标，并标明下一种外观。按下时引发 `ThemeChangeRequested`；除非处理程序将其标记为已处理，否则切换器会通过 AtomUI 的主题管理器应用更改（切换 `ThemeAlgorithm.Dark` 并保留当前主题的其他设置），并在其 `Variant` 的页面过渡中进行。Arc 将该过渡交给 View Transitions API；此处则将旧窗口截取为覆盖层，由其动画裁剪区在下方显示新主题（`RunTransitionAsync`，也可在处理程序中使用）。减少动态效果时直接切换，不做过渡。

trans-unit.source: Arc time field: a trigger over a scrolling list of times generated every `MinuteStep` minutes. The shown time rolls like a clock face: a later time rises from below, an earlier one drops from above. 12- or 24-hour display follows the culture unless `ClockFormat` says otherwise; the value is always a 24-hour `TimeOnly`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 时间字段：触发器下方是一个可滚动的时间列表，每隔 `MinuteStep` 分钟生成一项。列表打开时以所选时间为中心，方向键移动高亮（列表会滑动以保持其可见，两端循环），Enter 或点击选择并关闭，Escape 关闭。显示的时间如同钟面一样滚动：较晚的时间从下方升起，较早的时间从上方落下。除非 `ClockFormat` 另有指定，否则 12 小时制或 24 小时制显示跟随文化设置；值始终为 24 小时制的 `TimeOnly`。

trans-unit.source: 12- or 24-hour display (Auto follows the culture).

trans-unit.source: A vertical activity feed grouped by day, newest first (Arc's `Timeline`), for project history, audit logs and deploy streams. Day labels stay pinned while their updates scroll, the connecting line draws itself as rows come into view, rows with a `Detail` expand in place, and new updates slide in at the top while the rest glide down. ↑ / ↓ / Home / End move between expandable rows; Enter or Space expands one.

trans-unit.source: Culture of day headings and clock times; null uses en-US (Arc's default locale).

trans-unit.source: Arc toast: a brief confirmation for a completed background action (one locally controlled success message such as "Changes saved"). It rises from its edge on the morph spring while its check mark draws itself, closes after `Duration` (the timer does not pause, so keep the copy short), and can be swiped away in either direction with velocity. Text changes rise in place while the height springs to fit. For app-wide notifications (types, actions, updates, stacking) call `Show` from anywhere: it goes to the window's `ToastStack` (see `ToastHost`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知提示（Toast）：用于已完成后台操作的简短确认（一条本地控制的成功消息，如“Changes saved”）。它沿边缘升起，依托形变弹簧运动，同时其对勾逐步绘出；经过 `Duration` 后关闭（计时器不会暂停，因此请保持文案简短），并可按速度向任一方向滑动移除。文本变化时原位上浮，高度以弹簧方式调整至合适大小。若需应用级通知（类型、操作、更新、堆叠），请在任意位置调用 `Show`：它会进入窗口的 `ToastStack`（参见 `ToastHost`）。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast stack: short, non-blocking results of what someone just did, stacked at the edge of the window until they reach for them. New toasts rise from the bottom edge, older ones tuck 14px behind and shrink by 5% per step; hovering or focusing the stack fans it out into a list (Alt+T moves focus in). Toasts pause while the stack is open, dragged or the window is minimized, swipe right to dismiss, and morph in place when updated (`Update`): a loading toast becomes its result. Place one in the window (over the content, for example as the last child of the root panel) or let `ToastHost` create one on the window's overlay layer; then call `Show` or this control's `IToastService` methods from anywhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知堆叠：对某人刚完成操作的简短、非阻塞结果，堆叠在窗口边缘，直到用户主动查看。新提示从底部边缘升起，较旧的提示向后收入 14px 并每层缩小 5%；悬停或聚焦到堆叠区时会展开为列表（Alt+T 可将焦点移入）。打开、拖动或窗口最小化时提示会暂停；向右滑动可关闭；通过 `Update` 更新时会原位变形（加载中的提示会变为其结果）。可将其放置在窗口中（覆盖在内容之上，例如作为根面板的最后一个子元素），或让 `ToastHost` 在窗口的覆盖层上自动创建；之后在任意位置调用 `Show` 或此控件的 `IToastService` 方法即可。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts are queued (shown or waiting behind).
trans-unit.target: 排队中的提示数量（显示中及等待中的）。

trans-unit.source: Base lifetime (default 5s). Warnings and errors stay 1.6 times longer; loading toasts wait for an update.
trans-unit.target: 基础显示时长（默认 5s）。警告和错误的时长为其 1.6 倍；加载中的提示会等待更新。

trans-unit.source: A short label on hover or keyboard focus. Attach it to any control with `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"` (and optionally `arc:Tooltip.Side`). The first tooltip waits 250ms and rises 3px from its trigger; while any tooltip is open, and for 300ms after the last one closes, the next opens at once with a fade only. String content that changes while open crossfades and the bubble springs to the new size. The `Tooltip` instance itself is the bubble shown in the popup.
trans-unit.target: 悬停或键盘聚焦时显示的简短标签。使用 `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"`（可选 `arc:Tooltip.Side`）即可将其附加到任意控件。第一个提示会等待 250ms，并从其触发点上浮 3px；当任一提示打开时，以及最后一个提示关闭后的 300ms 内，下一个提示会立即打开，仅做淡入淡出。打开期间变化的字符串内容会交叉淡入，气泡以弹簧方式调整到新尺寸。`Tooltip` 实例本身即为弹出层中显示的气泡。

trans-unit.source: A keyboard-navigable file tree with animated folders and a selection fill that glides between rows. Folders open with their space growing on a smooth spring while the new rows stagger in; the chevron turns on a snappy spring and the folder icon pops open. Keyboard: ↑/↓ move, → opens or enters, ← closes or goes to the parent, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter/Space select and toggle, and typing jumps to a matching row. Unlike `TreeView` (nested item containers), rows are a flat, virtualized list of pooled, self-drawn rows (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`): thousands of open nodes cost one screenful of rows, and the open / close motion never relayouts the whole tree. Nodes come from inline `Items` (`TreeViewItem`) or from `ItemsSource` with `ChildrenSelector`.
trans-unit.target: 可用键盘导航的文件树，文件夹带动画，选中填充会在行之间平滑滑动。文件夹展开时其空间以平滑弹簧增长，新行依次交错出现；箭头以灵敏的弹簧转动，文件夹图标弹出展开。键盘操作：↑/↓ 移动，→ 展开或进入，← 收起或转到父级，Home/End，PageUp/PageDown，Enter/Space 选取并切换展开，输入字符可跳转到匹配的行。与 `TreeView`（嵌套的项容器）不同，行是扁平的虚拟化列表，由池化的自绘行组成（参见 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`）：数千个展开的节点只需渲染一屏的行，展开和收起动画也从不重新布局整棵树。节点可来自内联的 `Items`（`TreeViewItem`），或来自带 `ChildrenSelector` 的 `ItemsSource`。

trans-unit.source: A squarified treemap (Arc "Treemap") for a hierarchy of parts. Top-level branches take Series1–4 and, with `ColorLabel`, every tile deepens with a second measure. A data change morphs every tile in place. Labels never scale: each tile lays its text out at its size and shows it only when it fits.

trans-unit.source: Shows what fills a fixed allowance and how close it is to the limit (Arc UsageMeter): a title with a status badge, the rolling total, a bar of accent steps (one per category) and a legend that doubles as the keyboard path. The first time 40% of the meter is visible the categories grow in left to right; later changes re-flow every category on its own smooth spring (P18, P23) and the numbers roll the way they moved (P14). Past the limit the bar is struck through with a hatch beside a limit marker, so the overage reads without color. Hovering or focusing a category previews it (the others dim); a press pins it until pressed again or Escape. Categories come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Segments`.
trans-unit.target: 显示固定配额已占用多少，以及距离上限还有多远（Arc UsageMeter）：包括标题和状态徽标、滚动的总量、按类别分段的强调色进度条，以及兼作键盘操作路径的图例。首次有 40% 的仪表可见时，各类别从左到右增长；之后的变化会以各自的平滑弹簧重新排布每个类别（P18, P23），数字也会按变化方向滚动（P14）。超过上限后，进度条会以斜线划掉，并在旁边显示上限标记，即使没有颜色也能看出超出部分。悬停或聚焦某一类别会预览它（其余变暗）；按下会将其固定，直到再次按下或按 Escape。类别来自 `ItemsSource` 或内联的 `Segments`。

trans-unit.source: The account menu behind a person's avatar in an app's top bar (Arc user menu): a compact identity header, a short group of account destinations (`Items`, keep it to three or four), an inline light / dark / system switch, an optional presence switch and sign out. Theme and status choices keep the menu open; everything else closes it and returns focus to the avatar. When `SignOutAction` returns an unfinished task the row shows a spinner and "Signing out", and the menu closes once it settles. Below a 640px wide window the menu opens as a bottom sheet that follows a downward drag. The panel scales out of the avatar on a spring that never overshoots, rows fade in 16ms apart, one highlight glides between rows and the switch thumbs slide on Arc's CSS spring.
trans-unit.target: 应用顶栏中位于用户头像后的账户菜单（Arc 用户菜单）：包含紧凑的身份标题、一组简短的账户目的地（`Items`，建议保留三到四个）、内联的浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统切换、可选的在线状态切换以及退出登录。主题和状态选项会使菜单保持打开；其他操作会关闭菜单并将焦点返回头像。当 `SignOutAction` 返回未完成的任务时，该行会显示加载指示并显示“Signing out”，待其完成后菜单再关闭。窗口宽度小于 640px 时，菜单会以底部面板形式打开，并跟随向下拖动。面板以不会过冲的弹簧从头像处缩放展开，各行每隔 16ms 依次淡入，一个高亮块在行间滑动，开关滑块按 Arc 的 CSS 弹簧滑动。

trans-unit.source: An animated semantic search: a question is typed, embedded into a vector, dropped into a map of document vectors, and its nearest neighbours by cosine similarity become the ranked answers. The search is real (hashed bag-of-words embeddings, cosine ranking, a principal-component map), so `Search` works with any question.

trans-unit.source: A unit chart (Arc "Waffle chart"): a rows × columns grid where every cell is one share of the whole (10 × 10 = one cell per percent), filled column by column from the bottom-left corner. Cells are persistent: when the data changes they stay put where they can and the rest fly, staggered, to their new block while dipping and changing color. The legend rolls each share to its new value; hovering or focusing a category dims the others, clicking pins it. Arrow keys walk the grid cell by cell, Page Up / Page Down jump between categories, Escape clears the reading.
trans-unit.target: 单位图表（Arc“Waffle chart”）：行 × 列的网格，每个方格代表整体的一份（10 × 10 = 每格一个百分比），从左下角开始逐列填充。方格是持久的：数据变化时，尽量保留在原位，其余方格则交错飞至新的区块，过程中下沉并改变颜色。图例会将各占比滚动到新值；悬停或聚焦某一类别会使其他类别变暗，点击则将其固定。方向键逐格移动网格，Page Up / Page Down 在类别之间跳转，Escape 清除读数。
